Du steuerst relevante Kennzahlen wie Produktivität, Ausschuss, Qualität, Anwesenheit und Leistungserfüllung. Du reagierst souverän auf Abweichungen, Engpässe und kurzfristige operative Herausforderungen. Du dokumentierst Leistungen, Entwicklungen und relevante Abweichungen nachvollziehbar. Du bist regelmäßig auf der Fläche präsent und gehst als Führungskraft voran. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Führungsfunktion in Produktion, Industrie, Metallverarbeitung, Gießerei, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld. Erfahrung als Produktionsleiter, Projektleiter, Teamleiter, Lagerleiter, Schichtleiter, Vorarbeiter oder Gruppenleiter. Gute Kenntnisse in der Steuerung von Produktionsabläufen, Personalplanung und operativen Kennzahlen. Ein gutes Gespür für Menschen sowie die Fähigkeit, Teams verbindlich, fair und klar zu führen. Eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Durchsetzungsstärke, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität. Kommunikationsstärke im Kontakt mit Kunden, Mitarbeitenden und internen Schnittstellen. Führerschein Klasse B. Projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft. WARUM DIESE POSITION? Du hast sichtbaren Einfluss auf Abläufe, Qualität, Produktivität und die Entwicklung deines Teams. title: Principal Product Manager, Certificate Authority
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin or London</strong></p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-AbouttheRole">About the Role</h3> <p>TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.</p> <p>That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. </p> <p>Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.</p> <p>As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.</p> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-Responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business</strong> across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.</li> <li><strong>Build for the whole Internet</strong> by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.</li> <li><strong>Make resilience a product principle.</strong> Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.</li> <li><strong>Drive an ACME-first customer experience</strong> that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with engineering</strong> on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.</li> <li><strong>Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations</strong> to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.</li> <li><strong>Own go-to-market strategy</strong> including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.</li> <li><strong>Represent the customer and the ecosystem</strong> in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.</li> <li><strong>Work across Cloudflare product teams</strong> including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.</li> <li><strong>Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero</strong> by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-DesirableSkills,KnowledgeandExperience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>10+ years of product management experience</strong> building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.</li> <li><strong>Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products</strong> where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management</strong> including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.</li> <li><strong>Strong business judgment</strong> with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.</li> <li><strong>Ability to operate in ambiguity</strong> and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.</li> <li><strong>Technical fluency with engineering teams</strong> and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.</li> <li><strong>Strong written communication</strong> for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="PrincipalProductManager,CertificateAuthority-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.</li> <li>Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.</li> <li>Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.</li> <li>Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.</li> <li>Experience launching new businesses or zero-to-one products inside a larger platform company.</li> <li>Familiarity with certificate automation challenges created by 90-day and shorter certificate lifetimes.</li> <li>Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility, Merkle Tree Certificates, or customer migration planning for cryptographic transitions.</li> <li>Prior participation in WebPKI, IETF, browser trust, transparency, or security standards communities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> title: Senior Software Engineer - Egress (Go/Rust)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Lisbon, Portugal </li> <li>London, UK </li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's network-as-a-service: Egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products.</p> <p>As a member of the Egress team, you will be a key technical contributor to a cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is WARP, our Zero Trust platform, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/icloud-private-relay/">iCloud Private Relay</a> product.</p> <p>You will work closely with various Engineering teams to translate their requirements into new capabilities on the platform. Likewise you will partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure that the technology makes the best use of Cloudflare's world-class edge network.</p> <p>You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, Linux networking, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Grafana, Kubernetes, and more.</p> <p>Engineering teams at Cloudflare operate a Run What You Build model, including ours. We are responsible for the health of our system and participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of operational responsibilities.</p> <p>Because you’ll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Make daily progress on assigned engineering tasks, such as designing systems, writing specs, writing and pushing code via git, writing release plans for complex changes, rolling out production releases and working with other teams to coordinate system actions</li> <li>Participate in daily and ad-hoc team meetings to share progress and collaborate</li> <li>Participate in the team’s on-call schedule to ensure uptime of our production systems</li> <li>Investigating customer issues that are escalated to the Egress team for triage and resolution</li> <li>Responding to questions from other teams in the Egress team’s internal, public chat room</li> <li>Using AI-powered tools and systems as part of your daily workflow to analyze and extend codebases, introspect production systems and datasets, and accelerate problem-solving</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Programming experience in <strong>Go or Rust</strong> and a desire to improve your skills in both.</li> <li>8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including a track record of owning the architecture of complex, distributed, production-critical systems end to end.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership beyond your own code: driving RFCs and design reviews that other senior engineers and teams rely on, and being sought out as a technical escalation point.</li> <li>A solid grasp of networking protocols in Layers 3 and 4 of the OSI Model.</li> <li>Knowledge of HTTP, TLS, title: Senior Product Analyst (w/m/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Wir suchen eine:n Senior Product Analyst, der/die analytische Präzision mit einem ausgeprägten Produktgespür verbindet. Du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten. Du wirst echte Nutzerprobleme auf Grundlage qualitativer und quantitativer Daten herausarbeiten, eine Einschätzung dazu entwickeln, was sich ändern sollte, das passende Experiment aufsetzen und die Ergebnisse selbst analysieren. Du bist Teil eines Product-Teams, das sich auf einen Teil der User Journey fokussiert, und arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die für diesen Bereich verantwortlich ist, sowie mit den Entwickler:innen, die daran bauen. Du schließt dich einer Gruppe von Conversion Analysts im Unternehmen an, die genauso arbeiten, und bringst eine Perspektive und Erfahrung mit, von der das gesamte Team lernen wird. Unser Produkt ist ausschließlich für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Um unsere Nutzer:innen wirklich zu verstehen und für sie zu gestalten, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse unerlässlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im Team sind ebenfalls erforderlich. Das wirst du konkret tun: Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung. Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten. KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann. Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen. Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann. Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen. Dein Profil Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben. Dein Hintergrund kann verschieden sein – Product Analytics, CRO, Growth Engineering, oder eine hybridere Rolle aus Produkt oder Design – solange du weißt, wie man Hypothesen schärft, Experimente aufsetzt und Ergebnisse in Entscheidungen übersetzt. Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren. Du hast technisches Know-how und Erfahrung im Aufsetzen und Auswerten von Experimenten in einem A/B-Testing-Tool sowie im Erstellen der dafür notwendigen Dashboards. Du holst dir deine Zahlen selbst per SQL-Abfrage. Du arbeitest mit Rohdaten, um Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Chancen zu identifizieren – ohne auf andere warten zu müssen. Du hast statistische Grundkenntnisse. Du musst kein R beherrschen, aber du verstehst, worum es bei Bayesianischer vs. frequentistischer Statistik geht und warum man vor dem Start eines Experiments eine Power-Analyse durchführt. Du präsentierst deine Arbeit klar, verteidigst deine Entscheidungen, wenn sie hinterfragt werden, und bist sicher vor einem Publikum. Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI-Tools. Diese Rolle gibt dir mehr Einfluss und Kontrolle – aber dafür musst du unseren AI-Enablement-Stack nutzen und weiterentwickeln können. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich – du wirst Texte und Flows für deutschsprachige Nutzer:innen gestalten und bewerten. description: <div class="ng-tns-c879422873-771"> <section id="processing-state-26" class="processing-state_container ng-tns-c879422873-771 is-gpi-avatar is-done-processing ng-trigger ng-trigger-processingStateShowHide ng-star-inserted"> <div id="processing-state-26-summary" class="processing-state_details ng-trigger ng-trigger-menuExpansion ng-tns-c879422873-771 is-gpi-avatar ng-star-inserted"> <div class="ng-tns-c879422873-771"> <section id="processing-state-26" class="processing-state_container ng-tns-c879422873-771 is-gpi-avatar is-done-processing ng-trigger ng-trigger-processingStateShowHide ng-star-inserted"> <div id="processing-state-26-summary" class="processing-state_details ng-trigger ng-trigger-menuExpansion ng-tns-c879422873-771 is-gpi-avatar ng-star-inserted"> <h4><strong>About commercetools</strong></h4> </div> </section> </div> <div class="response-content ng-tns-c263290053-769"> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_bfb50fc8f1f4512c" class="markdown markdown-main-panel stronger enable-updated-hr-color"> <p>Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.</p> <p>Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of autonomous commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="3"><span data-path-to-node="3,1"><span class="citation-2853">You own AI capabilities end-to-end:  from the data and context that feed a model, through agent orchestration, to the generative UI a user sees and trusts. You've personally shipped and operated full-stack apps in production, so backend, frontend, data, and ML aren't four teams you coordinate with, they're four things you do. You're not a research scientist; you wield models and engineer ruthlessly around their uncertainty.</span></span></p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build agent loops and orchestration: tool use, structured outputs, business-rule enforcement, graceful failure</li> <li>Build the integration layer (via MCP) that lets agents securely call backend systems and business APIs</li> <li>Render model output into live, streamed, accessible UI via generative-UI protocols</li> <li>Ground models in real data: retrieval, embeddings, and feedback loops that actually close</li> <li>Treat evals as a first-class system - provable improvement, not vibes </li> <li>Take a capability from prompt-in-a-notebook to a measured, guard-railed production feature</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="6"><span data-path-to-node="6,1"><span class="citation-2837">This is a full time hybrid role location in either  </span><strong data-path-to-node="6,1" data-index-in-node="57"><span class="citation-2837">Berlin, Munich, London or Valencia</span></strong></span><span data-path-to-node="6,3">.</span></p> <p data-path-to-node="6"><strong><span data-path-to-node="6,3">What Sets Y</span></strong><strong><span data-path-to-node="6,3">ou Apart</span></strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="8">You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork. Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.<br><br><strong>Kimchi Inference</strong></p> <p>One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.<br><br></p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.</p> <p>Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.</li> <li>Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.</li> <li>You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.</li> <li>You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine<br> fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or<br> network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the<br> unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.</li> <li>Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business<br> taking an hour to reach serving.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck<br> on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible<br> experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)
description: <h4>Why Kimchi?</h4> <p>Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and the router deciding which model answers each request is ours too.<br><br><strong>The Auto Router</strong></p> <p>Our promise is one enforcement layer for your AI: budgets, spend attribution, and model routing, applied before a request ever hits a model. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20×, cached input up to 50× cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers' own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. That model is yours.</p> <p><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">Made </span></em><em data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="em"><span id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="annotation">by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.</span></em></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Every request gets a decision: which model serves it.</p> <p>This is an applied-ML seat, not an infrastructure one. Platform engineers own the proxy, the streaming path, and the fleet. You own the model inside them: the training data, the objective, the evaluation, and the iteration loop that ships a better router every cycle.</p> <p><strong>The problem:</strong> routing is a prediction problem wearing a product's clothes. Speed itself is a correctness variable: on deadline-bound agentic work, a model that decodes three times slower doesn't do the same work slower, it does less work. That's why naive cost-per-token objectives quietly optimize for the wrong thing. And the bar for evidence is high: a router change ships only after production-parity evaluation with error bars, then gets held to its numbers in live traffic.</p> <p><strong>Stack:</strong> Python; PyTorch; SQL at scale (ClickHouse); OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM APIs; benchmark and rollout harnesses (RouterBench-class); GitLab CI.</p> <h4>Requirements</h4> <ul> <li>You've spent 5+ years in applied ML or ML research, and you've trained, evaluated, and shipped models that make real-time decisions (ranking, recommendation, bandits, pricing, or LLM routing) and you can tell that story with receipts.</li> <li>Strong Python and SQL at scale: you can pull, clean, and interrogate millions of request-level records without waiting on anyone.</li> <li>You know the difference between a model that got better and an eval that got easier.</li> <li>You have real opinions about what LLM benchmarks measure, agentic harnesses included.</li> <li>You know enough serving reality (TTFT, decode speed, batching, prefix caching, concurrency) to model the objective honestly.</li> <li>You instrument before you optimize, error bars and all.</li> <li>A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to haves</h4> <ul> <li>You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.</li> <li>Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.</li> <li>You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Own the routing model end to end: features, objective, training, calibration, and release cadence. Iterate it like a product, not a research artifact.</li> <li>Build the evaluation that gates every change: production-parity benchmarks, router-vs-router comparisons, holdouts by task family, error bars on pass rates.<br> Nothing ships on vibes.</li> <li>Turn fleet data into training signal: per-request outcomes from production, benchmark rollouts, and override feedback, with failure categorization (infra vs<br> task) so poisoned labels never reach the policy.</li> <li>Model the objective the user actually experiences: task success × token cost × wall-clock speed under the real concurrency regime, with cached-input<br> economics in the picture.</li> <li>Run the online loop: shadow, A/B, full rollout, drift monitoring, retrain. When production disagrees with your offline eval, you find out why before the next<br> ship.</li> <li>Push the frontier where it pays: calibrated decisions, abstention under uncertainty, speed-aware routing. We experiment on what a router should be, not just<br> which model it picks today.</li> <li>Partner with platform engineers on instrumentation: the features and labels recorded per request (decode speed first-class among them) and the experiments<br> the data path must support.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: E-Commerce Developer – AI & Automation
description: Über uns Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen. Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken. Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Deine Mission bei uns Willst Du im E-Commerce nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern selbst die Hebel finden, die unseren Shop schneller, besser und erfolgreicher machen – mit KI, Automatisierung und sauberem Code? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Als E-Commerce Developer – AI & Automation (w/m/d) verantwortest Du die technische Weiterentwicklung unseres internationalen Shopify-PLUS-Shops über 11 Märkte – von Themes, Apps und Checkout bis zu Schnittstellen und automatisierten Workflows. Dabei denkst Du in Business-Ergebnissen: Was spart Zeit, was steigert die Conversion, was macht unsere Prozesse skalierbar? Ob Du aus der Shopify-Entwicklung, dem technischen E-Commerce oder der Automatisierung kommst: Die Position ist für Trainees bis Seniors offen – entscheidend sind Dein Drive, Deine Lernkurve und Dein Ownership. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen mit unseren Probiotika ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu schenken. Deine Aufgaben Du findest eigenständig die Stellen, an denen im E-Commerce Zeit, Umsatz oder Qualität verloren gehen, und löst sie mit KI, Automatisierung und Code – von der Idee bis zum Rollout. Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Prozesse mit n8n, Zapier und MCP und verbindest Shopify mit CRM, Accounting, Operations und Analytics. Du setzt KI täglich in Deiner Entwicklung ein, baust AI-Agenten und Tool-Integrationen und bringst funktionierende Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz. Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unseren Shopify-PLUS-Shop in 11 Märkten: Themes, Apps, Checkout und Performance. Du entwickelst APIs, Datenflüsse und individuelle Backend-Logik überall dort, wo Standardlösungen nicht ausreichen. Du verbesserst Conversion und Kundenerlebnis datenbasiert – mit A/B-Tests und neuen Kanälen wie TikTok Shop oder WhatsApp. Dein Profil Du hast E-Commerce-Drive: Du willst mit technischen Lösungen Umsatz, Conversion, Customer Experience und Effizienz spürbar verbessern – und misst Dich am Ergebnis, nicht an abgearbeiteten Tickets. Du nutzt KI und Automatisierung bereits praktisch – im Job oder in eigenen Projekten – und kannst zeigen, was dabei entstanden ist. n8n, MCP, APIs und AI-Agenten reizen Dich. Du bringst Erfahrung in der Shopify- oder Webentwicklung mit und fühlst Dich mit JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Liquid und APIs wohl. Python oder TypeScript sind ein Plus. Du arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch und übernimmst Verantwortung ohne enge Tagessteuerung. Ob Trainee oder Senior: Unterschiedlich ist die Tiefe, nicht der Anspruch. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1). Falls Dein Deutsch noch nicht verhandlungssicher ist, sind entsprechend noch bessere Englischkenntnisse erforderlich. Unser Versprechen Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Auf Dich wartet individuelles Learning und echte Sinnhaftigkeit – schenke mit Deinem persönlichen Beitrag Millionen von Menschen ein neues Leben! Du hast Rückfragen? Wende Dich gerne direkt an Deine zuständige Ansprechpartnerin: FUTRUE GmbH Vanessa Köpfler Am Haag 14 82166 Gräfelfing https://futrue.com Bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. *Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Anzeige die männliche Form verwendet. Sie bezieht sich ausdrücklich auf alle Geschlechter (w/m/d). title: Broker Development Manager
description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! THE ROLE Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success. Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets. Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential. Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry. Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes. Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs. Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business. PREFERABLE Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers. WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary) 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 Share Incentive Plan 📈 Workplace Pension 💰 Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options) Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵 Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣 £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓 £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻 We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. ONE LAST THING.. Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want! Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Social Media & Project Coordination (m/f/d), Fashion Week Focus
description: About us Fashion Revolution Germany e.V. is the German chapter of Fashion Revolution, the global movement for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and accountable fashion industry. Since the Rana Plaza factory collapse in 2013, the movement has asked one question: Who made my clothes? As a non-profit association of designers, educators, communicators and activists, we run campaigns, workshops and events that make fashion’s social and environmental impacts visible and show practical alternatives such as repair, upcycling and circular models. The project: RE/CLAIMED at Berlin Fashion Week A key focus of this internship is RE/CLAIMED, a multidisciplinary sustainable fashion show supported by Fashion Revolution Germany. RE/CLAIMED combines upcycled runway looks, dance, live performance, music and interactive installations to change how people value their clothes. After a sold-out first edition in January 2026, the second edition will take place with around 400 guests expected. Your role You’ll pilot the day-to-day social media activities for RE/CLAIMED in the run-up to Berlin Fashion Week, during the show and in the follow-up. You’ll also support the coordination of the show and of Fashion Revolution Germany’s projects in Berlin. You’ll work directly with Eric Vincent Vinsonneau, who leads RE/CLAIMED, and alongside our communications partners. Beyond RE/CLAIMED, you’ll take part in other Fashion Revolution Germany activities in Berlin. One example is our stand at the Alt-Rixdorfer Christmas Market in Neukölln on the weekend of 4–6 December 2026, where you’ll help with preparation, on-site support and social media coverage. Your tasks Social media (main focus) Plan and manage the content calendar for RE/CLAIMED’s Instagram, and optionally build a TikTok presence Create posts, stories and reels: behind the scenes, designer and performer portraits, countdowns and impact facts Cover the show live and produce recap content afterwards Engage with the community, partners, designers and press, and track performance Project coordination Support show preparation: partners, designers, models, dancers, volunteers and schedules Help with on-site logistics on the show day Support other Fashion Revolution Germany projects in Berlin as needed Your profile You have a strong interest in sustainable fashion and social or environmental topics You have experience creating social media content, ideally including short-form video You have a good eye for aesthetics and storytelling You’re organised, reliable and proactive, and comfortable working independently in a small team You speak fluent English (our working language). German is a strong plus. Bonus: Canva, CapCut, Adobe or similar tools; experience with events, fashion or non-profits What we offer Real responsibility for the social media of a show at Berlin Fashion Week Hands-on insight into producing a fashion show, from planning to the runway Access to a strong network in Berlin’s sustainable fashion, creative and NGO scene Room for your own ideas and formats Hybrid and flexible working arrangements An internship certificate, and supervision and documentation for mandatory internships Details Period: December 2026 – February 2027 (3 months) Hours: part-time or full-time, depending on your availability and study requirements Location: Berlin, hybrid (to be discussed). Presence is required on the show day and for key preparation dates. Type: unpaid internship, ideal as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) as part of your studies Working language: English How to apply Send us your CV in English by 30 Oktober 2026 . Links to social media content you’ve created are very welcome. Contact: Eric Vincent Vinsonneau E-Mail: ----- Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3>About the Team</h3> <p>Anduril Australia's Dive-XL Platform team is building the software and systems that define how an extra-large autonomous undersea vehicle operates, navigates, and executes missions. The Platform pillar is responsible for the full vehicle stack, from embedded vehicle management and safe navigation through to the mission software layer that determines what the vehicle does, how it communicates, and how operators interact with it.<br><br>This role sits at the centre of how Dive-XL's software capabilities are shaped and delivered. You will work closely with stakeholders across Dive-XL Platform engineering, Maritime Enabling Technology, Maritime Application Development, and Program teams to drive product design, particularly around the software features delivered on the mission software layer. A key objective is championing operator experience for Dive-XL, translating operational needs into well-defined software requirements, and ensuring what gets built delivers real capability to the people who use these systems. If you want to own the "what" and the "why" for software on a platform that is actively deployed and scaling, this is the role.</p> <h3>About the Job</h3> <p>Software Product Managers develop a detailed understanding of user, customer, and business needs, define what to build, why to build it, then independently lead projects to integrate those software capabilities with our products. This includes autonomy, simulation, data processing, payload integration, and off-board command and control or decision support. We expect Software Product Managers to demonstrate end-to-end outcome ownership of one or more significant projects or products, driving work through our engineering governance process, co-ordinating and directly contributing to project execution, and managing adoption of the solution by internal and external customers. Our Software Product Managers will also provide tactical subject matter expertise to cross-functional engineering teams as required.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Empathize with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment</li> <li>Be the voice of the user by developing informed empathy for end-users in the context of one or more steps in the lifecycle of un-crewed systems</li> <li>Advocate for Software Product Management within the teams you interact with. product requirements for your area of focus, at different levels of product maturity, informed by your understanding of user, customer and business needs and constraints, existing solutions, and technical architecture</li> <li>Hold a high bar for visual design and information architecture, providing valuable input within a collaborative multi-stakeholder environment that includes Software Product Designers, Software Engineers, Systems Engineers, and Engineering Managers</li> <li>Manage a 6 - 18 month roadmap for your allocated projects</li> <li>Define, document, gain consensus for, and communicate appropriate goals and plans for your projects, derived from broader organizational vision, strategy, and priorities</li> <li>Co-ordinate your project(s) roadmap and execution with other teams across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines</li> <li>Be responsible for co-ordinating and directly contributing to execution on one or more Software Engineering projects from definition through to delivery, optimizing for the delivery of value to the end-user</li> <li>Drive work through Anduril’s engineering governance process, working with your teams to present plans and designs to internal stakeholders</li> <li>Manage programmatic risk for your projects, and collaborate with engineers to manage technical risk, including sound and timely decision making</li> <li>Work as a leader of multi-disciplinary project teams of 4 - 10 members across team boundaries</li> <li>Collaborate with internal and external customer teams to drive adoption of your delivered software solutions</li> <li>Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time</li> </ul> <h3>Required Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Extensive professional experience working as a Software Product co-ordination, design, implementation management, sustainment and evolution</li> <li>Capacity to learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity</li> <li>Experience leading the design and execution of user engagement and research studies</li> <li>Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in the delivery or employment of a military mission system and/or autonomous vehicle</li> <li>Experience with the design, implementation and operation of horizontally scaled cloud technologies</li> <li>Experience with the design, implementation and support of embedded software, particularly in the field of robotics</li> <li>Experience with the design, implementation, roll-out, and evolution of user-facing front-end applications</li> <li>Experience with the development of high assurance safety critical software, including with DO-178, IEC 61508, or similar standards</li> <li>Experience with the development of modeling and simulation capabilities</li> <li>Desire to learn and grow into other roles that require experience as a Senior Software Product Manager, such as Staff Software Product Manager</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. title: Senior Growth Manager - France to Morocco
description: LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South. Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live. What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth. With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity. About the role As the Senior Growth Manager for the France-Morocco corridor, you'll drive LemFi's expansion within the Moroccan diaspora in one of our most critical markets. While the primary focus of your community-building will be in France, we are open to candidates based in France, the UK, or other European countries where LemFi currently operates. This is a growth role that requires you to be comfortable traveling to key diaspora hubs to build a physical community presence and drive high-leverage organic growth. You will direct influencer negotiations, manage external agencies and key community leaders, and execute grassroots field marketing. You'll spend 3 to 5 days every few weeks in a new city (primarily across France or other key European hubs), representing LemFi at events, building partnerships, rigorously tracking campaign performance, and driving user acquisition. You're embedded in the communities we serve, acting as both a strategist and a ground-level operator. You will work across paid channels, organic strategy, and local product teams to drive massive user acquisition in this market, while serving as the voice of the user. What you'll build and own Travel across France (and potentially other key European markets) 3 to 5 days every few weeks, establishing an on-the-ground presence in key cities. Attend community events, build and expand LemFi's community network with local Moroccan leaders and organizations, and grow relationships that build deep trust. Develop and execute comprehensive user acquisition strategies tailored for the Moroccan diaspora communities in France and Europe. Own growth targets for assigned markets and optimize based on data and insights. description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role We are looking for a customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Account Management Team. As a Senior Account Manager DACH at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts. Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard. What You Will Do: Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts. Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control. Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution. Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features. Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past. Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules. What We're Looking For Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients. Native or near-native proficiency in German. Ability to speak and write in English fluently. Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable. Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting. Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses. Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation. Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI. You’ll Thrive Here If You Are: A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work. Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts. Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team. A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships. What We Offer 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays. Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket. Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk. Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party. Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones. Flexible compensation options to help your money go further. 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year. 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about. Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected. A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk. Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO] • 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership • Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) • Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO] • 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM • Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO] • 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth • Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal] • 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A • Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) • Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) • Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) Your Role We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms. You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform. This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol . You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow. Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression. Here’s what you can expect: Key Responsibilities Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement. Internally developed moderation technologies . Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs. Third-party safety partnerships and integrations . Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management. Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance . Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended. Red teaming and adversarial testing . Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report. Trust and safety reviews for new features . Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards. Incident follow-through and continuous improvement . Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support. Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub . Your Qualifications Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning; Content moderation and AI guardrails : You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting. Legal/safety work experience : You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product; Collaborative mindset and communication : You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English; AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them; You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture; You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process; You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content; Bonus points You have previous legal/compliance education Professional experience or interest in AI Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry Soft Skills 🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English) 🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment ⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy 🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback 🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit! Why EverAI? 📈 Exponential Growth : From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond 🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it 🌍 Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance 🧠 Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship 👥 Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity 🛡️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale What We Offer ✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact 📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work 🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together ❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members) 🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected 📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications 💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD ⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows 🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech , led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies . We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with. We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business. If that’s you — reach out and apply!
