title: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)
description: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F) À propos de notre client Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux. Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE. Le poste Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais. Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients. Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise. Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements). Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production. Vos missions Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression. Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression. Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces. Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production. Mise au point et validation Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire. Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence. Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main. Documentation et propriété intellectuelle Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais. Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau). Vie du laboratoire Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins. Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001. Requirements Compétences techniques Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO. Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure. Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques. Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Savoir-être Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout. Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais. Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements. Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées. Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure. Formation et expérience Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés. Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus. Benefits Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique. title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Databases
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX | Seattle, WA | London, UK</strong></h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.</p> <p>You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.</p> <p>Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.</li> <li>Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.</li> <li>Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.</li> <li>Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.</li> <li>Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.</li> <li>Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.</li> <li>Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.</li> <li>You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.</li> <li>You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.</li> <li>You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.</li> <li>You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.</li> <li>You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.</li> <li>Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.</li> <li>You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.</li> <li>You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Sr. Account Executive Enterprise Sales
description: <h2>The Team + The Role</h2> <p>Pendo’s Enterprise Sales team drives growth across the company’s largest and most strategic accounts. In DACH, this team plays a key role in expanding Pendo’s presence with major enterprise customers and prospects.</p> <p>As a Senior Account Executive, you will own new business across Pendo’s largest DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close, with a focus on $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities. This role requires a strategic enterprise seller who can build executive relationships, create disciplined account plans, and position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions with clarity and urgency.</p> <p>This role is based in our Munich office.</p> <h2>What this looks like day-to-day</h2> <ul> <li><strong>New logo acquisition:</strong> Win new enterprise logos across Germany within Pendo’s most strategic segment. You will identify, engage, and convert high-value opportunities across large DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise sales execution:</strong> Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close. You will navigate matrixed organizations, align executive buyers, and keep deals moving with clear next steps and strong commercial discipline.</li> <li><strong>Strategic deal leadership:</strong> Consistently drive $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities by building value-based business cases. You will position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics platform as a critical driver of digital transformation for enterprise customers.</li> <li><strong>Executive relationship building:</strong> Build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and senior decision-makers. You will engage stakeholders with credibility, understand their priorities, and connect Pendo’s capabilities to strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Account planning:</strong> Develop and execute clear, strategic account plans for target enterprise accounts. You will map stakeholders, identify growth opportunities, and create focused plans that support new business acquisition and long-term account potential.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Collaborate across Pendo to win and expand strategic accounts. description: Powering Great Work We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone. title: Product Manager — Kits and Integrated Workflows
description: At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Platform stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. We’re looking for a product manager to own our kits and workflows, including EV Profiler and LNP Profiler, now that the concept is proven. You’ll make sure sample preparation, fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software work together as one system, and your responsibility is the complete customer experience, from sample to scientifically meaningful result. The job is making that system rock solid: hardening what’s already on the market, making sure it works the same way at every site, and getting more customers on it without support load growing at the same rate. The Role As part of the Product team, you’ll own the product management of our kits and end-to-end workflows, including the Discovery Kit, EV Profiler and LNP Profiler and their future revisions. You will ensure these work together with automated sample preparation and fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software to deliver reliable, reproducible and intuitive solutions for our customers. The initial products have launched, and the work now is making them dependable, repeatable, and scalable for our customers. You’ll create clarity and momentum for the R&D teams by understanding which problems matter, turning customer and market evidence into priorities, and removing barriers to delivering a coherent solution. You’ll grow adoption to routine use across many sites, including bioprocessing and QC settings where results must be reproducible and defensible, and you’ll work with Marketing on positioning and the product story as the portfolio evolves. You will play a critical role in bringing these quality improvements to the market and ensuring that current and future kits maintain their quality over time, and you’ll help define the roadmap for next iterations of existing and future kits and workflows. As a product manager, you’ll be the connective tissue between software, hardware, bioware, support, and the field, acting as the voice of the customer to help internal teams better understand our customers’ needs and problems. The role is ideal for a technically curious, commercially aware individual who loves getting hands-on with products, takes ownership of outcomes and thrives on complex, cross-functional challenges. You will work broadly across our platform and alongside US colleagues; the position is based in Oxford and involves occasional travel to customers and our US team (typically 10-20%). What you’ll do Understand scientists and their complete workflows first-hand. Work with customers and field teams, study usage and support data, and synthesize their sometimes conflicting inputs into the problems worth solving. Drive evidence-led product direction and priorities across our solutions with R&D and commercial leaders, balancing customer outcomes, differentiation, adoption, reliability, margin and technical feasibility. Own the roadmap for our kits (including the Discovery Kit and the EV and LNP Profiler kits) and workflows, balancing quality, reliability, usability and new features. Build and refine market and product requirements (MRD/PRD) across workflows, from sample preparation (Aplo Flow) through acquisition (Aplo Scope) to analysis (CODI), according to our Product Development Process. Own validation for each kit and workflow: define acceptance criteria, performance specifications and validation plans, including reference samples and reproducibility across instruments, operators and sites. Work with R&D, who own development and verification. Drive coherence across our end-to-end solutions, ensuring kits, reagents, lab automation, instruments and software evolve together rather than as disconnected products. Champion reproducibility, usability and reliable results across the complete workflow. Connect R&D, operations, quality, service, field applications, sales, marketing and customers. Establish feedback loops, clear ownership and effective cross-team decisions. Own pricing and packaging for our kits and workflows, balancing customer value, competitiveness and margin targets. Work with Marketing throughout a product's life to shape positioning, the value proposition and the product story as the portfolio evolves, not only at launch. Lead launch and release planning with R&D, Marketing and the field: set readiness criteria, make go/no-go decisions, and coordinate documentation, release notes and training for each launch or revision. Create and run webinars and internal training for the field application and sales teams on new products and revisions, and keep an accurate record of what each kit, instrument and software version can deliver. Track post-launch performance, including adoption, kit reorders, time to first result, reproducibility, support burden, customer feedback and commercial results, and use it to set priorities. Analyze support tickets, logs and customer feedback to identify recurring failure modes, and prioritize root-cause fixes into the roadmap. Work with Quality and Operations on manufacturing transfer, life cycle support and end of life, so our kits and workflows maintain quality over time. What you’ll bring A life-science background, ideally EVs, LNPs, nanoparticle characterization, imaging or biophysics. Being able to speak the language of our customers is critical. An MSc/PhD or equivalent hands-on experience is a real plus. Fluency across software, instruments, laboratory workflows and multidisciplinary R&D; comfortable investigating issues hands-on and understanding how the system fits together. Experience working with empowered, cross-functional development teams: knowing when to provide context, decide on a trade-off and leave the solution to specialists. Product management (or product owner) experience in life-science tools or instrumentation, ideally taking something from first release to a scaled, supported product. Experience planning and running launches with Marketing, R&D and the field, from development through adoption. Commercial and pricing judgement: You can weigh customer value, competitiveness and margin when setting price and packaging. A quality mindset: You’re comfortable writing acceptance criteria and test plans, and you think about risk, reproducibility and traceability. Exposure to a quality system (ISO 9001 or 13485) is a plus. Comfort with data: logs, tickets, precision and method-comparison numbers (CVs, site to site). Evidence sets priorities, not the loudest voice. The ability to lead across software, hardware, bioware, support and field without owning any of them, and to prioritize when everything feels urgent. Clear writing and organization skills. Requirements, release notes and docs that other people can act on. Nice to have Super-resolution or single-molecule imaging experience (dSTORM, PALM, DNA-PAINT), or general microscopy experience (TIRF, widefield, confocal, spinning-disk). Hands-on EV or LNP work in research, biopharma, gene therapy or drug delivery. Laboratory automation, automated liquid handling, sample preparation, consumable kits, workflow integration, scientific software or data analysis. Integrating instruments, software, consumables and automated lab workflows; exposure to verification, validation, quality systems or lifecycle support. Commercialization, pricing, segmentation, product positioning or product marketing in technically sophisticated markets. As an equal opportunity employer, we prioritize fairness and respect, ensuring every team member thrives regardless of their background. title: Senior Software Engineer, 5G Physical Layer
description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are fundamentally changing the design, economics, manufacturing, coverage limitations and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. By building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system—with a unique antenna design, highly sustainable spacecraft system and low-cost, small portable end-user devices—we can extend global satellite coverage, capacity and connectivity beyond legacy space services to provide a new kind of IoT platform that lets users sense, track, connect and act on information gathered, anywhere. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Software Engineer focused on the 5G Physical Layer , you will lead the design, implementation, optimization, and integration of 5G NR PHY software for 3GPP Release 15/16/17 and beyond-5G systems. Your work will focus on real-time, performance-critical PHY algorithms running on processor- and accelerator-based platforms, with close interaction with RF, DSP, and hardware teams. This role emphasizes PHY algorithm implementation, real-time constraints, and RF/SoC integration , while supporting higher-layer interfaces as needed. The position is based in Duisburg, Germany . What you will do 5G PHY Software Design and Implementation Design, implement, and optimize 5G NR PHY algorithms on processor-based and heterogeneous SoC platforms Develop software for key PHY functions such as modulation/demodulation, channel estimation, equalization, synchronization, coding/decoding, and HARQ support Implement PHY software compliant with 3GPP Rel 15/16/17 specifications Hardware, RF, and Platform Integration Integrate 5G PHY software with RF front-end hardware and digital baseband chains Develop and maintain hardware control software using interfaces such as I2C and SPI Work with complex SoC architectures, including ARM, DSPs, and hardware accelerators Develop software interfaces toward embedded accelerators and DSP blocks Real-Time and Embedded Systems Design software within strict real-time constraints and low-latency requirements Develop on embedded Linux, DSP operating systems, and lightweight RTOS such as FreeRTOS and Zephyr Optimize performance, memory usage, and throughput of PHY software components Verification, Testing, and Debug Create and execute PHY-level test cases and validation scenarios Generate, analyze, and verify PHY test vectors and waveforms Verify PHY functionality using 5G test equipment (e.g., R&S, Agilent) and commercial UEs Debug complex PHY, timing, RF, and performance issues across software and hardware boundaries Technical Leadership and Delivery Provide effort estimation and technical input for PHY software development tasks Support customer requests related to 5G PHY features and performance Document PHY designs, implementations, and results in Confluence or equivalent systems Collaboration and Ways of Working Collaborate with RF, systems, hardware, and protocol stack teams to ensure clean PHY-MAC interfaces Work effectively in a global, distributed team across Europe, India, and the U.S. Follow SCRUM / Agile and Continuous Integration development practices Operate autonomously while maintaining strong technical communication What you bring to this role Master of Science or Master of Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent Significant professional experience as an embedded C and C/C++ software engineer Strong background in 5G NR PHY and digital communications theory Experience working with SDR platforms and SoC architectures Working knowledge of MATLAB and Python for PHY algorithm development and analysis Strong understanding of real-time embedded software constraints Excellent problem-solving, time management, and communication skills Bonus Points Deep understanding of 3GPP 5G NR PHY specifications (Rel 15/16/17+) Experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and satellite communications Experience implementing PHY algorithms on DSPs and hardware accelerators Strong understanding of link budgets, channel models, and RF impairments Experience with waveform generation, PHY simulation, and lab bring-up Additional Requirements This is a fast-paced, high-impact environment - flexibility to occasionally work extended hours or weekends during critical periods is expected. title: Data Protection Specialist – Customer Service (m/w/d)
description: Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife. Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis . Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften . Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie . Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚 Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany. Worum es bei der Rolle geht Datenschutz ist für uns kein reines Compliance-Thema. Er ist ein zentraler Bestandteil von gutem Kundenservice. Wir wachsen schnell, arbeiten datengetrieben und stehen täglich in engem Kontakt mit unseren Kundinnen und Kunden. Dafür brauchen wir eine Person, die Datenschutz operativ denkt, pragmatisch umsetzt und im Alltag verankert . Als Data Protection Specialist verantwortest du den Datenschutz in unserem Operations- und Customer-Service-Umfeld. Als erste Anlaufstelle für alle datenschutzrechtlichen Fragen klärst du diese selbstständig oder ziehst bei Bedarf das Legal-Team oder den externen Datenschutzbeauftragten hinzu. Diese unterstützen dich als Sparringspartner bei komplexen Sachverhalten. Dein Fokus liegt auf einer schnellen, lösungsorientierten Bearbeitung, um aus Einzelfällen standardisierte Lösungen für die Bereiche Operations und Customer Service zu entwickeln. Um das sicherzustellen, arbeitest du eng mit unserem Kundenservice Team zusammen und unterstützt das Team bei Bedarf auch operativ im Kundenkontakt. Deine Aufgaben Datenschutzrechtliche Prüfung, Aufarbeitung, Beratung sowie Koordination aller Fälle im Bereich Operations und Customer Service. Schnittstelle zwischen dem Bereich Operations und Customer Service, dem Legal-Team und unserem externen Datenschutzbeauftragten. Beratung interner Teams (Customer Service Operations, IT / Technologieplattform, Produkt, Marketing) zu datenschutzrelevanten Fragestellungen. Weiterentwicklung und Umsetzung von Prozessen, Richtlinien und Arbeitsweisen im Umgang mit Kundendaten. Aufbau und Dokumentation von Datenverarbeitungsprozessen (Verzeichnis von Verarbeitungstätigkeiten), Datenschutzverletzungen sowie, Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen. Frühzeitige Identifikation von Risiken, Ableitung und Implementierung klarer, umsetzbarer Maßnahmen. Gezielter Ausbau von Datenschutz-Know-how im Team durch praxisnahe Schulung und Beratung. title: Junior Data & Automation Engineer
description: Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. The Data & Automations Team The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability. The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions. Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver. The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought. Role As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams. You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written. Tech environment Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics. Data Platform & Infrastructure: Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform G&A and GTM Data Pipelines & Automations: Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams AI Projects: Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets) Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping) Monitoring & Support: Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers Collaboration & Learning: Work with stakeholders - as diverse as Finance, People, Sales, and Product - to understand requirements and translate them into data solutions Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions Continuously expand your knowledge of data engineering, automation, and AI best practices What you'll do Under the supervision of the Business Automation team’s more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics. Automation Development: Develop and maintain Python-based automations and solutions to streamline enterprise processes Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects Data Integration & Transformation: Support the implementation of data pipelines that integrate data from various sources, including APIs, external databases, and third-party services Assist in transforming raw data into clean and ready-to-use models using SQL and dbt Collaborate on data quality monitoring and improvement initiatives Monitoring and Support: Help implement monitoring for automation workflows and data pipelines Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing automation solutions Assist in documentation of systems, processes, and workflows Collaboration & Learning: Work collaboratively with team members and stakeholders - as diverse as HR, Sales and Product Engineering - to understand requirements and implement effective solutions Continuously expand knowledge of data engineering and automation best practices Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions Who you are Technical skills The ideal candidate will possess most or all of the following qualifications. Hands-on experience through personal projects (share your GitHub account!), particularly contributions to open source initiatives, will be valued equally to professional and academic experience for this role. Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts (e.g. layered or dimensional models) Solid coding skills in Python Understanding of ELT/ETL patterns, pipeline design, and data quality testing Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and CI/CD concepts Practical experience with a public cloud provider and a cloud data warehouse Attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify edge cases Good understanding of AI and LLM principles, along with practical use of AI tools in your work Excellent communication skills in both French and English, written and verbal Soft skills Problem-solving mindset with critical thinking about business processes Strong communication abilities - translating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and active listening skills for accurately capturing business requirements A natural curiosity, eagerness to learn, and comfort asking questions early rather than staying blocked are an absolute must Bonus points: Basic project management capabilities - tracking tasks, managing timelines, and reporting progress Nice to have Hands-on experience with dbt, Airflow, or Terraform Exposure to ingestion and reverse ETL tools Hands-on experience building LLM-powered pipelines or applications What we offer Competitive package Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France Trust and flexible working hours Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions Remote-friendly environment We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. description: <p></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Capco France recherche des <strong>Data Engineers</strong> pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de plateformes et solutions data modernes, robustes et évolutives.</p> <p>Au sein de notre Practice <strong>Data & Analytics</strong>, vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation à fort impact, de la conception des architectures et pipelines de données jusqu’à leur mise en production et leur optimisation.</p> <h2><strong>Ce que vous ferez</strong></h2> <p></p> <ul> <li>Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données robustes et évolutifs permettant d’ingérer, transformer et mettre à disposition des données issues de sources multiples.</li> <li>Participer à la conception et à l’évolution d’architectures data modernes, notamment dans des environnements Cloud, en tenant compte des enjeux de performance, de sécurité et de scalabilité.</li> <li>Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et l’observabilité des données grâce à des pratiques de tests, monitoring, documentation et automatisation.</li> <li>Collaborer avec les équipes Data, Cloud, Architecture et métiers afin de transformer les besoins fonctionnels en solutions techniques performantes et maintenables.</li> <li>Utiliser de manière responsable les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés pour recherchons</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Une expérience significative en <strong>Data Engineering, minimum 5 ans</strong>, avec une bonne maîtrise de Python et SQL et une expérience dans la conception de pipelines de données.</li> <li>Une expérience des technologies et architectures data modernes, ainsi que d’au moins un environnement Cloud tel qu’AWS, Azure ou GCP.</li> <li>Une bonne compréhension des problématiques de modélisation, transformation, qualité et gouvernance des données.</li> <li>Une capacité à collaborer avec des profils techniques et métiers, à résoudre des problématiques complexes et à communiquer clairement les choix techniques.</li> <li>Une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled appliqués au Data Engineering, avec une attention portée à la sécurité, à la qualité, à la traçabilité et à la validation humaine.</li> <li>Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes, réglementés et internationaux, avec une excellente communication en français et en anglais.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Atouts supplémentaires</strong></h2> <p></p> <ul> <li>Une expérience avec des technologies telles que <strong>Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka ou dbt</strong>.</li> <li>Une pratique des principes <strong>DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code</strong> ou des approches d’automatisation appliquées aux plateformes data.</li> <li>Une expérience dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux, l’assurance ou plus largement les services financiers.</li> <li>Une connaissance des problématiques de sécurité, gouvernance, lineage et protection des données dans des environnements réglementés.</li> <li>Une expérience pratique de l’utilisation de Generative AI ou Agentic AI pour améliorer des workflows d’ingénierie, avec des mécanismes appropriés de revue, contrôle et traçabilité.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Pourquoi rejoindre Capco ? </strong></h2> <p> </p> <p>Créé en 1998, Capco est un cabinet de conseil en management et en organisation spécialisé dans le secteur des services financiers, avec 34 bureaux répartis entre l’Amérique, l’Asie et l’Europe et regroupant 7 000 collaborateurs dont 160 à Paris.</p> <p>Notre offre conseil s’appuie sur trois grands domaines d’expertise : Business Consulting, Digital et Techonology</p> <p>Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :</p> <ul> <li>Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels</li> <li>Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise</li> <li>Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)</li> <li>Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance</li> <li>Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an</li> <li>Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique</li> <li>Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain : <ul> <li>#BeYourselfAtWork</li> <li>RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)</li> <li>Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find more title: Senior Consultant* / Manager* – ServiceNow Specialist (GRC / IRM)
description: <p></p> <p><strong>Standort</strong>: Frankfurt am Main, Düsseldorf, Berlin, München (Hybrid) |<strong> Practice Area:</strong> Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | <strong>Anstellungsart</strong>: Unbefristet</p> <p><strong>Gestalte die Zukunft des Risiko- und Compliance-Managements – mit ServiceNow, intelligenten Workflows und innovativen Technologien.</strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Die Rolle</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p>Als Senior Consultant* / Manager* – ServiceNow Specialist (GRC / IRM) bei Capco unterstützt du führende Banken, Asset Manager und Versicherungen bei der Konzeption, Transformation und Implementierung moderner Risiko- und Compliance-Prozesse auf Basis der ServiceNow-Plattform.</p> <p>Du berätst unsere Kunden an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Verantwortlichen aus Risikomanagement, Compliance und IT zukunftsfähige Prozess- und Systemlandschaften. title: Senior Program Manager, Data Center Delivery & Site Readiness
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Job Title:</strong> Senior Program Manager, Data Center Delivery & Site Readiness</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>New York, NY</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>About the role</strong></span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to own data center delivery and the sourcing work that gets each site ready to operate. You'll take projects from vendor selection and contract negotiation through construction, infrastructure deployment, commissioning, and handover to operations.</p> <p>This role combines technical program management with hands-on commercial execution. You'll work with engineering, construction, procurement, and operations teams to ensure facilities, equipment, and site services are ready when they're needed, with clear accountability for schedule, cost, and quality.</p> <h1>What you'll do</h1> <h2>Deliver data centers</h2> <ul> <li>Represent Cloudflare across new builds and expansions, managing data center providers, general contractors, design consultants, commissioning agents, and compute integration partners.</li> <li>Coordinate mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) installation, white space fit-out, rack-level power, structured cabling, equipment staging and validation, and commissioning through operational acceptance.</li> <li>Maintain a delivery schedule that connects construction milestones, equipment arrivals, service activation, and deployment dependencies. Resolve field issues and drive recovery plans when commitments slip.</li> <li>Assess vendor and partner readiness before deployment, and coordinate handover with operations so acceptance criteria, documentation, and support responsibilities are clear.</li> </ul> <h2>Source site services and manage contracts</h2> <ul> <li>Own sourcing for the services each site needs to open and operate, including temporary power and water, security, waste management, and facilities support.</li> <li>Translate construction and operational requirements into scopes of work, supplier selections, and service start dates. Identify gaps early enough to prevent delays to site work.</li> <li>Negotiate regional and multi-site agreements, rate cards, service-level commitments, and change orders that new sites can use without restarting procurement.</li> <li>Hold suppliers accountable for delivery, service quality, and commercial commitments, coordinating utility and service-provider dependencies with construction and operations.</li> </ul> <h2>Manage the portfolio</h2> <ul> <li>Track budgets, forecasts, scope changes, and risks across concurrent projects. Give leadership concise updates on progress, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.</li> <li>Build repeatable site-readiness and delivery playbooks, including sourcing checklists, vendor qualification, milestone tracking, and handover requirements. Apply lessons from each build to the next.</li> <li>Ensure deployment activities meet applicable codes, safety standards, and security requirements in partnership with the responsible technical teams.</li> </ul> <h1>What you'll bring</h1> <ul> <li>7+ years in technical program management, construction management, or infrastructure delivery, including at least 5 years working on data center or high-density infrastructure projects.</li> <li>Direct experience managing data center providers or general contractors on behalf of an owner, including contract administration, schedule oversight, and scope changes.</li> <li>Hands-on sourcing experience for site services or indirect categories in multi-site industrial environments, including standing up services for a new site.</li> <li>Experience negotiating supplier agreements and rate cards across locations, with a practical understanding of how procurement lead times affect construction and operations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data center MEP systems, white space delivery, structured cabling, rack-level power distribution, and compute staging and integration.</li> <li>Experience managing substantial infrastructure budgets and competing dependencies across multiple projects.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical delivery issues and commercial tradeoffs to senior leadership.</li> <li>A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred experience</h1> <ul> <li>High-density GPU deployments and liquid cooling systems.</li> <li>Fast-track or modular data center construction.</li> <li>Utility coordination, security services contracting, and facilities management agreements.</li> <li>PMP or an equivalent project management credential.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 About the Role As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team. You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites , ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site. Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required. The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment. Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required. As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods. Your Key Responsibilities: System operations & technical support You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites. Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems. Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation. Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path. Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams. Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions. Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems. Maintenance & customer-site interventions You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities. Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions. Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention. Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures. Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions. Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities. Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements. The role involves business travel within France and internationally , with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems. User training & technical guidance You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs. Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities. Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces. Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance. Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation. Documentation & continuous improvement You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities. Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports. Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems. Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures. Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions. Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems. Requirements Education & experience Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field. The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities . Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred. Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued. Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage. Technical skills Required Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software. Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems. Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues. Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures. Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required. Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions. Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures. Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken , as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation. Willingness and ability to travel internationally. Nice to have Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics . Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment. Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems. Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python . Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment. Experience delivering technical training to users or operators. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one A team eager to collaborate and grow with you A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely) Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between. Process Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45') Hiring Manager Interview (45') Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward) Meeting with the teams 2 reference check Offer (This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles) At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. You find the site, underwrite it, and get the paper signed.</p> <p>The binding constraint is usually power: available MW, interconnection, substation work, and when the site actually energizes. You also have to be right about land or campus control, fiber, water, flood and seismic, permitting, and latency onto Cloudflare’s network.</p> <p>The commercial work is NNN paper and the structures next to it: modified gross, FRI, wholesale dedicated-room, powered shell, build-to-suit, sale-leaseback, joint venture. Base rent, OpEx and tax passthroughs, escalators, work letters, landlord delivery, PUE treatment, delay credits, SLAs, ramp, expansion options, ROFR, exit and renewal.</p> <p>You build the pipeline (developers, brokers, wholesale operators, power developers, utilities), run technical diligence, and take a TCO / cost-per-MW / NPV pack to leadership for the capital ask. Several of these will be live at once, across markets. Legal, capacity planning, network strategy, energy, security, operations, and finance all sit in the process. title: Senior Full Stack Developer | Java / React (f/m/d)
description: Become a Part of ACCURIDS Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At ACCURIDS, we’re building the data backbone behind life-science innovation — a system that identifies, links, and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely, and with better patient outcomes. At ACCURIDS, you’ll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one. As a key member of our Product Development team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, and product owners. In this role, you will directly align with cross-functional engineering stakeholders and indirectly impact our customers through the features and fixes you deliver, while having direct access to our CTO as a trusted mentor and technical sparring partner How you’ll make an impact: Own features end-to-end: Take full ownership of user-facing features across the stack, from refining business logic in modern Java/Spring Boot to building responsive React/TypeScript interfaces via GraphQL and REST APIs. Amplify velocity with AI: Lead by example in our AI-native engineering culture. You will use tools like Cursor, Claude, or Gemini to accelerate scaffolding, refactoring, and test writing, while acting as the ultimate authority on architectural integrity, security, and quality. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your leverage moves up a level - you direct them, shape the architecture, and own the quality of what ships. Shape next-gen architecture: Drive our evolution toward a multi-module Spring Modulith architecture, optimize complex PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries, and dive into domain-specific RDF semantic data structures. Elevate quality & team standards: Raise the bar on engineering hygiene by maintaining rigorous test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright), conducting sharp merge request reviews (including AI-generated code), and mentoring junior engineers. What helps you succeed: Proven SaaS Experience: 5+ years of shipping and owning full-stack features in production software. A degree in Computer Science, Fachinformatiker training, or strong hands-on experience as a career-changer are all welcome. AI-Native Mindset: AI tools (Cursor, Claude and Gemini) are an integral part of your daily workflow. You view AI as an output amplifier, combine high curiosity with deep technical judgment, and reject skepticism toward AI-assisted coding. Location & Work Permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit. Full-Stack Core Stack: Deep expertise in modern Java (17+), the Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), React 18, TypeScript, Redux, and GraphQL (Apollo Client). Data & Testing Rigor: Strong hands-on experience with SQL/PostgreSQL, Flyway migrations, full-stack testing (Unit, Integration, E2E), and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Languages: Business fluent English is required; German skills are a strong plus. Bonus Impact: Prior experience with semantic web tools (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Material UI (MUI 5), Elasticsearch, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP) is a major plus. Why you’ll love working here: Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Technical Lead / Lead Engineer role or deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features, or platform architecture as we scale. Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required; fully remote work is not offered). Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space. Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €75,000 – €100,000 per year for a full-time, permanent position. Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card. Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product. Not ticking every box? Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn. At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply. title: (Senior) Accountant/ Buchhalter*in (all genders) in Berlin
description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time. Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus. Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum. Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf. Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet. Your Role Du arbeitest in unserem Finance-Team und verantwortest die korrekte und zuverlässige Buchung der Geschäftsvorfälle unserer Gesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Accounting-Team stellst du sicher, dass notwendige Zahlungen in allen Unternehmensbereichen korrekt abgewickelt und verbucht werden. Der Einsatz moderner Software-Lösungen beschleunigt und digitalisiert unsere Prozesse. Du nimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Unternehmen ein und stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen. Diese Position richtet sich an eine Person, die eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, Prozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und gemeinsam mit Homaris langfristig wachsen möchte. What You'll Do Geschäftsvorfälle prüfen und buchen . Du stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Geschäftsvorfälle in DATEV korrekt erfasst werden. Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung verantworten. Du erfasst die Vorgänge ordnungsgemäß und betreust außerdem die Anlagen- und Bankbuchhaltung. Zahlungseingänge und Zahlläufe steuern. Du kontrollierst die Zahlungseingänge und erstellst die erforderlichen Zahlläufe. Steuermeldungen übermitteln. Du übermittelst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen und Übernachtungssteuererklärungen. Konten abstimmen. Du führst Abstimmarbeiten im Sachkonten-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbereich sowie für Intercompany-Konten durch. Abschlüsse vorbereiten. Du übernimmst vorbereitende Tätigkeiten und arbeitest bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit. Kreditkartenabrechnungen bearbeiten. Du bearbeitest und buchst die Kreditkartenabrechnungen über Pleo. Prozesse digital weiterentwickeln. Du optimierst proaktiv Prozesse und erhöhst dabei den Digitalisierungsgrad. What Makes You a Fit Relevante Ausbildung und Erfahrung . Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung. Kenntnisse im deutschen Rechnungswesen . Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGB und des Umsatzsteuergesetzes. DATEV-Erfahrung . Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware DATEV mit. Weiterbildung als Pluspunkt. Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung zum/zur geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) abgeschlossen. Digitale Sicherheit . Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, und offen für eine digitale Arbeitsumgebung. Eigenständigkeit und Teamgeist. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich, bist zugleich teamfähig und schaust gerne über den eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus. Verbesserungsorientierung. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Interesse daran, deinen Bereich aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln. Sprachkenntnisse . Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B1-Niveau. KI-Affinität. Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst ihr Potenzial und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann. Präsenz. Du arbeitest in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu kommen. Du arbeitest gerne persönlich mit anderen zusammen – denn genau so entsteht gute Arbeit. The Environment Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet. Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt. What We Offer Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst. Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei. Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor. Next Steps Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf. Wir nehmen uns Zeit, alle Bewerbungen sorgfältig zu prüfen, daher kann es 1-2 Wochen dauern, bis wir uns bei dir zurückmelden. Wir bitten dich um ein wenig Geduld und danken dir dafür! Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Naomi unter oder +49 1579 2465851 Wir schätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Kulturen und Hintergründe.
