title: Software Entwickler:in mit Schwerpunkt GenAI
description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen. Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich “Generative AI” aus und suchen dafür dich, um gute Software für Kunden zu bauen, die relevante Probleme löst. Was dich erwartet Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines. Du nutzt und verarbeitet Daten über Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, APIs, Cloud-Speicher und Legacy-/Unternehmenssysteme, damit AI-Anwendungen mit relevanten Informationen arbeiten, um für den Kunden echten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, dein bestehendes Know-How auf neue Herausforderungen anzuwenden. Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzung von GenAI-Anwendungen und deren Integration. Du teilst dein Wissen gerne, z. B. auf Konferenzen, Meetups oder in Fachartikeln. Du nutzt Open Source zur Problemlösung und lässt Verbesserungen und Erweiterungen zurückfließen. Du hast einen Blick auf den GenAI-Markt und die Weiterentwicklung von Technologien und Trends. Das solltest du mitbringen Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder IT-Beratung. Erfahrung mit RAG- oder RAG-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken und LLMs. Grundkenntnisse in probabilistischem Testen mit Testsets und Qualitätssicherung mit Metriken. Du hast Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden (wie etwa bei der Beratung oder im Pre-Sales). Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch auf C1+ Niveau sowie konversationssicheres Englisch. 1-2 Mal im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um Kunden und Kolleg:innen persönlich zu treffen, stellt kein Hindernis für dich dar. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 65.000 € bis 75.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden. Kein 08/15: Bei unseren AI-Projekten sind Forschungsgeist und Experimentierfreude gefragt, da wir innovative Konzepte verproben, um Lösungen mit hohem Kundennutzen zu schaffen. Lass dich inspirieren: Arbeite mit einem der führenden Köpfe auf dem Gebiete der generative Artificial Intelligence - unserem CTO Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiterentwickelst. Wir arbeiten selbtsorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir schaffen den Rahmen, den du brauchst, um gut arbeiten zu können. Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Expert:in nach außen sichtbar wirst. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst . Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück ist kein Problem. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? title: Senior AI Solutions Entwickler:in
description: Wer wir sind Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen. Bei Mayflower arbeiten wir in agilen Teams und legen großen Wert darauf, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für das Produkt, pflegen eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und legen Wert auf eine offene Feedback- und Weiterbildungskultur. Dazu bieten wir spannende Use Cases, großen Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, echten Einfluss beim Kunden zu nehmen. Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich „Generative AI" aus und suchen dich, um gemeinsam agentische AI-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden echte Probleme lösen. Neugierig geworden? Dann lies einfach weiter! Was dich erwartet Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks wie LangGraph oder OpenAI Agent SDK. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack und Vector Databases. Du berätst Kunden als vertrauenswürdiger Partner auf Augenhöhe und führst sie strategisch bei der Umsetzung innovativer AI-Vorhaben. In Workshops erarbeitest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden die AI-Architektur für die jeweiligen Use Cases, ermittelst die Business-Anforderungen und stellst eine Roadmap auf, die einen schnellen Start mit kurzfristigen Ergebnissen ermöglicht. Mit Begeisterung nutzt du moderne agentische Entwicklungsmethoden, entwickelst mit deinem Team Best Practices und förderst kontinuierlich den Wissenstransfer zu moderne AI-Architekturen, Model Optimization und Enterprise-AI-Integration. Du verfolgst relevante Trends und bringst Inhalte für Whitepaper, Landing Pages, Workshop-Konzepte und AI-Produkte ein, um Kunden für uns zu begeistern. Das solltest du mitbringen Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung. Projekterfahrung mit LLMs und Agentic-RAG-Implementierungen sowie mit AI-Agent-Frameworks – ob im Python-Umfeld (LangGraph, Deepagents), im TypeScript-Bereich (Eve, Flue, Mastra) oder im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Erfahrung mit Vector Databases und MLOps ist von Vorteil. Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln. Fähigkeit zur Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende Architekturen. Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf dem Level C1. Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands: 1-2 Mal im Monat für Workshops und Konferenzen. Das haben wir zu bieten Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 80.000 € bis 90.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden. Sinnhafte Projekte: Entwickle Software, die relevante Kundenprobleme löst und Usern das Leben leichter macht. Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt. Kein 08/15: Bei uns hast du Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use-Cases und Technologien. Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst. Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiter entwickelst. Wir arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden. Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Teile deine Erfolge und bringe dich und andere weiter. Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Bei uns findest du echte Sparring-Partner, die mehr sind als Rubber Ducks - Kolleg*innen, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln. Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst. Viele Überstunden und überlange Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns nicht üblich. Gut für die Psyche: unsere das und ein offener Umgang mit psychischer Gesundheit unterstützen dich dabei gesund zu bleiben. Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück sind kein Problem. Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen. Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, , 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad. Der Kontakt zu uns Du hast Feedback oder Fragen zu der Stelle? title: Syndikus-Steuerberater/in (w/m/d)
description: Einleitung Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung. Wir bieten Dir Keine operative Fristlast Bei uns arbeitest du strategisch, inhaltlich und qualitativ hochwertig – ohne die ständige Fristendichte und den Dauerstress einer klassischen Kanzlei. Gestaltungsfreiheit & direkter Impact Du bist Sparringspartner:in auf Augenhöhe für die Geschäftsführung. Deine Expertise findet Gehör, deine Konzepte werden umgesetzt. Attraktives Festgehalt Wir schätzen deine Verantwortung und Erfahrung. Deshalb erwartet dich ein faires Bruttogehalt zwischen 5.000 und 8.300 Euro (je nach Qualifikation). Arbeiten im Herzen von Cottbus Unser modernes Altbau-Büro verbindet Charakter mit bester Ausstattung. Dank VBB-Anbindung und Mitarbeiterparkplätzen in der Nähe kommst du jeden Tag entspannt an. Feel-Good-Angebote im Haus Unsere festangestellte Feel-Good-Managerin sorgt für kleine Auszeiten – von der kurzen Schultermassage bis zu Momenten zum Durchatmen. Hundefreundliches Büro Dein Vierbeiner ist bei uns ein geschätztes Teammitglied und ausdrücklich willkommen. Homeoffice-Möglichkeit & hybrides Arbeiten Wir schätzen den Austausch vor Ort, bieten dir aber gleichzeitig maximale Flexibilität. Homeoffice ist jederzeit und auch spontan möglich, damit Job und Privatleben wirklich zusammenpassen. Strukturierte, digitale Prozesse Kein Papierkrieg, keine Zettelwirtschaft. Wir arbeiten konsequent mit durchdachten digitalen Workflows und moderner Technik. Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt. Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit moderner Ausstattung Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung. Vertrauensarbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten Bei uns gibt es keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster, in denen du anwesend sein musst. Flexible Teilzeitmodelle Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell. Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum. Spontan Urlaub nehmen Manchmal braucht man einfach eine Auszeit. Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familienfreundliche Kultur Kranke Kinder, Elternabend oder kurzfristiger Arzttermin – wir wissen, dass solche Situationen zum Alltag gehören. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang. title: Risk Manager/in (m/f/d)
description: Location Frankfurt am Main About Us About AllUnity AllUnity is a regulated e-money institute building Europe’s digital payments infrastructure for instant cross-border payments, digital asset markets, and seamless liquidity flows. Established by DWS, Flow Traders, and Galaxy, AllUnity delivers fully backed, MiCAR-compliant stablecoins (EURAU, CHFAU and SEKAU) that provide regulatory certainty and robust reserve backing for secure, frictionless capital movement across markets. About the Role We are looking for a Risk Manager/in (m/f/d) with experience in structured risk management within a regulated financial services environment and a strong interest or exposure to blockchain-based products. The role focuses on risk framework development, new product and change assessments, and technology-related risk analysis in a digital asset context. You will act as a key contributor to the Institute’s second-line risk function, supporting the evaluation of new blockchain integrations, product developments and outsourcing arrangements under MiCA and DORA. The role combines traditional operational risk management with digital asset specific risk considerations. You will manage defined risk workstreams, particularly in the assessment of new blockchain integrations and product developments. Key Responsibilities 1. Core Risk Management & Governance Conduct inherent and residual risk assessments in line with the Institute’s risk methodology Maintain and enhance the risk inventory, including control mapping and documentation standards Assess control design and effectiveness across operational and technology-related processes Monitor KRIs and risk appetite thresholds, including follow-up and escalation where required Support tracking and monitoring of recovery indicators and related governance processes Contribute to material change assessments and structured risk papers for management 2. New Product & Process Risk (NPP) Perform end-to-end risk assessments for new blockchain integrations (e.g., L1/L2 chains, bridge solutions) Assess impact on existing operational processes, governance structures and control frameworks Evaluate smart contract-related risk exposure at a conceptual level (e.g., mint/burn controls, upgradeability, governance mechanisms) Identify operational, ICT, outsourcing and concentration risks arising from new initiatives Support the preparation of clear, decision-ready risk assessments for internal approval committees 3. Technology, ICT & Outsourcing Risk (MiCA / DORA) Support alignment of ICT and outsourcing risk management with MiCA and DORA requirements Evaluate third-party providers (e.g., custody, bridge, oracle and technology providers) from a risk and criticality perspective Assess resilience, dependency, concentration and exit strategy considerations Contribute to operational resilience testing and scenario development Ensure technology and outsourcing risks are consistently reflected in the overall risk profile 4. Digital Asset Risk Structuring Translate technical setups into structured, risk-relevant documentation Identify key risk drivers such as governance risk, third-party dependency and single points of failure Challenge control design constructively and propose practical mitigation measures Support stress scenario development (e.g., bridge exploit, de-pegging, chain halt) Key Requirements Experience 4 - 6 years of professional experience in Risk Management, Operational Risk, Internal Audit or Risk Advisory Experience in a regulated financial services environment (e.g., bank, EMI, fintech or comparable institution) Practical exposure to risk assessments, control evaluations and governance processes Experience supporting new product approvals or material change assessments is a strong advantage Technical & Regulatory Knowledge Solid understanding of risk assessment methodologies (inherent/residual risk, control effectiveness, risk appetite frameworks) Familiarity with blockchain fundamentals (e.g., token issuance, smart contracts, L1/L2 chains, bridge concepts) Understanding of operational and technology risk in digital asset environments Knowledge of MiCA and/or DORA requirements is strongly preferred Awareness of outsourcing and third-party risk principles in regulated institutions Skills & Working Style Strong analytical and structured thinking Excellent documentation and drafting skills in German & English Proficiency in German is required Ability to translate technical and regulatory topics into clear risk documentation Independent and solution-oriented working style Confidence to challenge constructively while collaborating across functions High attention to detail and ownership mindset Why You Should Apply In this role, you will not only monitor risk, you will actively contribute to the development and refinement of the risk framework of a BaFin regulated euro stablecoin institution operating under MiCA and DORA. You will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of traditional financial risk management and blockchain-based infrastructure, working closely with senior leadership in a highly regulated environment. This role offers meaningful ownership, regulatory depth and exposure to one of Europe’s most innovative digital financial initiatives. Benefits Competitive Compensation 45 EURAU Monthly Employee Allowance 30 Days Paid Vacation Learning & Development Budget Transparent Culture, Open Communication and a driven, collaborative team committed to innovation, professionalism, and excellence. Regular Team Retreats & Offsites Welcome Packages & Company Swag Ready to Apply? If you are excited to build a world-class digital workplace and help shape the infrastructure powering the future of finance, we’d love to hear from you! AI APIs into cybersecurity workflows and automation pipelines.</li> <li>Hands on experience with Infrastructure pentesting tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs Your initial priorities will include planning benefits events at the Bangalore hub, streamlining enrollment and benefits onboarding , handling tier 1 benefit questions and escalations, taking over and improving administrative and audit processes, along with routine benefits tasks.You'll build depth in global benefits and manage assigned work with increasing independence, seeking guidance on prioritization, new assignments, and higher-risk issues. Protect accuracy and team-member experience, communicate progress and risks, and seek guidance on prioritizing improvements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting benefits administration, including enrollment, reporting, and audits, and working with benefits brokers or vendors. Experience supporting benefits in more than one country is required; global technology company experience is preferred. Strategic benefits plan design experience isn't required.</li> <li>Working knowledge of core benefits concepts, such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental benefits.</li> <li>Experience using a human resources information system (HRIS), benefits administration platform, or similar operational tools, with attention to detail in data entry, testing, reconciliation, and quality assurance. Workday experience is preferred.</li> <li>Intermediate or stronger Excel or Google Sheets skills, including VLOOKUPs, filters, pivot tables, and data analysis; macros aren't required. Ability to evaluate multiple sources, identify patterns or discrepancies, and develop evidence-based recommendations with appropriate guidance.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain benefits topics in accessible language and collaborate across functions.</li> <li>Ability to manage assigned work, meet deadlines, communicate when blocked, and distinguish urgent work from work that can be sequenced.</li> <li>A collaborative, learning-oriented approach, willingness to apply feedback, and curiosity about using artificial intelligence tools responsibly to improve benefits work and team processes.</li> <li>Ability to be based in Bangalore and go to our Bangalore hub to host and manage benefits events, with flexibility for collaboration across time zones, including Pacific time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Benefits team within Total Rewards supports global benefits programs, working with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, People Technology, Legal, People Business Partners, brokers, and vendors. failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model.</li> <li>Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.</p> <p>You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</p> <p>GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.</p> <p>Some of our projects include:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation</li> <li value="2">Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith</li> <li value="3">Building passkeys and passwordless authentication</li> <li value="4">Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI</li> <li value="5">Improving service accounts and secure automation</li> <li value="6">Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.</li> <li value="2">Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="3">Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.</li> <li value="4">Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.</li> <li value="5">Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.</li> <li value="6">Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.</li> <li value="7">Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.</li> <li value="8">Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.</li> <li value="9">Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.</li> <li value="2">Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).</li> <li value="3">Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.</li> <li value="4">Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.</li> <li value="5">Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="6">Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.</li> <li value="7">Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.</p> <p>Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.</p> <p>This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.</li> <li value="2">Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.</li> <li value="3">Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.</li> <li value="4">Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.</li> <li value="5">Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.</li> <li value="6">Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.</li> <li value="7">Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.</li> <li value="8">Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.</li> <li value="2">Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.</li> <li value="3">Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.</li> <li value="4">Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="5">Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll supply-chain problem.</li> <li><strong>Own What You Build in Production:</strong> Take part in on-call and incident response for the systems your teams own, act as a technical escalation point during course-correct agent output.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cross-Team Technical Leadership:</strong> A sustained record of technical leadership across more including scaling or governing APIs, service platforms, data systems, modular monoliths, or shared backend components.</li> <li><strong>Modularization in Production:</strong> Experience modernizing a monolith or legacy backend architecture in production, and with modular architecture such as bounded contexts, package encapsulation, ports and adapters, service extraction, event-driven boundaries, or an equivalent approach.</li> <li><strong>Influence Without Authority:</strong> A strong ability to create alignment through clear written proposals and decision records, so decisions are documented, understood, and adopted without constant escalation.</li> <li><strong>Product Judgment:</strong> The ability to balance customer outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, reliability, AI Leadership:</strong> Production experience with AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflows, including the ability to evaluate and improve how a team adopts them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Helpful title: Deployment Strategist (all genders)
description: About GeneralMind GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows. About the role As an AI Solutions Consultant at GeneralMind, you own the customer relationship end-to-end - from first pitch to close and well beyond. You sit at the heart of our go-to-market motion, working hand in hand with founders, marketing, product, and sales ops to sharpen our approach and move fast. As part of an early and ambitious team, you will help shape and scale how we win and grow customers across international markets. We are as interested in sharp generalists as we are in experienced sellers - what matters is that you learn fast, understand complex problems, and articulate value clearly. You will operate at the intersection of AI, SaaS, and operational excellence (e.g. supply chain), and become AI-native by leveraging AI tools to maximise your performance. What You'll Do Own customer interactions from first pitch through close to further upsells. Engage and build long-term partnerships with C-level executives and their direct reports across established, complex enterprises. Run discovery calls, product demos, and negotiations - translating complex product value into clear business outcomes for buyers who may be new to the category. Guide customers through deep dives and product Go-Lives, then nurture and expand the relationship over time. Develop a deep understanding of customer challenges, especially in operational domains such as supply chain. Partner closely with marketing, product, and founders - feeding market insights back into messaging, strategy, and roadmap. Maintain clean pipeline management and accurate forecasting in our CRM. Contribute to building and refining our product and go-to-market strategy, and continuously test, learn, and improve your approach. What we are looking for 3-8 years of professional experience, gained in a demanding environment such as top-tier management consulting, venture capital or growth equity, a fast-paced high-growth startup, or B2B SaaS / enterprise software sales. Ambitious, fast-learning, and energised by complexity - you want to build, not just execute, and take ownership early. Ability to understand complex products and business processes quickly, and to articulate their value clearly to non-technical buyers. A structured, analytical, and highly proactive working style. A team player who rolls up their sleeves - no task is beneath anyone here, and that mindset is what makes us move fast. Strong curiosity for AI tools and a genuine willingness to integrate them into your workflow; excited about shaping how modern go-to-market is done with AI. Motivated to grow into a top-performing commercial operator - with or without a pure sales background. Above-average academic record; a strong university background is a plus. Excellent communication skills in German and English; additional languages are a plus. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

du scope fonctionnel pour optimiser continuellement la qualité de service et la robustesse de nos outils.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>CE QUE TU APPORTES</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Une expérience confirmée sur curiosité naturelle qui te pousse à creuser les sujets complexes.</li> <li>Un équilibre démontré entre réactivité en gestion d'incident et proactivité dans la mise en place d'outils de surveillance.</li> <li>Une capacité à animer une activité de support et à piloter des plans d'action transversaux.</li> <li>Une sensibilité aux enjeux de l'IA (génération d'alertes intelligentes, automatisation du traitement) pour apporter davantage d'efficience au support est un atout majeur.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>STACK TECHNIQUE</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Observabilité et monitoring : Datadog</li> <li>Gestion des incidents & ITSM : SMAX</li> <li>Architecture Web, APIs et flux de données e-commerce / logistique</li> </ul> <h3><strong>CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS</strong></h3> <ul> rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE</strong></h3> <p>Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>DECATHLON DIGITAL </strong></p> <p>Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. title: Director, Market Growth Strategy, Molecule to Market (Lab Automation)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Why At Dotmatics </strong></p> <p>At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.</p> <p><strong>We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.</strong></p> <p>We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.</p> <p>Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.</p> <p><strong>Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics </strong></p> <p>Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.</p> <p>You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.</p> <p><strong>We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. </strong></p></div><div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <div class="iCIMS_InfoMsg iCIMS_InfoMsg_Job"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Container"> <div class="iCIMS_Expandable_Text"> <p><strong>What do we need </strong></p> <p>We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Lab Automation and Orchestration.<br>Lab automation is where science meets engineering. Robotics, liquid handlers, instruments, and scheduling software are moving labs from manual work toward automated, data driven, and eventually autonomous operation. While we are supporting fully automated labs, most labs still run as islands. Instruments speak different languages, workflows are hard to change, and the data that comes off the line rarely arrives ready for analysis or AI. </p> <p>We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Lab Orchestration and automation are core to our Molecule to Market story, and they connect directly to the strengths of Siemens in industrial automation. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.</p> <p>This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with lab automation leaders at pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutes across the UK and Europe, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the lab automation market with confidence and one consistent story. You’ll work with industry thought leaders to shape the conversation on autonomous labs and AI. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in lab automation. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win.</p> <p><strong>How you’ll spend your time</strong></p> <ul> <li>Customer engagements: meeting automation leaders, scientists, and engineers, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business</li> <li>Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors and automation vendors, and spotting trends early</li> <li>Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win</li> <li>Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the lab automation audience</li> <li>Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on self driving labs and the future of the automated lab</li> <li>Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get labs running on Luma and putting AI to work on automated workflows and data</li> <li>Partner and ecosystem engagement: working with instrument makers, robotics providers, and integrators so our joint story is clear to customers</li> <li>Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the lab automation market</li> </ul> <p>The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to lab automation buyers, and turn that into real software adoption.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the market strategy for Luma in lab automation, including workflow orchestration, scheduling, instrument integration, data capture, and autonomous lab concepts</li> <li>Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Lab Automation, Automation Engineers, Discovery Technologies, Research IT, Core Facilities, and Operations leaders</li> <li>Build positioning and messaging that speaks to automation engineers, scientists, IT leaders, and executives</li> <li>Drive software adoption by working with customers and field teams to find the workflows where Luma delivers value fastest, and by capturing what works so others can repeat it</li> <li>Define and prove AI use cases for lab automation, including closed loop experimentation, smarter scheduling, and data prepared for tools like NVIDIA BioNeMo</li> <li>Translate automation pain points into clear value, including less integration work, faster workflow changes, better use of instruments, trusted data, and a clear path from automation islands to connected labs</li> <li>Partner with the Siemens Solution Marketing team to build content, campaigns, and events for the lab automation market</li> <li>Work with industry thought leaders, analysts, and partners to build credibility and bring outside voices into our story</li> <li>Create the competitive view against other informatics vendors, scheduling and orchestration tools, automation vendors, and in house builds</li> <li>Develop the business case, pricing inputs, and value story with Finance and Sales</li> <li>Equip global teams with talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and customer proof points</li> <li>Partner with DISW and DI Automation teams to align messaging, joint offers, and customer conversations</li> <li>Partner with Product on roadmap priorities based on what automation teams tell us</li> <li>Connect lab automation to the bigger Molecule to Market narrative, including ELN, Biologics, and Tech Transfer</li> <li>Support strategic pursuits and executive conversations with customers and partners</li> <li>Track market trends, including autonomous labs, AI driven discovery, robotics, and data standards, and turn them into action</li> </ul> <p><strong>We are looking for people who have </strong>10 or more years in life sciences, lab automation, or scientific technology, with hands on experience in a pharma, biotech, CDMO, research institute, or automation vendor setting.  You will bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case excellent writing and presentation skills. Ideally holding a degree in life sciences, engineering, robotics, or a related field, with a Masters or PhD a plus </p> <p><strong>The key skills </strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of how automated labs work day to day, including liquid handling, robotics, instrument integration, workflow scheduling, and the data that flows from them</li> <li>Knowledge of how automation leaders make decisions, balance speed, cost, and flexibility, and work with scientists, IT, and engineering teams</li> <li>Experience in product marketing, market strategy, product management, or commercial roles at a software, automation, informatics, or life sciences solutions company</li> <li>Familiarity with scheduling and orchestration software, LIMS, ELN, or lab data platforms</li> <li>A track record of driving software adoption, or of turning new technology such as AI into use cases customers actually adopt</li> <li>Proven ability to turn complex science and technology into clear, simple messaging</li> <li>Comfort working with senior leaders, industry experts, and customers</li> <li>Ability to work across a large, global, matrixed organisation and build trust with teams in different regions and business units</li> <li>Right to work in the UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience running or supporting a lab automation team or an automated lab build</li> <li>Knowledge of industrial automation concepts and how they apply to the lab</li> <li>Familiarity with lab data standards and open interfaces</li> <li>Experience with AI, machine learning, or data platforms in a scientific setting</li> <li>Existing relationships with industry thought leaders, analysts, automation vendors, or research institutes</li> <li>Experience working across the UK and European life sciences community</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p> <ul> <li>A clear lab automation market strategy adopted by Sales, Product, Services, and Solution Marketing</li> <li>Messaging and sales tools that teams around the world actually use</li> <li>One consistent story for lab automation across Dotmatics, DISW, and DI Automation</li> <li>Growing description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin,TX; Washington, D.C.</p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Security at Cloudflare is a diverse, focused team committed to helping secure both Cloudflare and our customers. The Security Technical Program Management team sits at the intersection of engineering, security, and business. We define, align, and drive the strategic security programs that reduce risk and advance innovation across Cloudflare, while partnering to build the best solutions for our customers.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is seeking a highly skilled, self-motivated Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the company’s strategic Governance, Risk, and Compliance program, initially focused on the Department of Defense Impact Level 4 (IL4) initiative. </p> <p>As a Technical Program Manager focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance, you will define, align, and drive complex security and compliance programs that reduce risk and enable Cloudflare’s regulated business. You will manage stakeholder expectations, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and ensure the delivery of predictable, high-impact outcomes.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is process-oriented yet remains flexible and iterative. You excel at navigating ambiguous technical challenges, fostering collaboration across teams, and asking the insightful questions necessary to drive stakeholders toward measurable results. This position requires a professional capable of managing complex tradeoffs and coordinating teams across global time zones.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance team as its dedicated Technical Program Manager</li> <li>Lead the integrated IL4 roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and execution cadence</li> <li>Connect with stakeholders through expert communication and diplomacy to maintain alignment and encourage collaboration</li> <li>Establish and maintain a program operating cadence: roadmap, governance forums, decision log, risk/issue register, communications plan, and executive reporting</li> <li>Build automations and AI agents to handle routine program administration at scale</li> <li>Utilize AI platforms to consolidate diverse project streams into unified roadmaps, generating initial metrics, status updates, and executive reporting dashboards</li> <li>Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities by identifying tradeoffs early, applying risk-based judgment, and balancing long-term compliance objectives with urgent security needs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills and Knowledge</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of continuous improvement</li> <li>Experience in cybersecurity or security program management in a technical, fast-moving environment</li> <li>BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or related field or equivalent experience</li> <li>Proven track record of creating realistic project plans, managing dependencies, and overseeing execution to meet commitments with predictability</li> <li>Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity and authorization frameworks (for example, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, FedRAMP, and DoD SRGs), with the ability to translate requirements into program plans and measurable delivery</li> <li>Proven ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including executives</li> <li>Hands-on experience or a strong competency in leveraging AI productivity tools and development platforms to automate routine program administration, with rigorous human-in-the-loop review of AI output</li> <li>Comfortable managing tight deadlines, changing priorities, and ambiguity</li> <li>Proven ability to forge and sustain effective partnerships internally and externally</li> <li>Strong competency with Confluence and Jira and various development methodologies </li> <li>Embraces technology including automation and AI augmentation</li> <li>Experience working with multiple time zones and cross-functional teams</li> </ul> <div> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $158,000 - $218,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you are the go-to-market partner embedded into a product team, from the first discovery conversation to scaling. You bring customer, market and competitive evidence into the decisions that shape what gets built from day one: which segments to target, what features to prioritize, how to create Aha moments. You influence what the product does, how it wins and whether people will pay. You also build the systems that keep this work running: from automated competitor and customer insights generation, to agentic workflows that let product teams run smaller launches themselves at high quality. You work closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Growth Marketing and Paid Acquisition. What you'll do Taking one (or many) of our big bets to market. You gather evidence that improves our GTM decision quality, not tick off a launch checklist. Align the people around the work. Bring structure to complex go-to-market work: clear owners, milestones, decision points and success measures. Facilitate decisions across Product, Engineering, Data, Growth and commercial teams. Build the insight engine. Replace ad hoc research with automated flows of competitor and customer insight that product and marketing teams use every week. Own part of the context system. title: (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d)
description: At aedifion , you will actively shape the future of energy-efficient building operations. Our mission is to make existing buildings smarter, more sustainable, and easier to manage making a real contribution to CO₂ reduction. You'll join an innovative tech company that uses cutting-edge technologies like IoT, AI, and cloud solutions to enable sustainable real estate. Our culture? Open, diverse, and team-oriented. With more than 100 colleagues from various nations, we combine a wide range of expertise and perspectives to achieve big things together. Your impact in this position: As our (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d) , your mission is to make sure our revenue organization grows in a way that is strong, predictable and scalable. You combine data analysis with consistent process automation, and you play a key part in giving Sales more time for what actually matters, in raising forecast quality to a new level, and in building a go-to-market (GTM) structure that scales with aedifion. What you can expect: Sales enablement roadmap: Take ownership of the prioritized sales enablement roadmap and drive it forward, so that manual work in Sales goes down step by step through workflow automation. Forecast and pipeline: Define what good pipeline quality and forecast accuracy mean at aedifion, track how both develop, and turn what you see into concrete measures that make our planning more reliable. Turning data into decisions: Analyze GTM data from different sources, spot patterns and connections, and translate them into clear recommendations that revenue leaders and the C-level can act on. GTM process architecture: Design and improve the processes along the entire GTM funnel, set clear definitions and handovers between teams, and keep developing them based on your own analyses. Building agents and governance: Build and roll out AI agents for recurring steps in GTM work, establish one common standard for how AI automation is used, and keep quality and oversight across all teams. GTM tech stack: Evaluate tools against defined criteria, prepare well-founded decision papers, and shape together with our Head of Business Operations how new solutions fit into our existing tool landscape. Strategic GTM planning: Create the analytical basis for decisions on growth, market coverage and compensation, so they rest on solid data and set the right incentives for our team. At aedifion we foster an open and appreciative culture where everyone can develop freely, regardless of background, gender, age, ability or orientation. We offer a safe space for personal growth and independent work. Flexibility and openness matter to us, so that everyone can work with authenticity and enjoy what they do. We especially welcome applications from women. What you bring along: Experience: You hold a university degree and have already taken ownership in Revenue Operations with results you can point to, ideally in a scale-up or start-up environment. Automation and AI: You know process automation and AI-supported workflows from your own hands-on work, you have implemented concrete use cases yourself, and you know where they add the most value in GTM. Data analysis: You bring complex data from different sources together, see the patterns in it and turn them into recommendations that revenue leaders and the C-level can act on. CRM and BI tools: You know your way around Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and you have experience presenting data clearly with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Metabase. Stakeholder coordination: You have worked with different teams before, you know how to moderate competing requirements, communicate priorities clearly and make complex topics understandable for everyone involved. GTM expertise: You know the key metrics of a revenue organization, you understand how pipeline, forecast and stage velocity work, and you have a solid grasp of retention metrics such as NRR, renewal rate and expansion. Languages and tools: With very good German and English (C1 each) you communicate confidently across the team. Experience with Confluence or a comparable tool and with the Microsoft 365 environment rounds off your profile. Benefits Make a difference: Your work helps to reduce CO₂ emissions and make buildings more sustainable and energy-efficient. Mobile work: Organise your working day according to your needs – with flexible working hours, short core working hours and the freedom to work from our modern office in Cologne, remotely from anywhere in Germany or up to 10 days a year from other European countries. Feel-good offer: With 30 days of annual leave, you can relax and unwind, while fresh organic fruit, regional coffee, free drinks and our monthly team breakfast provide you with your daily energy boost. Further training: We support you with tailor-made training opportunities to advance your career. Tech stack: You will receive modern work equipment of your choice – whether Microsoft or Apple – as well as high-quality noise-cancelling headphones for focused work. Mobility package: Always mobile: you can choose between the Germany Ticket or a Jobrad bike – for your commute or private use. Pension provision: Subsidies for capital-forming benefits (VWL) or company pension schemes (bAV). Stay active: With our Urban Sports Club membership, you have access to a wide range of sports and fitness offers – to help you recharge and stay healthy inside and outside of work. #teamaedifion: Regular team events, working on an equal footing, actively sharing experiences and flat hierarchies promote strong teamwork and open communication within our team. Dog-friendly office: Bring your dog along – we look forward to some animal support. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>
