title: Account Solutions Architect - Greenfield - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h2> <p>The infrastructure powering the AI era doesn’t sell itself, and the customers building on it don’t want to be sold to. They want a peer. You’ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you’ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights & Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You’ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).</li> <li>Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.</li> <li>Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.</li> <li>Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.</li> <li>Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.</li> <li>Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.</li> <li>Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.</li> <li>Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.</li> <li>Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn’t be unfamiliar territory.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.</li> <li>Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple concurrent opportunities across a geographic territory.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100, A100, H200) and the software stack around them: CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN.</li> <li>Working knowledge of high-performance networking concepts: InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, TCP/IP.</li> <li>Background working directly with AI labs, research institutions, or enterprise ML teams.</li> <li>Exposure to physical AI use cases and the infrastructure requirements they bring.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.</li> </ul> <p>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You’re comfortable going one layer deeper than the demo - whether that’s a networking topology, a training job that won’t converge, or a rack layout question from a facilities team.</li> <li>You’ve worked across more than one layer of the stack and find the intersections more interesting than any single discipline.</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-moving environment and take ownership of your region like it’s your own business.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who makes the people around you - including your AE and AM - better at their jobs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. About the Role We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer . Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client? You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them. If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you. Responsibilities Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design. Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do. Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster. Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress. Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty. Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path. Qualifications 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus. Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code. Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python. Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard. Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet. Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT. Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written). Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry. Life at Nabla When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked. If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application. Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link . Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Frontend Engineer - Agentic AI
description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Your Mission As a Frontend Engineer at Hawk, you will build and maintain the user interface of our agentic AI Investigation Agent. This is the product where compliance analysts configure AI workflows, watch autonomous investigations run, and review, question and act on what the agent concludes. The frontend is a modern TypeScript monorepo made of a host application and a growing set of independently deployable microfrontends. These remotes are designed to be built once and used in two places: our new shadcn/ui-based Investigation Agent and our existing Material UI-based Case Manager. Your job is to understand this codebase deeply, keep it healthy, and ship new features with care, from the component level all the way to how it is built and deployed. What You'll Work On: Features: Build product features end to end in React and TypeScript, such as workflow graph editors, investigation timelines, data-heavy tables and dashboards that make agentic AI output understandable for analysts. Microfrontends: Develop and maintain Module Federation remotes, keep remote/host contracts stable, and make sure features fit into both the Investigation Agent and the MUI-based Case Manager. Design system and data layer: Contribute to our shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind component library (documented in Storybook), and consume our Python/FastAPI backends through OpenAPI-generated clients with TanStack Query and Router. Build, test and deploy: Work in a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with GitHub Actions CI, Vitest and Playwright tests, and deployments to AWS including per-PR preview environments. Collaboration: Work closely with Product, UX, backend engineers and Data Science, and use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor as part of your everyday workflow. Your Profile: 3–5 years building and maintaining production React applications, with strong TypeScript and modern React skills (hooks, composition, performance, complex state and forms). Clean frontend architecture: you structure code around features and clear boundaries. You keep UI components presentational and reusable, put data fetching and business logic in hooks and typed API layers, and keep server state separate from local UI state. You prefer composition, small focused components and strict typing, and you treat cross-module contracts as an API. Design-system experience: hands-on work with a component-library approach, ideally shadcn/ui, Radix and Tailwind. Familiarity with Material UI is a strong plus. Microfrontends and delivery: Module Federation or similar runtime composition, shared dependencies and host/remote contracts, plus the build and deployment basics behind them: Vite, monorepos (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo or Nx), CI pipelines (GitHub Actions) Comfort with ambiguity : you're happy working on problems that aren't fully defined yet. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, build a first version and refine it with Product and UX, without waiting for a perfect spec. AI tooling: daily, practical use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.). Communication: clear communication in English, and the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Bonus: Some Python: enough to read a FastAPI endpoint or Pydantic model, run the backend locally, trace a bug across the API boundary, or open a small backend PR. You don't need to be a backend engineer. Infrastructure as code: exposure to Terraform or AWS CDK. Quality tooling: Storybook-driven development, visual regression testing or accessibility testing. Auth: Auth0/OIDC integration in single-page apps. Domain interest: UX for AI products, or previous work in fintech, RegTech or compliance. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Actively collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g. pharmacy, warehouse) Participating and supporting in audits (internal/external) and inspections where required Any other tasks deemed necessary by the Responsible Person (RP) What do you need? Knowledge of Good Manufacturing (GMP) or Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and the regulatory framework governing pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution Proven experience working within a GMDP regulated pharmaceutical environment, (ideally supporting wholesale distribution and importation), with more than 2 years experience Proven experience of dealing with a Quality Management Systems (QMS), including but not limited to Complaints, CAPAs, Deviations risk management, change control, self inspections/internal audits Proven experience in dealing with unlicensed products (especially in accordance with Regulation 167) Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills Strong communication and report-writing ability Highly organised, able to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines Desirable Experience or exposure to Importation of unlicensed products from outside the EEA Experience in working with an ERP system Previous experience working within the medical cannabis sector Previous experience in releasing products (QC-Quality control) What we offer: Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions Private Healthcare Scheme Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave About Us At Leafio, we’re building a smarter, more resilient pharmaceutical supply chain that gives pharmacies fast and reliable access to the medicines they need, when they need them. By working directly with manufacturers and creating a more efficient wholesale model, we’re improving stock availability, simplifying distribution and helping to make medicines more affordable for patients. Everything we do is focused on creating a supply chain that is responsive, transparent and equipped to better support healthcare providers across the UK. We are an ambitious, fast-growing business with exciting plans for the future. This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact, help shape how we grow and join a team that is modernising pharmaceutical distribution from the ground up. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: Network Security Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, our team is always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - to help build a better service and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>Do you love solving complex technical problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? title: BDR Talent Programme (Amsterdam)
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the Programme This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems. You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth. High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve. What You’ll Do Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders. Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn. Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping. Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com ’s solutions with their goals. Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution. Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter. Who We’re Looking For We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success: Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals. Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output. Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders. Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success. Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter. Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance. What You’ll Get Out of It A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars: Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives. AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting. Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles. Want to Stand Out? When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive. When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027. What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications. Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai. Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director, Analytics & Business Intelligence
description: The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow. Meet Nuvei , the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration. At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey! Your Mission We are looking for a Senior Director of Analytics & Business Intelligence to join our fast-growing Revenue Operations team . title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Company Description:</strong> Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.</p> <p>As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.</p> <p></p> <p> </p></div><p></p> <p><strong>Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Amsterdam ( preferred), or London <br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead<br><strong>Role type:</strong> Full-time</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.</p> <p>This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.</p> <p>This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.</p> <p>This is a senior leadership role combining:</p> <ul> <li>Deep power systems expertise</li> <li>Top-tier strategy problem solving</li> <li>Origination and senior client leadership</li> <li>Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes</li> <li>Team leadership and platform-building</li> </ul> <p>You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.</li> <li>Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.</li> <li>Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.</li> <li>Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Change & Platform Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.</li> <li>Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.</li> <li>Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.</li> <li>Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Origination & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and mentor high-performing teams.</li> <li>Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.</li> <li>Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.</p> <p><strong>Essential Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy</li> <li>Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory</li> <li>Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.</li> <li>Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.</li> <li>Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.</li> <li>Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.</li> <li>Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.</li> <li>Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.</li> <li>Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.</li> <li>Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mindset</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.</li> <li>Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.</li> <li>Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why This Role Matters</strong></p> <p>Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.</p> <p>This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.</p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="description__body"></div> <p><strong data-start="578" data-end="603">Diversity & Inclusion</strong><br data-start="603" data-end="606">At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.</p> <p>Click <a href="https://www.systemiq.earth/privacy-policy/">here</a> to view our Data Policy.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Qui sommes-nous:</strong></p> <p><strong>Burson</strong> est le leader global de la communication créé pour générer de la valeur pour ses clients grâce à la réputation. Avec nos équipes hautement spécialisées rompues aux dernières technologies et nos capacités créatives uniques, nous aidons les marques et les entreprises à repenser leur réputation comme un avantage concurrentiel pour le présent comme pour le futur. <strong>Burson</strong> fait partie du réseau WPP, spécialiste de la transformation créative.</p> <p> </p> <p>Stage conventionné à pourvoir à partir de Janvier 2026.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Missions :</strong></p> <div> <p>Vous intégrerez l’équipe <strong>Brand & Lifestyle</strong>, composée d’une dizaine de consultant·es, et participerez à leurs côtés à l’accompagnement de clients dans la mise en œuvre de leurs stratégies de communication, de relations médias et d’influence.</p> <p>Vous serez pleinement intégré(e) aux équipes projets et contribuerez aux différentes étapes des campagnes, de la veille et la recherche d’informations jusqu’aux relations avec les journalistes et influenceurs et au suivi des actions menées.</p> <p> </p> <p>Vos missions pourront notamment inclure :</p> <ul> <li> <p>Réalisation de veilles médiatiques, sectorielles et de recherches thématiques</p> </li> <li> <p>Rédaction de communiqués de presse, invitations médias, notes de synthèse et profils de journalistes</p> </li> <li> <p>Identification et qualification de journalistes, médias et influenceurs pertinents</p> </li> <li> <p>Participation aux relations médias : diffusion de contenus, relances journalistes et suivi des retombées</p> </li> <li> <p>Participation à l’organisation d’interviews, rencontres presse et événements</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribution à la préparation de recommandations et de stratégies de communication : recherches, positionnement, messages clés et propositions d’actions</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> </div> <p><strong>Le profil que nous recherchons :</strong> Tu es en M1, M2 ou année de césure en communication, et tu as idéalement une première expérience en stage dans le domaine de la communication ou des Relations Publics. Une convention de stage est obligatoire.</p> <p>Au-delà de ton parcours, nous apprécierons particulièrement :</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Ton engagement :</strong> Impliqué.e, <a href="http://curieux.se/" target="_blank">curieux.se</a>, <a href="http://rigoureux.se/" target="_blank">rigoureux.se</a> et autonome, tu as également un fort esprit d’équipe.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Ton intérêt pour l’actualité :</strong> Tu es passionné.e par les médias et l’actualité.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Tes compétences en RP :</strong> Tu as une bonne connaissance des techniques de relations presse (relances, rédaction de communiqués de presse, shopping médias).</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Ta qualité rédactionnelle :</strong> Tu as une excellente plume.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Tes qualités relationnelles :</strong> Tu es à l’aise dans les échanges et sais créer du lien.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Ton niveau d’anglais :</strong> L’anglais lu, écrit et parlé est un atout précieux, car certaines missions peuvent être internationales.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <div class="sc-brzPDJ kmwlVI"> <div class="sc-iHInoD hRnHQL" data-is-text-too-long="true" data-is-view-more="true"> <div class="sc-OUEHq jfYLER"> <p><strong>Notre engagement :</strong></p> <p>Nous vous offrons un stage professionnalisant au sein d’une équipe dynamique et experte. Vous serez pleinement intégré(e) à la vie de l’agence et bénéficierez d’un encadrement personnalisé :</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Suivi régulier :</strong> Points d’étape avec votre tuteur/tutrice pour évaluer votre progression et définir vos objectifs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Culture du feedback :</strong> Retours constructifs sur vos missions et vos réalisations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Découverte du métier :</strong> Collaboration avec les consultants de l’équipe pour appréhender les différentes facettes de notre activité.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération et avantages :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Gratification : 750€/mois</p> </li> <li> <p>Télétravail possible et éligibilité à la prime de télétravail (10€/mois)</p> </li> <li> <p>Forfait mobilité durable (45,40€/mois)</p> </li> <li> <p>Prise en charge des repas au restaurant d’entreprise (reste à charge de 3,70€)</p> </li> <li> <p>1 jour de RTT par mois</p> </li> <li> <p>Accès aux offres du comité d’entreprise (cinéma, culture, sport…)</p> </li> <li> <p>Prime de cooptation</p> </li> <li> <p>Récupération des heures supplémentaires</p> </li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>Votre place est chez Burson :</strong></p> <p>Notre vision est de faire de Burson la référence en matière de formation pour les professionnels de la communication créative et les leaders de demain. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant où les collaborateurs motivés et ambitieux peuvent développer leurs compétences, étendre leur réseau et élaborer des stratégies innovantes pour les plus grandes marques. Notre engagement envers le développement de nos talents se traduit par des opportunités de formation, des programmes de mentorat avec des leaders du secteur, et une culture d'entreprise stimulante et inclusive qui encourage la collaboration et l'innovation. Nous avons également mis en place des programmes de reconnaissance et de fidélisation pour nos meilleurs talents. Nous investissons dans nos collaborateurs car nous sommes convaincus que leur réussite est aussi la nôtre.</p> <p>Chez Burson, nous sommes une agence d'apprenants permanents. Nous savons que l'excellence en créativité et en communication exige une compréhension fine et nuancée. C'est pourquoi nous recherchons des collaborateurs talentueux de tous horizons et de toutes cultures. Ces talents sont essentiels pour concevoir des idées audacieuses, favoriser un dialogue constructif, créer des expériences enrichissantes et stimuler l'innovation pour nos clients. Votre point de vue unique, votre talent, fait de vous une #BursonPerson.</p> <p>En cliquant sur « Soumettre la candidature », vous nous transmettez les informations saisies. Avant de le faire, veuillez consulter notre politique de confidentialité en matière <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">de recrutement. </a>Les candidats résidant <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">en Californie. </a>sont invités à consulter notre politique de confidentialité californienne pour le recrutement. Ce document détaille l'utilisation de vos données personnelles lors de votre candidature et explique comment les mettre à jour ou les supprimer.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.</p> <p>Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a <strong>Senior Technical SEO Specialist</strong> to strengthen our technical capabilities.</p> <p>This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.</p> <p>You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.</li> <li>Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.</li> <li>Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.</li> <li>Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.</li> <li>Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.</li> <li>Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.</li> <li>Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.</li> <li>Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.</li> <li>Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.</li> <li>Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The technical expertise we are looking for</strong></h3> <p>For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.</p> <p><strong>You have a strong understanding of:</strong></p> <ul> <li>HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.</li> <li>HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.</li> <li>JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.</li> <li>Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.</li> <li>Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.</li> <li>txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.</li> <li>Structured data and Schema.org.</li> <li>Core Web Vitals and web performance.</li> <li>International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.</li> <li>Website and platform migrations.</li> <li>Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.</li> </ul> <p>You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.</p> <h3>What seniority means to us</h3> <p>Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.</p> <p>We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.</p> <h3>You will also:</h3> <ul> <li>Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.</li> <li>Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.</li> <li>Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.</li> <li>Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.</li> <li>Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.</li> <li>Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.</li> <li>Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.</li> </ul> <p>Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll need:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.</li> <li>Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.</li> <li>Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.</li> <li>Strong experience working with <strong>l</strong>arge and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.</li> <li>Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.</li> <li>A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.</li> <li>An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.</li> <li>Fluent in English. description: About Morpho Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . Location: Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team). About the role: As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem. Responsibilities: Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security. Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security. Oversight of the IT function Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales. Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation. Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event. Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels. Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably. Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives. Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence. What Success Looks Like: First 30 Days You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it. You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on. You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins. You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today. First 60 Days You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it. You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire. You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them. You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion. First 90 Days Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional. A documented incident-response capability that's been validated by at least one tabletop exercise. Hiring underway, and a clear operating rhythm established with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations. Morpho's external security posture is taking shape - trust surface, counterparty security program, and ecosystem engagement - and you're recognized internally and externally as Morpho's credible security voice. Must-have Experience & Skills: 10+ years in security, several of them building or leading a security function, ideally at a crypto/web3, fintech, or financial-services company where security is core to the business. Strong grasp of the crypto/web3 threat model Proven experience building and growing a security team from a small base, recruiting across security operations and application/infrastructure security. Deep, hands-on technical expertise across cloud, infrastructure, CI/CD, supply-chain, identity, and application security - you do the work, not just direct it. Owned incident response end to end, including incident command and external communication. Sharp prioritization and the ability to galvanize action through hard and soft influence, including driving outcomes through teams you don't own. Exceptional, organized, responsive communication - credible to executives and to external audiences from fintechs to Fortune 500 institutions. Humble. Nice to Have: An established network and public profile in the security or crypto-security community, and comfort representing security work publicly (talks, writing, framework contribution). Offensive security depth, or experience standing up red/blue capabilities. Familiarity with institutional and regulatory expectations and threat-sharing networks (e.g. Crypto ISAC, TIBER-style frameworks). Taken an organization through certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent) Perks & Benefits We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning. Equal Opportunity We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Finance Manager, Financial Control & Accounting
description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 💰 Our Finance team The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management. We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently. As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A , Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) , and Procurement . This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO . ✨ Why this role is special Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies. You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on. A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone. International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands. 🎯 What you will do As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) , your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable. Your responsibilities will include: Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard; Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time; Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control; Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework; Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury; Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners , and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness; Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls , working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales. 👀 Who we're looking for Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up. Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus. Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position. International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus. Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable. Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things. AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition. Languages: Fluent French and English. 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: 💸 Top-market compensation 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent …and much more, check the full list here ! 🤝 Our hiring process Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams). Step 2 – Role-specific assessments For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. ☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. Compensation: €61.5K – €84K • €61.5K – €84K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Process Automation Engineer
description: Functieprofiel Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software). Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. Daarnaast: In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses Mogelijkheden voor remote support Geïnteresseerd!
