title: Product Manager
description: Role summary Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. Responsibilities Product vision, grounded in real user needs You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. Market scoping and opportunity-spotting Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. Logistics know-how turned into product decisions Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. The full lifecycle From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. The connective tissue across the company When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. The team you’ll join You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. Life at Bluerock We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock. 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required. Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field required. A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations , on time and within budget. Genuine ease operating cross-functionally . You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission. An appetite for ambiguity and change : a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem. Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification. Excellent leadership and team management skills , with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively. Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment Our hiring process Hit the Apply button. Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation. An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: As Optics11 continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer – Hardware Design to take ownership of the mechanical hardware development of high-performance fiber-optic measurement systems used in demanding energy and marine environments. At Optics11, we develop cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing solutions that make critical infrastructure and underwater security systems smarter, safer, and more reliable. In this role, you will design ruggedized chassis, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies that protect and integrate electronic, photonic, fiber-optic, and electromechanical subsystems. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external partners to develop robust, manufacturable, and serviceable hardware solutions that support integration, qualification, manufacturing, and long-term operation. You will apply structured engineering methods, sound technical judgement, and rigorous verification practices to ensure products perform reliably under vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and other environmental conditions. What you'll do: Lead the mechanical design and development of chassis, enclosures, mounting structures, and assemblies for fiber-optic measurement systems, from concept through qualification and release. Collaborate with electronics, photonics, optical, and systems engineering teams to define PCB placement, optical component integration, fiber routing, interconnections, thermal interfaces, and packaging constraints. Design robust hardware solutions that meet vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, environmental, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements for energy and marine applications. Develop modular, maintainable, and upgradeable hardware architectures that support manufacturability, serviceability, and long-term product support. Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, design calculations, assembly instructions, and manufacturing documentation. Manage technical collaboration with suppliers, manufacturers, OEMs, and external development partners to ensure performance, quality, manufacturability, and qualification requirements are met. Support prototype development, subsystem integration, environmental and mechanical testing, product qualification, and release activities. Analyze test results, performance margins, failure modes, and operational limits to improve product robustness, reliability, and design maturity. Apply engineering analyses, trade-off studies, DfMA principles, simulation tools, and FEA to optimize mechanical, thermal, structural, dynamic, manufacturability, lifecycle, and cost performance. Investigate qualification failures, manufacturing issues, integration challenges, and field performance topics using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis. Provide technical input during design reviews, engineering discussions, development decisions, and cross-functional integration activities. Plan and execute work in line with priorities, milestones, quality expectations, and timelines, while proactively communicating risks, dependencies, and recommendations. Share expertise, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability, collaboration, product quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided3 times/ week. Qualifications: MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline with a focus on mechanical design of opto-electronic, electronic, photonic, or other high-tech hardware products. 5+ years of experience in multidisciplinary product development environments. Strong experience designing chassis, enclosures, hardware packaging solutions, and mechanical assemblies for high-performance products. Proven track record in developing ruggedized opto-electronic hardware products from concept through qualification and release. Strong understanding of vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and environmental requirements for demanding operational environments. Experience with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar. Experience creating engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation. Strong analytical mindset with experience in structured problem solving and engineering verification. Strong communication skills in English and collaborative working style. Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance. Nice to have: Experience with fiber-optic integration, optical component packaging, or photonic hardware development. Experience with CE/FCC, MIL, NATO, and/or STANAG qualification standards. Experience with ruggedized chassis standards used in defense, marine, aerospace, or industrial applications (e.g. VPX, CompactPCI, uTCA). Experience managing external suppliers, manufacturers, and development partners. Experience supporting environmental qualification, certification, or product compliance programs. Please note that we can only consider candidates who are currently residing in the Netherlands and already have the legal right to work here without requiring visa sponsorship or a work permit. title: Senior Project Manager (Subsea)

You will be responsible for keeping projects on track, managing expectations, identifying risks early and ensuring successful delivery within scope, time and budget. This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong technical background, hands-on project management experience and exposure to offshore or subsea environments such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or related activities. You will join a growing scale-up environment where processes are still evolving, and where your experience can directly contribute to how we mature our project management approach. What you’ll do: Lead multidisciplinary projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope and within budget. Act as the main point of contact for customers, partners and internal stakeholders. Manage projects related to offshore, subsea or marine operations, such as subsea cable installation, geotechnical monitoring, marine surveys or similar activities. Coordinate closely with R&D, engineering, production, commercial and other internal teams to ensure successful project execution. Translate technical requirements into clear project deliverables, timelines and actions. Identify project risks early and implement mitigation plans to protect delivery, quality and customer expectations. Monitor project progress, budget, planning, scope and key milestones. Support bid development, technical discussions and customer relationship management where needed. Contribute to improving project management processes, tools and ways of working in a scaling organization. Capture lessons learned, share knowledge and support others in building strong project delivery practices. What’s in it for you Work on products that are deployed in real-world, high-impact environments, not just concepts or internal tools Operate in a fast-growing, international scale-up where you can truly influence how projects are run. Regular team activities and shared lunches throughout the week. What we’re looking for: MSc degree in Engineering, Physics, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology or another relevant technical discipline. Around 5–8 years of relevant project management experience in a technical environment. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer bij BigData Republic combineer je diepgaande technische expertise met consultancy. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren. Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen. Wat ga je doen? Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie. Je; analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen; adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes; ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen; ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen; bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen; werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability; werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers; helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau; draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic. De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning. Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten. Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere; Python Airflow Apache Spark Kafka Docker Tensorflow Pytorch Kubernetes Terraform AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. We zoeken daarom geen engineer die simpelweg zoveel mogelijk tools kent, maar een ervaren professional die begrijpt welke technische oplossing in welke situatie passend is en waarom. Je werkt aan complexe data-, AI- en machine-learningvraagstukken voor grote organisaties in verschillende sectoren. Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een klein, informeel en inhoudelijk gedreven team van ervaren Machine Learning Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers en Data Scientists. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele onderdelen van BigData Republic. We organiseren iedere vrijdag kennissessies op kantoor, schrijven inhoudelijke artikelen, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je eigen expertise verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd collega's en klanten verder te helpen. Dit is nadrukkelijk een senior consultancyrol. Om succesvol te kunnen zijn in deze functie zoeken we iemand die beschikt over: minimaal 6 jaar relevante professionele werkervaring binnen software engineering, data engineering, data science en/of machine learning; minimaal 3 jaar hands-on professionele ervaring met machine learning, waarbij je aantoonbaar ML-oplossingen naar productie hebt gebracht en beheerd, verbeterd of opgeschaald; ervaring met het zelfstandig analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en het adviseren van klanten en stakeholders over oplossingen, architectuur en technische keuzes; ruime professionele programmeerervaring met Python; gedegen kennis van software-engineeringprincipes en ervaring met het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen; ervaring met minimaal één grote cloudomgeving: AWS, Azure en/of GCP; ervaring met MLOps, waaronder deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, observability en schaalbaarheid; academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied; uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (minimaal C1) en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat. Wat je gaat doen Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere: Data Engineering & AI Machine Learning Java Development Kubernetes & Cloud Native Cloud & Platform Engineering Front-end Development Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding. Concreet betekent dit dat je: actief technische professionals sourcet en benadert, onder andere via LinkedIn Recruiter en andere sourcingkanalen; zelfstandig searches en sourcingstrategieën ontwikkelt voor moeilijk vindbare doelgroepen; kandidaten screent op ervaring, technische context, motivatie en consultancy-fit; hiring managers adviseert over doelgroep, haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, selectiecriteria en recruitmentaanpak; kandidaten gedurende het volledige proces begeleidt en zorgt voor een professionele en persoonlijke candidate experience; interview- en selectieprocessen bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt; talentpools opbouwt en relaties onderhoudt met relevante professionals; data en recruitmentinzichten gebruikt om keuzes en prioriteiten te onderbouwen; externe recruitmentpartners inzet wanneer dit aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt; kansen signaleert om recruitment slimmer, sneller en effectiever te organiseren. Ongeveer 85% van je tijd ben je bezig met recruitment en sourcing. De overige tijd gebruik je om recruitment verder te professionaliseren, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van tooling, data, processen, arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, AI of nieuwe sourcingmethoden. Je bent daarmee niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor vacatures, maar mede-eigenaar van hoe recruitment binnen Conflux wordt uitgevoerd en ontwikkeld. We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren tech recruiter die zelfstandig kan opereren in een markt waarin kandidaten schaars zijn en actief gevonden en overtuigd moeten worden. Dit breng je mee Minimaal 6 jaar professionele recruitmentervaring. Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met IT- of tech recruitment. Ervaring met het zelfstandig werven van ervaren of senior technische professionals. Aantoonbare ervaring met active sourcing en direct search. Je weet hoe je een technische doelgroep analyseert en vertaalt naar een effectieve search- en benaderingsstrategie. Je kunt inhoudelijk voldoende meepraten over technische rollen en begrijpt het verschil tussen bijvoorbeeld software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, cloud en platform engineering. Je bent ervaren met LinkedIn Recruiter en weet dat goede sourcing verder gaat dan alleen LinkedIn. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor hiring managers en durft recruitmentvraagstukken kritisch te benaderen. Je kunt zelfstandig prioriteiten bepalen en meerdere complexe vacatures tegelijkertijd managen. Je combineert snelheid met kwaliteit en houdt grip op voortgang en candidate experience. Je spreekt en schrijft professioneel Nederlands en Engels. Ervaring met recruitment binnen tech consultancy, IT-dienstverlening, detachering of een vergelijkbare kennisintensieve omgeving is van toegevoegde waarde. Wie jij bent Je hebt weinig dagelijkse aansturing nodig. Je ziet waar recruitment stagneert, onderzoekt waarom en komt met oplossingen. Je wacht niet alleen op sollicitanten, maar gaat zelf de markt in. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe sourcingmethoden, tooling en technologie en experimenteert graag met manieren om moeilijk bereikbare kandidaten toch te vinden. Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat recruitment uiteindelijk draait om mensen. Je bouwt relaties op, communiceert duidelijk en zorgt ervoor dat kandidaten ook bij een afwijzing een professionele ervaring hebben. Waarom Conflux? Je komt terecht in een organisatie waarin recruitment dicht op de business zit. De lijnen met hiring managers en directie zijn kort en er is ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise invloed uit te oefenen op hoe we recruitment organiseren. Je krijgt: veel zelfstandigheid en vertrouwen; directe invloed op recruitmentstrategie en sourcing; ruimte om nieuwe sourcingmethoden en tooling te introduceren; inhoudelijk sterke collega's binnen verschillende technische disciplines; korte lijnen met hiring managers en directie; ruimte om recruitmentprocessen daadwerkelijk te verbeteren. Wat we bieden Een salaris van €4.600 tot €5.900 bruto per maand op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van ervaring. Vakantiegeld ter hoogte van 8% Een bonusregeling op basis van persoonlijke en bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, inzetbaar voor bijvoorbeeld een elektrische auto, declaraties of bruto uitbetaling. Een maandelijkse pensioenbijdrage. Een dienstverband van minimaal 32 uur per week, met voorkeur voor 36 of 40 uur. Laptop en telefoon. Regelmatig gezamenlijke activiteiten en evenementen. Een hybride werkomgeving met kantoor in Utrecht. We werken flexibel, maar recruitment is bij Conflux nadrukkelijk een vak waarbij relaties belangrijk zijn. Daarom verwachten we dat je regelmatig op kantoor in Utrecht aanwezig bent om nauw samen te werken met hiring managers, consultants en collega's. Proces We maken graag kennis met je. Daarbij kijken we niet alleen of jij bij Conflux past, maar ook of Conflux aansluit bij de manier waarop jij recruitment wilt bedrijven. Je solliciteert met je cv. In het eerste gesprek maak je kennis met de recruiters met wie je gaat samenwerken. We bespreken daarbij nadrukkelijk je ervaring met tech recruitment, sourcing en stakeholdermanagement. In het tweede gesprek ontmoet je de directie en gaan we verder in op wederzijdse verwachtingen en jouw visie op recruitment. Zijn we daarna allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een aanbieding en kun je samen met ons verder bouwen aan recruitment binnen Conflux. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Recruiter
description: Wij zoeken geen recruiter die wacht op sollicitaties. adesso Nederland groeit. En de mensen die wij zoeken, zijn meestal niet actief op zoek naar een nieuwe baan. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst. Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie. Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen. En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën. Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden. Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je pakt hem. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management. Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel. Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert. Je doet het ook zelf. Je: voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals; bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat; benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken; experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen; voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken; adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie; voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire; houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat; gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt; komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken; denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities; bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek. We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen: “Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.” En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren. Wanneer ben je voor ons senior? Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat. Wat jij doet Als Data Engineer benut je geavanceerde Business Intelligence-tools om data uit diverse bronnen te ontsluiten en in een krachtig 'data warehouse' te transformeren. Hiermee leg je het fundament voor geavanceerde analyses en rapportages die cruciaal zijn voor strategische besluitvorming en operationele optimalisatie. Jouw missie is het verbinden, organiseren en ontsluiten van gegevens op een manier die Centric en onze klanten een voorsprong geeft. Hoe doe je dat? Door het doel van de klant voorop te zetten én te scoren. Het is jouw passie voor data en jouw drive om bedrijven te helpen slagen in het tijdperk van datagedreven besluitvorming. Je bent geen gewone data engineer, je bent een visionair, een probleemoplosser en een pionier in data-intelligentie. Bij Centric krijg je de kans om je talenten te benutten, te groeien en te werken aan inspirerende projecten voor diverse toonaangevende organisaties. Wat doe je nog meer? title: Stage: Marketing Retail en Logistiek
description: Wat jij doet Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen meekijken, maar echt bijdragen aan commerciële groei, slimme marketing en innovatieve AI-toepassingen? title: Senior Information Security Officer (ISO)

title: Senior Claimbehandelaar Schadeverzekeringen
description: IG&H groeit hard. Daarom zoeken wij een Senior claimbehandelaar schadeverzekeringen die vanuit diepgaande praktijkervaring in schadeverzekeringen wil bijdragen aan de toekomst van de Nederlandse verzekeringssector. Heb jij minimaal 10 jaar ervaring als Claimsbehandelaar of Schadebehandelaar en weet jij precies waar schadeprocessen slimmer, sneller en klantgerichter kunnen? Dan is dit jouw rol. Als Senior Business Analist Schade combineer je jouw inhoudelijke expertise met de kracht van strategie, technologie, data en AI. Je werkt samen met verzekeraars, product owners, consultants en softwareontwikkelaars aan oplossingen die het schadevak daadwerkelijk verbeteren. Je hoeft geen traditionele IT’er of business analist te zijn. Juist jouw ervaring uit de praktijk maakt het verschil. Jij weet wat er op de werkvloer gebeurt, waar processen vastlopen en welke oplossingen in de praktijk wel – en vooral niet – werken. Waarom deze rol belangrijk is? De Nederlandse verzekeringsmarkt is volop in beweging. Verzekeraars staan voor de uitdaging om schadeprocessen efficiënter, klantgerichter en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Digitalisering, data en AI bieden daarbij grote kansen, maar alleen als technologie aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk van schadebehandeling. In de praktijk gaat het onder andere om vraagstukken rondom: optimalisatie van het schadeproces van eerste melding tot uitkering; digitalisering en automatisering van schadebehandeling; verbeteren van klantbediening en medewerkerervaring; toepassing van data en AI in schadeprocessen; STP en geautomatiseerde afhandeling waar dit mogelijk is; inrichting van toekomstbestendige processen en systemen; het slimmer ondersteunen van schadebehandelaars bij complexe dossiers. IG&H werkt samen met toonaangevende verzekeraars aan deze vraagstukken. Als Senior Business Analist Schade ben jij de verbindende factor tussen de praktijk van schadebehandeling en de technologie die deze praktijk toekomstbestendig maakt. Wat ga je doen? In deze rol werk je aan uiteenlopende opdrachten bij verzekeraars en opereer je op het snijvlak van business, processen en IT. Je gebruikt jouw ervaring uit de schadepraktijk om complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen. Vertalen van praktijkervaring en klantbehoeften naar concrete requirements en oplossingen. Meedenken over de inrichting van toekomstbestendige schadeprocessen. Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het Symbria -platform. Workshops & Stakeholdermanagement Begeleiden van workshops en werksessies bij verzekeraars. Ophalen en structureren van wensen en behoeften van verschillende stakeholders. Schakelen tussen schadebehandelaars, managers, product owners, consultants en softwareontwikkelaars. Complexe inhoud begrijpelijk maken voor verschillende doelgroepen. Creëren van draagvlak voor nieuwe processen, werkwijzen en technologische oplossingen. Technologie, Data & AI Onderzoeken hoe technologie het schadeproces slimmer en efficiënter kan maken. Meedenken over toepassingen van AI en automatisering binnen schadebehandeling. Identificeren van kansen om repetitieve werkzaamheden te automatiseren. Samenwerken met product- en developmentteams om oplossingen vanuit de praktijk vorm te geven. Bijdragen aan de verdere digitalisering van de schadeverzekeringsketen. Thought Leadership & Marktontwikkeling Inbrengen van jouw inhoudelijke expertise in klantvraagstukken en proposities. Ontwikkelen van visie op de toekomst van schadebehandeling. Bijdragen aan thought leadership binnen het schadevak. Signaleren van ontwikkelingen en innovaties die relevant zijn voor verzekeraars. Samen met collega's verder bouwen aan de positie van IG&H binnen de schadeverzekeringsmarkt. Wat breng je mee? Diepgaande kennis van schadeprocessen en de dagelijkse praktijk van schadebehandeling. Ervaring met complexe schadedossiers en inzicht in de uitdagingen van schadeorganisaties. Affiniteit met procesverbetering, digitalisering en innovatie. Een goed begrip van de mogelijkheden van technologie, data en AI binnen het schadevak. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? description: <h2><strong>About Decathlon</strong></h2> <p>Decathlon aims to become the best sports digital platform and open ecosystem in the world. We want to enable customers to experience Decathlon through many local sport-centric experiences by connecting many third-party actors and services, in a secure and performant way.</p> <p>Our digital teams in Lille, Paris (and more…) which bring together more than 5000 collaborators are united to build and scale digital products with the aim to always deliver the best value to our users. With a presence in more than 70 countries, Decathlon is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.</p> <h3><strong>Job Description</strong></h3> <p>Our PRISM (Supply Chain) is looking for an AI Engineer based in Paris. As an AI Engineer dedicated to agent deployment, you will be at the heart of a tight-knit technical team. Your will play a critical role in the industrialization, deployment and monitoring of our Agent capabilities. You will closely work with digital teams (Data, Product, Engineering) to architect the deployment infrastructure, design intelligence routing, and build secure infrastructure allowing our agents to interact natively with our corporate data and legacy systems.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and deploy solid foundations that will allow our AI agents to be hosted, run, and interact smoothly with our systems during production release.</li> <li>Design robust pipelines enabling multi-step asynchronous agentic execution (e.g., transactional ingestion and writing flows), by implementing distributed resilience patterns.</li> <li>Integrate agentic orchestration SDKs (notably Google Vertex AI Agent SDK / ADK), bypassing "black box" limitations of managed frameworks.</li> <li>Efficiently orchestrate agents in production while ensuring proper information processing, routing to the most suitable models, and guaranteeing optimal cost and token usage management. Also ensure quality and speed of task execution.</li> <li>Strictly define the scope of action for each agent. You guarantee they only access data and actions for which they are formally authorized, respecting our confidentiality rules, while ensuring data security.</li> <li>Build advanced performance measurement and tracking pipelines to trace agent reflections and decisions from end to end in order to debug logic in production.</li> <li>Work with the team to define relevant and consistent data evaluation metrics relative to the defined functional specificities and metrics.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Hard Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Robust backend design (Python), operational mastery of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and pipelines (CI/CD, automated testing, observability, log management) to ensure robust production releases.</li> <li>Production-focused Python expertise, mastery of deployment platforms (Vertex AI Agent Builder, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) and client/server integration protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).</li> <li>Experience optimizing context windows for massive frontier models. Request routing to models suitable for the selected solutions.</li> <li>Ability to build test frameworks for LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, Golden Datasets), mastery of deterministic metrics and strict validation of output formats (JSON schema enforcement).</li> <li>Practical experience with Agentic RAG, <em>Semantic Caching</em> to reduce latency and API costs, or using prompt optimization frameworks (e.g., DSPy)</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Applied experience in supply chain, retail technology, or model deployment via Databricks / MLFlow</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Soft Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills.</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.</li> <li>Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies and share them.</li> <li>Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable terms for non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Ability to understand user challenges and associated needs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Senior Profile: You have solid experience (Machine Learning Engineering) with a strong focus on production infrastructure release.</li> <li>Ability to leverage managed solutions (Vertex AI) while knowing how to "dive into code" to debug distributed architectures, develop custom connectors, and bypass framework limitations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to evolve in shifting technical environments.</li> <li>Operational skills on GCP and understanding of containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) to autonomously deploy the Agentic layer.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Technical Environment</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Agent orchestration: </strong>Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI Agent Builder</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure & Cloud:</strong> GCP (Google Cloud Platform), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines.</li> <li><strong>AI & Integration Protocols:</strong> Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMs (Gemini), LLM routing & memory management.</li> <li><strong>Security & Access:</strong> Google Cloud Model Armor.</li> <li><strong>Execution Engine:</strong> Databricks, AWS EKS, Sagemaker</li> <li><strong>Payload</strong>: Python, Spark, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow / Pytorch, Pyspark </li> <li><strong>CICD: </strong>Github Actions</li> <li><strong>Serving: </strong>Docker, Protobuf, gRPC</li> <li><strong>Model registry, Model Tracking</strong>: MLFlow</li> <li><strong>Orchestration:</strong>  Airflow</li> <li><strong>Documentation / code:</strong> Git, Confluence </li> <li><strong>Data Visualisation:</strong> Tableau</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Flexibility in work organization (location, pace)</li> <li>Freedom of choice of work tool (Mac, Windows)</li> <li>Upgrading of skills (diversity of projects, languages and technologies)</li> <li>Internal and external training courses</li> <li>Shareholders</li> <li>Remote Friendly: 2 days/week</li> <li>Monthly and quarterly premiums</li> </ul> <p>Joining Decathlon means being part of a dynamic team passionate about sports, innovation, and making a positive impact on the lives of our customers. If you are enthusiastic about leveraging data science to optimize supply chain processes and drive business growth, we invite you to apply and be a part of our journey!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><strong>DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT </strong></p> <p>What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.</p> <p><br><strong>Changing the game for good</strong>. We are in this for the love of sports. And like everything we love, we want it to last. That’s why we are embarking on a journey to create a more sustainable tech model, reducing our direct environmental impact while maintaining a safe, diverse, and inclusive space for all our people to learn and thrive together. Team up with us to design the digital future of sports.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success About the job Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain. You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes. As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week. Why Now, Why Mirakl Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis. At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption. We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide. You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it. What You'll Do 1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain 2. Lead AI System Development Design and build production-grade AI systems Drive architecture decisions Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability 3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact Work closely with end users Measure adoption and outcomes Accelerate AI transformation across your domain 4. Establish Technical Excellence Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability Review designs and mentor engineers Raise the quality bar across initiatives 5. Grow AI Capability Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders Share knowledge and reusable components Build AI expertise within your organization Success Metrics Business impact delivered by AI initiatives Adoption within the domain Technical quality and reliability Team capability growth Our stack and tools Languages: Python and SQL AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes You'll Love This Job If you have 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems Ability to influence Product and Business decisions Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on! This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return. An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects. 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture. title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)
description: Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées À propos de l'opportunité Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants. En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp. Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Ce que nous recherchons Indispensable Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer. Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Atouts Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp. Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème. Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans. Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois. Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales. Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer. Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Formation et accompagnement Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. title: Logistics Operations Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>You will work closely with Cloudflare's Infrastructure team as well as with external vendors and partners to support the rapid growth and maintenance of our data center infrastructure. You will be responsible for coordinating the distribution and delivery of data center hardware to and from our data centers within the region. You will participate in the development and implementation of consistent processes and performance measurements, utilizing business intelligence and AI tools.</p> <p>You will support the team globally on infrastructure projects such as data center expansions, hardware renewals, reverse logistics and spare parts fulfillment. </p> <p>This is a role that requires understanding of warehousing, transportation, and requires experience with data analysis and AI tools. You will support our partners within a complex and fast moving global supply chain.</p> <p>This is a highly collaborative position that will require coordinating with:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Warehousing providers, freight forwarders, importer of record partners, customs brokers and data center partners to plan and execute on the delivery of data center hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>External vendors including hardware manufacturers, rack integrators and contract vendors, across time zones, in support of our 200+ and growing data center locations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Internal teams such as Data Center Engineering, Capacity Planning, Trade Compliance, Hardware Sourcing, and Procurement.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Post-secondary degree in a technical or business management field.</p> </li> <li> <p>A minimum of 3 years of experience working with global supply chains and logistics is necessary.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to be proactive with ability to learn fast and execute on multiple tasks simultaneously.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to recognize areas for improvements in operational processes in a rapidly changing environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Python, LLM usage and AI tooling experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Possess strong verbal and written communication skills, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Desirable, but not required:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience supporting data centers or other Networking/IT hardware and infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Multi-lingual, preferably in Spanish.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>You will report to the Senior Director, Head of Market Access, EU West Region and work closely with Medical affairs, Market Access, Commercial locally and globally, to support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic rare diseases.</p> <p>You will own the value demonstration strategy for our products across the region, and translate it into effective patient access: design each product's evidence generation plan, drive it through to delivery, and align it with pricing and access strategy, starting in France, then extending to the other countries of the EU West region</p> <p>Your main responsibilities include:</p> <p><strong>Evidence generation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and lead natural history studies, cohorts, registries, and analyses of medico-administrative databases (SNDS, BNDMR/ BaMaRa, rare disease network registries)</li> <li>Lead indirect comparisons in the context of single-arm trials and very small patient populations</li> <li>Develop health economic models (cost-effectiveness, budget impact) for France, then for other markets in the region</li> <li>Design real-world data collection frameworks (PUT-RD / data collection protocols) that can be reused for reassessment and in other countries</li> <li>Define the scientific publication and communication plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Study management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Draft specifications, run tenders, and select vendors</li> <li>Convene and lead external scientific advisory committees</li> <li>Secure all required approvals (health data access, ethics committees, regulatory compliance)</li> <li>Manage the administrative, contractual, and budgetary aspects of studies</li> <li>Review and validate all deliverables (protocols, analysis plans, study reports, publications)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Value communication and internal expertise</strong></p> <ul> <li>Translate study results into actionable clinical and economic arguments</li> <li>Drive scientific dissemination (congresses, publications)</li> <li>Serve as the internal reference point on epidemiology, health economics, and health data matters</li> <li>Build and maintain a network of research agencies, academics, and institutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Value and access strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the value demonstration strategy for each product across the region</li> <li>Build economic value propositions and value dossiers and ensure their local adaptation</li> <li>Contribute to pricing strategy and preparation for CEPS negotiations (e.g., positive externalities, budget impact)</li> <li>Coordinate and build the economic modelling and CEESP dossier (early scientific advice, modelling, CEESP submission, technical exchange, etc.)</li> <li>Contribute the health-economic and RWE content of early access dossiers and submissions to the Transparency Committee, in coordination with the Market Access Director, with progressively increasing ownership of Benelux dossiers</li> <li>Anticipate assessors' objections and build responses ahead of submission</li> </ul> <p><strong>French rare disease ecosystem</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build working relationships with rare disease networks, reference and competence centres, patient associations, and learned societies</li> <li>Negotiate collaborations with existing registries and cohorts</li> <li>Contribute to documenting the patient journey and disease burden</li> </ul> <p><strong>Function leadership and development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and arbitrate the region's HEOR and RWE budget</li> <li>Structure the function (methods, quality standards, vendor panel, review processes)</li> <li>Recruit and manage future team members</li> <li>Represent the region to global HEOR and Market Access teams</li> </ul> <p>The above list of tasks is not exhaustive.</p> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>This is a France-based role</li> <li>Travel within France, a priority country, is expected, as is travel to our international office in Zug, Switzerland, for team alignment and engagement.</li> <li>Travel to other countries in the EU West region may also be required. Local team meetings and the designated office location in France are in the Paris area.</li> </ul> <h3><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><span class="TextRun Underlined SCXW398674 BCX0" lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW398674 BCX0">Who You Are</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW398674 BCX0" class="List-kOVW5V UnorderedList-nqKD7g"> <li class="ListItem-ncLgmg">7–10 years of experience in HEOR, real-world evidence (RWE), or market access within industry, biotech, or specialized consulting</li> <li class="ListItem-ncLgmg">Direct, hands-on experience completing French market access dossiers, including submissions to the Transparency Committee, early access applications, and title: Senior Value Engineer - Supply Chain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p>The position of the <strong>Senior Value Engineer</strong> is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: </strong>Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of <strong>Python</strong> and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.</p> <p><strong>Process Improvement & Value Realization: </strong>Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value</p> <p><strong>Project Management: </strong>Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.</p> <p><strong>Executive Stakeholder Management: </strong>Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul title: Network Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: </strong>Singapore or Tokyo, Japan</h3> <h3><strong>This position is open to experienced candidates, as well as fresh graduates who will be graduating in December 2026 or Jan 2027.</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Network Security Engineer</strong> to join our team and support our largest and most technically sophisticated customers in resolving technical problems, threats or attacks on their infrastructure at OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7. Spectrum and Rate Limiting to help customers.</p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor for our enterprise customers, responding to and resolving inquiries and incidents related to network security and performance, while delivering timely, high-quality and personalized assistance.</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving DDoS mitigation, firewall rules, SSL/TLS, network confirmation, and other security configurations.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Compare traffic signatures and attributes including IP addresses, cookie variations, HTTP headers, and JavaScript footprints to determine what is good traffic and what is malicious</li> <li>DDoS mitigation for OSI layers 3,4, & 7: advise customers on how to filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare tools like Magic Transit, Network Firewall, WAF, IP reputation lists, packet inspection, blocklisting, allowlisting, and rate limiting</li> <li>Work with Engineering and Product teams to improve products and tools</li> <li>Utilize generative AI and automation tools to streamline log analysis, accelerate root-cause analysis during security incidents, and optimize customer response times.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have a minimum of 4 years experience working as a Network Security Engineer / Technical Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of network protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, and BGP, with a particular focus on anycast routing concepts and implementation, as well as tools such as iptables and looking glass.</li> <li>Proven experience troubleshooting network connectivity issues, BGP routing, and GRE tunnels, and performing packet capture analysis</li> <li>Confident with command line and tools, including curl, dig, traceroute, openssl, git</li> <li>Experience in a web development and / or hosting environment such as installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, Caddy and IIS.</li> <li>You are competent at writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript or other scripting languages.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, and other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> <li>Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIA GCIH, GCFA, GCFE or equivalent.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations. Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. Requirements What You’ll Do Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision. As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it. In general you will: use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation; use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure; participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance; Are You the team member we are looking for? In order to be successful in this role, you are/have: motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering comfortable interacting with technical and business people strong communication and presentation skills recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major; familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git) familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s) fluent in both English and German available for a minimum of 32h a week. ready to start on the 1st of February Benefits What We Offer Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different and provides unique opportunities to learn. Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts ( https://github.com/unit8co/darts ) Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers. Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor 15 paid days of holiday Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities. up to 10% of paid time for self-development. Flexible working hours, including some home office. Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites. If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position.
