title: Senior Customer Engineer (Pre-sales), East China
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Beijing, China </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.</p> <p>Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, utilizing AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation:</strong> Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, build bespoke architectures, and deliver compelling product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) across Cloudflare’s portfolio (Security, Networking, Zero Trust and Developer Platforms).</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory:</strong> Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Alignment:</strong> Own the long-term technical relationship across the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring continuous alignment between the customer’s evolving business goals and our product roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion:</strong> Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. You will be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation:</strong> Act as an "AI-Augmented" engineer. Leverage AI agents and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, and basic telemetry monitoring, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer.</li> <li><strong>Technical Acumen:</strong> Broad technical expertise spanning web security, networking (routing, DNS, DDoS mitigation), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Mindset:</strong> Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Cloudflare Developer Stack Experience:</strong> Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting solutions using Cloudflare's developer platform and AI ecosystem, specifically Workers AI and AI Gateway.</li> <li><strong>Applied AI Knowledge:</strong> Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.</li> <li><strong>Coding/Scripting:</strong> Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong> This role features a competitive base salary and a variable commission structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: <h1><strong>Product Manager – Innovation & Design</strong></h1> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Location: Paris (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong>Imaginez et construisez des produits qui répondent aux vrais besoins des utilisateurs et transforment durablement les services financiers.</strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"> </p> <p>Capco recherche des <strong>Product Managers</strong> pour accompagner les acteurs majeurs des services financiers et de l'énergie dans la conception de produits utiles à leurs clients et créateurs de valeur pour leur organisation.</p> <p>Au sein de notre capability <strong>Tech, Product & Engineering</strong>, vous intégrerez des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant Product Managers, ingénieurs, développeurs et experts métiers.</p> <p>Votre rôle sera de comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs, identifier les bonnes problématiques à résoudre et transformer ces insights en produits simples, viables et performants.</p> <p>Vous intégrerez également de manière pragmatique les outils d’IA et d’automatisation approuvés dans vos méthodes de travail pour accélérer la recherche, l’analyse et l’expérimentation, tout en conservant le jugement humain au cœur des décisions produit.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Travailler avec des équipes produit pluridisciplinaires pour identifier les problématiques utilisateurs prioritaires et concevoir des solutions à la fois désirables, viables et techniquement réalisables.</li> <li>Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et de la recherche utilisateur jusqu’au lancement, à la mesure de la performance et à l’optimisation continue.</li> <li>Combiner études de marché, recherche qualitative, données quantitatives et comportements observés pour construire une compréhension structurée des utilisateurs<strong> </strong>et exploiter, lorsque pertinent, des outils d’IA approuvés pour accélérer l’analyse et faire émerger des insights.</li> <li>Intégrer les contraintes propres aux services financiers – réglementation, risques et contrôles, protection des données et viabilité économique – dans les décisions produit.</li> <li>Piloter le produit par les résultats et la valeur créée pour les utilisateurs et le business, en testant différentes approches plutôt qu’en vous concentrant uniquement sur la production de livrables.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compétences et expériences désirées </strong> </p> <ul> <li>Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en Product Management, acquise au sein d’une entreprise technologique ou d’un cabinet de conseil.</li> <li>Une expérience avérée dans la discovery, la conception et le développement de produits de bout en bout, idéalement sur des expériences web et mobiles.</li> <li>Une bonne maîtrise des méthodologies produit – Jobs-to-be-Done, personas, frameworks de priorisation, KANO, Lean Startup – et des méthodes de delivery Agile.</li> <li>Une capacité démontrée à collaborer avec des designers, ingénieurs/développeurs, équipes métiers et parties prenantes, ainsi qu’à traiter des problématiques complexes à partir de données et d'insights structurés.</li> <li>Une bonne connaissance de la banque et des services financiers, associée à une curiosité pour les usages de l’IA et des workflows AI-enabled permettant d'améliorer la qualité, la rapidité ou la pertinence du travail produit, dans un cadre responsable et avec validation humaine.</li> <li>Vous êtes à l’aise pour travailler en français et en anglais dans des environnements internationaux. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi rejoindre Capco?</strong></p> <p>Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.<br>Fondé en 1998, le cabinet compte aujourd’hui plus de 7 000 collaborateurs dans 36 bureaux à travers le monde, dont 160 à Paris. </p> <p>Challenger reconnu face aux grands noms du conseil, Capco se distingue par sa double expertise métier et technologique, au service de la stratégie comme de l’exécution.</p> <p><strong>Notre promesse : accompagner la transformation de nos clients dans un monde en constante mutation – réglementaire, technologique et opérationnel.</strong></p> <p>Nous intervenons à l’intersection du business, de la réglementation et de la tech, en mobilisant des équipes pluridisciplinaires, expérimentées et engagées.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Nos marqueurs distinctifs :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Une spécialisation sectorielle forte</strong><br>Nous apportons à nos clients une compréhension approfondie de leurs enjeux métiers, en particulier dans la banque, les marchés de capitaux et l’énergie.</li> <li><strong>Une approche collaborative et sur mesure</strong><br>Nous intégrons les équipes clients, adaptons nos méthodes à leur culture et co-construisons des solutions concrètes et opérationnelles.</li> <li><strong>L’excellence comme exigence</strong><br>Notre ambition est d’obtenir des résultats mesurables et durables pour nos clients – et de toujours viser la valeur ajoutée.</li> <li><strong>Un esprit “One Capco”</strong><br>Nos équipes collaborent à l’échelle internationale pour mobiliser les meilleures expertises et partager les bonnes pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Une culture entrepreneuriale et inclusive</strong><br>L’innovation, l’initiative et le mérite sont au cœur de notre modèle. Nous valorisons les idées, la diversité et le progrès collectif.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Nos expertises s’articulent autour de 6 métiers complémentaires</strong></p> <ol> <li>Stratégie & Transformation</li> <li>Finance, Risque & Conformité</li> <li>Product, Innovation & Design</li> <li>Data & Analytics</li> <li>Conseil Tech (Advisory)</li> <li>Engineering (Delivery)</li> </ol> <p> </p> <p><strong>Chez Capco, nous vous offrons :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Un environnement de travail international centré sur l’innovation et la création de valeur pour nos clients bancaires et assuranciels</li> <li>Un parcours de formation continu adapté à vos besoins, pour acquérir de nouvelles compétences et développer une réelle expertise</li> <li>Une organisation de travail hybride (charte télétravail de 2 jours par semaine)</li> <li>Une rémunération compétitive avec un bonus lié à la performance</li> <li>Un PEE avec un abondement de 2903€ par an</li> <li>Une culture d’entreprise entrepreneuriale, inclusive et méritocratique, de nouveau certifiée Great Place To Work</li> <li>Des initiatives pour construire le Capco de demain :</li> <ul> <li>#BeYourselfAtWork</li> <li>Woman@capco</li> <li>RSE (forfait mobilité durable, jour de solidarité, etc.)</li> <li>Des communautés métiers, sportives et culturelles</li> </ul> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Chez Capco Paris, handicap visible ou invisible, parcours atypique ou classique, toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues et seront traitées avec équité.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Analyst, France & Netherlands (12 Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><em>Please note this is a hybrid position from our Paris office. Please submit your CV in English.</em></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></span></p> <p>The Global Markets Strategic Finance & Analytics team provides budget oversight, reporting, strategic planning and analytical decision making support to the Global Markets team and in-region business teams across EMEA. In addition this team supports identifying and pursuing opportunities to drive growth and business impact for our international business.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>The Difference You Will Make</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>While your formal reporting structure is into the Director, Strategic Finance & Analytics, EMEA, on a day-to-day basis you will work closely with the cross-functional team that is based in-region. </li> <li>You will directly support Country Managers (and their teams) based around EMEA to drive clear reporting, produce actionable insight, track core KPIs, evaluate investment decisions and work cross-functionally to develop strategies to solve problems.</li> <li>The individual is expected to be a strong cross-functional business partner who has a combination of hands-on analytical skills, financial modelling expertise, commercial acumen, and the ability to package their insights into strong narratives appropriate for senior executive consumption. They will be comfortable working in cross functional teams based in EMEA and around the world including Finance & Accounting, Business Operations, Data Science, Marketing, Product and Supply.</li> <li>The ideal candidate relishes the opportunity to roll up their sleeves to drive meaningful impact, possess strong stakeholder management skills, and is a self-starter that is comfortable with ambiguity in a fast paced global work environment.</li> <li>This person will have a high degree of visibility with senior management within the organization, including Country Managers, Regional and Finance Leaders. </li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>A Typical Day</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with a Country Manager in driving performance management, including development and ongoing analysis of KPIs, creating goals/OKRs and measuring performance.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of what levers drive growth and efficiency for our business and translating that into investment cases and initiatives to drive business impact.</li> <li>Partnering with the business on annual planning and budgeting, laying out risks and opportunities and debating strategies and capital allocation to maximise growth.</li> <li>Stepping in to lead EMEA’s monthly business review and speaking to key drivers of variance to goal and potential actions to improve performance.</li> <li>Modelling and summarising the implications of a regulatory action and potential mitigating actions we could take to minimize business impact.</li> <li>Joining a call with the Regional Marketing team to discuss changes to channel or country spend and helping bridge local and regional considerations.</li> <li>Digging into the regional impact of a global product feature and identifying relevant regional insights that could point to local optimization opportunities.</li> <li>Analytical deep dives: Conduct deep dives into business trends across EMEA and different segments of the business. Independently lead data extraction, analysis, visualization, and presentation. </li> <li>Build ad hoc reporting and analysis to help business operations and other cross functional partners understand the drivers of performance for key performance indicators.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong><br>Your Expertise</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of relevant experience. Ideally, you have demonstrated relevant experience in an analytical role such as Strategic Finance, Financial Planning and Analytics (FP&A), Strategy/Management Consulting, Investment Banking or Business Operations. </li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, accounting, engineering, statistics or other relevant field that demonstrates quantitative orientation; MBA or advanced degree a plus.</li> <li>Superb financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills, SQL experience highly preferred.</li> <li>Strong analytical abilities and able to synthesize complex information. You enjoy absorbing large amounts of data and qualitative insights and can quickly develop a strong narrative that leads to recommendations and builds our understanding of the business.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: The ability to work and influence cross-functionally in a matrixed business environment is a must. title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️ We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies. In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end : you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market. This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan . About the Enterprise segment Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc) Total Addressable Market: ~ 7M members in France Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support. Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics; Company profiles : Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness; HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies) Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives. Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters. ⭐ What you will do ⭐ You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine . More precisely, you will: Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment . Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come) Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment. Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations , rigorous follow‑up , and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management. Be on the field with the team : prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates. Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals : strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy. Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.). For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range . ⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐ You may be a great fit at Alan if you: Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales , with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader Have experience leading and coaching sales teams , with the ability to set a high bar , give clear direction , and help people grow Have full working proficiency in French , and advanced level in English for internal communication Have a very hands‑on mentality : you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments , and can prioritize ruthlessly Are data‑driven and analytical : you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.) Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area Nice-to-have: Experience selling to HR or Finance . 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible Office . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance . Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only. Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles. Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. title: Senior Systems Engineer, Browser Isolation
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX (US), Lisbon (Portugal), London (UK)</p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/zero-trust/products/browser-isolation/">Cloudflare Browser Isolation</a> runs web content in remote browsers, helping protect users from threats while preserving a responsive browsing experience. Our team builds the Chromium-based browsing engine, remote rendering and streaming technology, and distributed services that manage browser sessions across Cloudflare’s global network.</p> <p>You will work at the intersection of systems programming, distributed systems, and security. Engineers contribute across the product, collaborating on browser changes, service orchestration, observability, and build infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>Scope and growth</strong></p> <p>At this level, you will be accountable for outcomes across a problem area that may span several components. You will establish technical direction, make uncertainty and trade-offs explicit, and help other engineers succeed while remaining hands-on. This is an individual-contributor role; people-management experience is not required.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use</strong></p> <ul> <li>Browser engine: Chromium and C++.</li> <li>Systems programming: Rust.</li> <li>Distributed services and orchestration: Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Nomad, and Consul.</li> <li>Remote rendering and streaming: WebRTC and Skia.</li> <li>Browser client: TypeScript, WebAssembly, and WebGL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex, multi-component initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, staged rollout, and measurable production outcomes.</li> <li>Design and implement changes in our Chromium-based C++ browser and the distributed services and systems components supporting remote browsing, working across Go, Rust, and TypeScript.</li> <li>Make and explain architectural trade-offs across latency, availability, resource efficiency, security boundaries, and operational complexity.</li> <li>Investigate difficult cross-layer failures and performance bottlenecks, distinguishing browser, host, network, and control-plane causes.</li> <li>Improve resilience, capacity management, observability, and release safety; define success metrics and validate results.</li> <li>Coordinate work with partner teams, surface dependencies and risks early, and guide delivery through ambiguity.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and raise the quality of code reviews, design reviews, testing, documentation, and operational practices.</li> <li>Participate in the team’s production on-call rotation after onboarding, lead technical incident investigations as needed, and drive durable corrective actions.</li> </ul> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong production C++ proficiency, including memory and resource ownership, concurrency, and debugging in substantial codebases.</li> <li>A track record of independently leading complex systems or distributed-service improvements across multiple components, from an unclear problem to a reliable production outcome.</li> <li>Strong Linux/UNIX and networking fundamentals, with experience diagnosing correctness, latency, and resource-consumption issues using profiling and operational evidence.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating distributed systems, with sound judgment about service boundaries, data partitioning, consistency, timeouts and retries, backpressure, capacity limits, and recovery from partial failures.</li> <li>Experience designing safe rollout and recovery strategies and maintaining production software over its lifecycle.</li> <li>Ability to communicate trade-offs clearly, align stakeholders, mentor teammates, and improve engineering practices through constructive feedback.</li> <li>A willingness to work across C++, Rust, Go, and TypeScript and learn unfamiliar parts of the stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>These are preferred qualifications, not prerequisites. Prior Browser Isolation or Cloudflare experience is not required.</p> <ul> <li>Browser engines, Chromium, browser sandboxing, or security-sensitive systems.</li> <li>Low-latency streaming, graphics, remote computing, or other real-time systems.</li> <li>Container and workload orchestration, including Nomad or Kubernetes, and service discovery.</li> <li>Experience using Rust for systems programming or distributed services.</li> <li>Go or TypeScript; WebRTC, Skia, WebAssembly, or WebGL.</li> <li>Production observability, capacity planning, incident response, or build and release infrastructure.</li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p data-path-to-node="1">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.</p> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More detail

You will guide new capacity from delivery to production, partnering with Cloudflare's data center and hardware teams to ensure systems pass validation, come online smoothly, and uphold Cloudflare's high standards.</p> <p>You will serve as a bridge connecting Cloudflare's infrastructure, hardware, and data center teams with the customer's engineering organization. You'll ensure teams work from a shared vision, clear operational roadblocks, and feed real-world insights back into how Cloudflare builds and evolves its platform.</p> <p>This role is ideal for engineers who want to:</p> <ul> <li>Stay deeply technical and hands-on with real production infrastructure.</li> <li>Guide outcomes from hardware delivery through running workloads.</li> <li>Shape how Cloudflare delivers compute capacity at scale.</li> <li>Build long-term, trust-based partnerships with world-class engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Capacity Onboarding & Delivery:</strong> Lead bringing new compute capacity online for the customer, collaborating on planning, provisioning, validation, and handover to production. Define acceptance criteria and validation workflows, including burn-in, benchmarking, and health checks across compute, storage, and networking. Work alongside on-site data center teams to execute checks and resolve issues.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Standards & Operational Readiness:</strong> Champion Cloudflare's build, configuration, security, and observability standards prior to capacity launch. Ensure comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and runbooks are established for all production systems.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Cross-Team Alignment:</strong> Act as the central point of collaboration between Cloudflare's infrastructure, hardware engineering, data center operations, supply chain, and network teams, alongside the customer's engineering group.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Technical Accountability:</strong> Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer's infrastructure, guiding account strategy and technical direction for supporting Cloudflare resources.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Reliability & Incident Response:</strong> Engage in operational rhythms with the customer and Cloudflare, including standups, capacity reviews, change management, and incident response. Facilitate blameless root-cause analysis and post-incident improvements<br>.</li> <li><strong>Automation & Tooling:</strong> Develop production-quality automation and tooling for provisioning, validation, and fleet management to continually improve rollout efficiency.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Capacity Planning & Forecasting:</strong> Partner with the customer to understand future demand, forecast capacity needs, and proactively identify constraints.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Feedback Loop & Product Influence:</strong> Surface real-world operational issues and platform opportunities with Cloudflare's Infrastructure, Hardware, and Product teams to inform future roadmaps.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Strategic Relationship Management:</strong> Cultivate trusted technical relationships with senior stakeholders (Staff+ engineers, Directors, and VPs) across both organizations.<br><br></li> <li><strong>On-Site Presence:</strong> Spend time regularly on-site at customer offices to foster close communication and partnership with their engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h4> <p><em>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Infrastructure & SRE Background:</strong> Solid experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, or production engineering, with a track record of running and scaling large-scale production systems.</li> <li><strong>Capacity & Fleet Operations:</strong> Practical experience bringing server capacity online, encompassing provisioning, imaging, configuration management, and fleet-scale lifecycle management.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Fluency:</strong> Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, and diagnostics. Ability to set validation standards, triage issues remotely, and partner with on-site technicians. Experience with GPUs or specialized accelerators is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Networking:</strong> Strong understanding of Linux systems and core networking principles (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, load balancing, and data center topologies).</li> <li><strong>Automation & Development:</strong> Proficiency in languages such as Go, Python, or Rust, along with experience using infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Salt).</li> <li><strong>Production Ownership:</strong> Experience supporting mission-critical services, including on-call rotations, incident response, SLO management, and reliability engineering.</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Familiarity with monitoring, metrics, and logging frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse) to maintain system health proactively.</li> <li><strong>Containers & Orchestration:</strong> Exposure to Kubernetes or similar platforms and workload scheduling on newly provisioned capacity.</li> <li><strong>AI-Augmented Workflows:</strong> Interest or experience in leveraging modern AI tools to streamline automation, debugging, and documentation.</li> <li><strong>Program-Level Coordination:</strong> Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex, multi-team delivery efforts across regions and time zones with clear communication and alignment.</li> <li><strong>Proactive Communication:</strong> Ability to engage comfortably in strategic technical discussions with executive-level stakeholders, translating infrastructure context into business outcomes.</li> </ul> architecture.</li> <li>Experience in customer-embedded or partner-facing technical infrastructure roles.</li> <li>A history of sharing knowledge, such as technical writing, internal mentorship, open-source contributions, or community presentations.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description: <p>ANINE BING is looking for a <strong>Senior FP&A Analyst</strong> to join our <strong>Finance</strong> team based in <strong>Paris</strong>.</p> <p>As a senior member of our Paris HQ Finance team, the Senior FP&A Analyst holds the full view of the company P&L, from net sales to EBITDA, across all channels and regions. The role combines ownership of the planning and reporting cycles with hands-on business partnering, and plays a central part in structuring our FP&A processes as the brand scales internationally.</p> <p>We're looking for a rigorous, process-oriented finance professional with a strong retail background and a sharp understanding of margin mechanics. You are comfortable owning the numbers end to end and challenging the business on what drives them.</p> <p>This is a <strong>full-time permanent position (CDI)</strong> based at our <strong>Paris HQ</strong> (<em>with 4 days per week in the office and 1 day of remote work possible</em>). The role reports to the <strong>Head of Finance</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities Include:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Full P&L ownership:</strong> own the company-wide P&L view, from net sales through gross margin, store contribution and operating expenses down to EBITDA, consolidated across retail, e-commerce and wholesale, and across the US, Europe and Asia. Act as the go-to reference on P&L performance and its drivers for the Head of Finance and the leadership team.</li> <li><strong>Budgeting & forecasting:</strong> lead the annual budget, monthly reforecasts and long-range plan. Own the planning calendar, key assumptions and models, and consolidate inputs from regional and functional stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Margin management:</strong> own margin analysis at every level (channel, market, category, collection, SKU), including markdowns, promotions, cost of goods, freight, duties, FX and inventory provisions. Build margin bridges, explain variances and drive recommendations on pricing and markdown strategy.</li> <li><strong>Monthly close & reporting:</strong> own the FP&A month-end close and the global management reporting package (actuals vs. budget, forecast and prior year, variance commentary, KPI dashboards). Work with Accounting to ensure management and statutory figures reconcile.</li> <li><strong>Business partnering:</strong> serve as finance partner to Retail, E-Commerce, Wholesale, Merchandising and Supply Chain leaders on store P&Ls, inventory productivity and open-to-buy, pricing, promotional plans, and business cases for store openings and market entries.</li> <li><strong>Processes & controls:</strong> design, document and continuously improve FP&A processes, templates, review controls and data standards. Drive reporting automation across the finance stack (NetSuite, Excel / Google Sheets, BI tools) in coordination with Accounting and IT.</li> <li><strong>Leadership support:</strong> prepare materials for executive and board reviews and lead ad hoc analyses requested by the CFO and the Head of Finance. Review and guide the work of junior team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>5–7 years of experience</strong> in FP&A, controlling or financial planning, with significant exposure to a company-wide or business-unit scope.</li> <li><strong>Retail experience is mandatory:</strong> proven experience in a retail or fashion company with a store network and multi-channel model, and a solid command of store economics, seasonality, markdowns, inventory and open-to-buy.</li> <li><strong>Full P&L vision:</strong> hands-on experience owning or co-owning a full P&L, from top line to EBITDA, including consolidation across channels or countries.</li> <li><strong>Strong margin expertise:</strong> gross margin building blocks, markdown and promotional impact, landed cost, inventory valuation and provisions, with the ability to explain margin drivers clearly to non-finance stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Rigorous and process-oriented:</strong> a track record of building or improving planning, closing and reporting processes, with reliable delivery against deadlines.</li> <li>Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and financial modeling skills; experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a plus) and a BI or reporting tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau or equivalent).</li> <li>Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.</li> <li>Fluent English required (global scope, US HQ, international teams); professional proficiency in French preferred.</li> <li>Strong communication skills: able to turn complex analyses into concise, decision-oriented messages and to challenge senior operational stakeholders with confidence</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits & Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>At ANINE BING Paris, we combine creative ambition with a people-first culture. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p> </p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day—building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with limitless entrepreneurial spirit, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p> <p> </p> <p>As we continue to scale our global platform, the Head of Operations – EU Fulfilment will play a critical role in leading end-to-end customer fulfilment capability across the EU region.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the Vice President, Operations and based in France, the Head of Operations – EU Fulfilment is responsible for leading and directing customer fulfilment across the EU region, building capacity and capability through both owned and third-party operations to service all verticals. The role owns the development and execution of operational strategies that improve speed of delivery, reduce cost, and drive down defects across the full supply chain from first to final mile. The Head of Operations – EU Fulfilment delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <p>Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner closely with business leaders and stakeholders across the UK and EU, operational leaders spanning supply chain, freight, fulfilment, and final mile, and local technical and functional teams to align operational plans with broader business priorities.</li> <li>Strengthen the France-based operational partnership with internal stakeholders across the international Senior Leadership Team, influencing effectively within a regional, matrixed environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>People Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and develop high-performing teams with clear ownership across key partners, verticals, and locations, fostering a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Translate operational excellence standards into 3PL environments, embedding accountability and performance ownership across all third-party operators.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fan & Customer Impact</strong> (Obsessed with Fans)</p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute strategies to improve customer and partner satisfaction through faster delivery, lower cost, and reduced defect rates across the EU region.</li> <li>Drive operational plans that support all verticals and locales, ensuring consistent service quality and fulfilment performance for fans across every channel.</li> <li>Manage vendor performance, contracts, and service delivery to ensure all partners meet or exceed agreed service levels and customer experience standards.</li> <li>Lead the selection and onboarding of new providers to support the growth plans of verticals and locales within the EU region.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Innovation & Problem Solving</strong> (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)</p> <ul> <li>Translate capital expenditure projects into tangible ROI and measurable service benefits, ensuring investment decisions are grounded in data and operational insight.</li> <li>Develop and implement plans to improve speed to delivery while simultaneously reducing cost and defects, identifying synergies across the EU region to optimise performance.</li> <li>Act as a change leader and owner, driving continuous improvement across 3PL and internal operations through innovative thinking and structured execution.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ownership & Execution</strong> (Determined & Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Own the operations forecast and plans end-to-end, ensuring alignment between operational capacity and business demand across all EU verticals and locations.</li> <li>Optimise the speed and cost of service across the region, balancing efficiency with service quality and partner commitments.</li> <li>Drive operational synergies across the EU region, identifying and realising efficiencies that benefit customers, partners, and the broader Fanatics Commerce business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of operational leadership experience within complex, multi-site or omni-channel organisations.</li> <li>Proven experience managing 3PLs, including SLA ownership, contract management, and performance governance.</li> <li>Strong understanding of the end-to-end supply chain, from first mile through to final mile delivery.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record as a change leader, owning and driving transformation across operational environments.</li> <li>Effective communicator and influencer with the ability to operate in regional, matrixed stakeholder environments.</li> <li>France-based operational experience is essential, with the ability to lead on-the-ground operations from a France base.</li> <li>Experience developing and executing operational plans that deliver measurable improvements in speed, cost, and quality across multiple verticals and geographies.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Paris, France, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</em><br><br><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.</em></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT THE TEAM</em></strong><br><em>Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site, <a href="http://www.fanatics.com">www.fanatics.com</a>.</em><br><br><em>Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).</em><br><br><em>At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:</em><br><em>· Build Championship Teams</em><br><em>· Obsessed with Fans</em><br><em>· Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit</em><br><em>· Determined and Relentless Mindset</em></p> <p><em>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></em></p> <p></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal informa

description: <p>The Continuous Profiler (<a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/continuous-profiling-fourth-pillar/">https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/continuous-profiling-fourth-pillar/</a>) team at Datadog is building a cutting-edge continuous profiling product that has low enough overhead to run continuously in production, unlocking insights into how customer applications perform under real workloads at scale. As AI reshapes software development and teams lose touch with how their code works and interacts with the hardware, this capability is becoming more essential than ever, for humans and AI alike. Today the information produced by our profilers is used for everything from automatic performance tuning to root cause analysis.</p> <p>As a distributed systems engineer on the profiling team, you will be contributing to the systems that intake, process, index, store and make sense of the data collected. You will be working with some of the best runtime engineers, visualization experts, data scientists and designers in the industry on challenging and fun problems. title: Senior Named Account Executive (Majors), Sydney
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Sydney<br></strong></p> <hr> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p>Our Enterprise team specifically helps marquee Australian corporations solve complex technical challenges while protecting their critical digital infrastructure, customer data, and online experiences.</p> <p>As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will lead Cloudflare’s strategic engagement for a portfolio of premier NSW-headquartered enterprise accounts across Financial Services, Healthcare, Media, and Digital Tech leaders. In this role, you will drive adoption of the Cloudflare platform across Security, Performance, Zero Trust, and AI infrastructure, positioning Cloudflare as a foundational pillar for digital transformation and enterprise resilience.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Relationship Management: </strong>Build and nurture deep, executive-level relationships across target named accounts, navigating complex organizational structures to establish trusted advisor status with C-suite and technology leaders</li> <li><strong>Territory Leadership:</strong> Formulate and lead the engagement strategy across your assigned NSW enterprise portfolio, driving adoption of Cloudflare’s core solutions across Cloud SaaS, Zero Trust, Network Security, and AI enablement.</li> <li><strong>Partner Ecosystem Engagement:</strong> Collaborate with strategic channel partners, Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), and cloud ecosystem partners to extend Cloudflare’s reach, influence, and co-selling impact within target accounts.</li> <li><strong>Business Development & Execution: </strong>Proactively identify and qualify high-impact enterprise opportunities, leveraging AI-assisted research and cross-functional teams to drive multi-million-dollar transformational outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Account Strategy & Operational Rigor: </strong>Execute comprehensive multi-year account plans while maintaining high standards in forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and deal qualification.</li> <li><strong>Full Lifecycle Collaboration:</strong> Partner with Customer Engineers, Customer Success, and Professional Services to ensure successful deployment, value realization, and platform expansion through to renewal.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Leadership:</strong> Share industry insights, competitive intelligence, and enterprise deal strategies across the ANZ team, actively mentoring peers to elevate collective performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of meeting and exceeding complex B2B enterprise software or SaaS sales quotas in high-growth technology environment</li> <li>Deep understanding of the NSW enterprise market, with experience navigating complex commercial procurement, legal, and risk governance processes.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build executive relationships (CIO, CISO, CTO, Head of Infrastructure) and close multi-year enterprise agreements.</li> <li>Strong technical aptitude with the ability to title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description: TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies. Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Ce que nous vous offrons Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs). Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière. Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement. Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation. Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC. Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils. Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées. Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée. Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température). ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations. RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). En externe • Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques • Prestataires de métrologie • Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques. PROFIL RECHERCHE Formation • Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent. Expérience • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire. • Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne. Compétences techniques • Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision. • Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid. • Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15- 140 / COFRAC). • Analyse de données de température. • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique. Qualités personnelles • Sens de l'organisation. • Rigueur et méthode. • Esprit d'analyse. • Capacité de prise de décision. • Aisance relationnelle. • Force de proposition. • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs. • Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence. Objectifs du poste • Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules. • Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique. • Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température. • Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport. • Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. This is a critical role that will be at the forefront of protecting our company and customers from malicious threats. You will be responsible for driving security research, exercises, and activities that emulate real world attackers and attacks to drive improvements in Cloudflare’s security posture focusing on AI, Agents, harnesses and LLM’s. </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI Security and Vulnerability Research: </strong>Stay current with emerging threats and perform deep-dive research to identify AI-specific vulnerabilities and risks in addition to general vulnerabilities across Cloudflare’s products and services.</li> <li><strong>Agentic testing and adoption: </strong>As a core function, identifying AI-related attack surfaces through rigorous testing of agentic implementations and LLM usage which will help  define requirements and implementation guidance while proactively. </li> <li><strong>Adversary Simulation:</strong> Execution of full-chain red team operations targeting Cloudflare’s global infrastructure, corporate networks, and product ecosystems.</li> <li><strong>Efficacy Testing:</strong> Establish a rigorous framework for testing "Security Efficacy"—measuring exactly how well our WAF, EDR, and SIEM detections perform against known TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures).</li> <li><strong>Purple Teaming:</strong> Foster a highly collaborative relationship with the Blue Team (Detection & Response) to ensure findings are translated into immediate defensive improvements.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship & Growth:</strong> Be a technical leader, providing technical expertise while fostering a culture of curiosity, ethical hacking and partnering to improve Cloudflare’s security posture. </li> <li><strong>Executive Reporting:</strong> Translate complex technical exploits into risk-based narratives for leadership, helping prioritize engineering resources where they matter most.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Security Incident Response Team (SIRT):</strong> You will act as the "sparring partner" for SIRT.
