Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Amsterdam</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.</p> <p><strong>This is a hybrid role.</strong></p> <h3>Languages required: English & Dutch</h3> <p>This is a great opportunity to be an early member of a high performing sales team at a fast growing technology company. We are looking for ownership-oriented team members with excellent communication skills and technical curiosity. As the Business Development Representative (BDR), you will:</p> <ul> <li>Create excellent customer experiences</li> <li>Learn customer-centric sales skills</li> <li>Become an expert in Cloudflare’s product</li> <li>Team members have opportunities to move into roles across the organization, especially in mid-market sales, customer success, solutions engineering, and sales operations</li> </ul> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <p>This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Seoul, South Korea, Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></p> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ensure all construction activities and global workflows are in strict compliance with local laws while maintaining a focus on sustainable, high-performance building standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Seniority:</strong> 10-12+ years of experience leading interior design and complex construction project management, specifically within high-growth technology companies or global enterprises.</li> <li><strong>Scale Mastery:</strong> A proven track record of successfully directing a global corporate office portfolio in excess of 250,000+ total square feet.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity & Growth Mindset:</strong> A profound curiosity for how technology can optimize human interaction. You must be comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building unprecedented internal tools from scratch rather than managing legacy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Integration:</strong> Knowledge of technical infrastructure (MEP systems, architectural principles, AV/IT) and a clear vision of how they connect with automated building systems.</li> <li><strong>Sophisticated Communication:</strong> Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional executives and external partners across multiple time zones.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Architecture, Project Management, Interior Design, or Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Mobility & Presence:</strong> Willingness to work in-office ~3 days a week to lead by example within our local workplace laboratory, with the flexibility to travel globally to oversee high-stakes project transformations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> LEED, WELL, or PMP Certifications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Skills:</strong> Experience with AI-enhanced workflows, generative design platforms, or transitioning legacy portfolios into AI-assisted operational models.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $223,000 - Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. This role reports to the VP of Strategic Finance, Treasury, Deal Desk, & Investor Relations and is the engine room of how Cloudflare tells its financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end quarterly earnings cycle, drive our long-term financial model and consensus discipline, partner directly with the CFO and senior leadership on guidance, and lead the analytical and communications work behind every major investor and analyst touchpoint — quarterly calls, conferences, our annual Investor Day, and ad-hoc executive projects. We move fast, we ship work that goes directly to the CEO, CFO, Board, and public markets, and we hold ourselves to an exceptionally high bar on accuracy — and we are AI-native in how we work, treating modern tooling as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, and rigor.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <p>As the Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations, you will be the operational and analytical lead for Cloudflare's engagement with the public markets. build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with our covering analysts and shareholders.</li> <li>Articulate the Cloudflare investment narrative — our connectivity cloud strategy, the Workers and Developer Platform story, and our long-term financial model — in a way that is both compelling and credible.</li> <li>Plan and execute the calendar of investor events: sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and our annual Investor Day.</li> <li>Prepare the CEO, CFO, and other senior executives for every investor interaction with tailored briefing materials, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Develop and maintain core IR collateral: investor presentation, fact sheets, IR website content, and board-of-directors investor update materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and special projects</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-lead the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day — invite tracker and registration management, co-author all presentation content and prepared remarks across all presenters, own the supporting documentation, validation, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-through.</li> <li>Lead select strategic finance projects: peer benchmarking analyses, long-range financial modeling, competitive analyses, and ad-hoc executive-level financial analyses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team — the person who knows where every number comes from and what it means.</li> <li>Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, market dynamics, and industry trends; provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. Comfort debating modeling assumptions and valuation mechanics.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong> — including the ability to draft in the voice of senior executives, translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences, and operate confidently in high-stakes external communications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling skills </strong>— fluency in building, maintaining, and stress-testing operating models, share-count and dilution forecasts, guidance sensitivity analyses, and consensus benchmarks.</li> <li><strong>An ownership mindset</strong> — comfort owning a process end-to-end, driving operational structure in a fast-paced environment, and operating with the integrity and accuracy demanded by external disclosure.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, CEO, Board, Legal, Accounting, FP&A) and external stakeholders (sell-side analysts, institutional investors).</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill </strong>— fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced engineers. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon</strong></span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Department</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Team</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We build the tooling and platform capabilities that power the next generation of AI agents on the Cloudflare Developer Platform. Our goal is to make it easier for agents to interact with the web, and to be observed and controlled while they do it — without giving up performance, scalability or security.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the centre of that work, and it is the product this role owns. It runs full browser sessions on Cloudflare’s global network and lets developers drive them with code or with an agent: a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint that any Puppeteer, Playwright or CDP client can connect to from anywhere, Workers bindings, and a REST API for the common jobs — screenshots, PDFs, Markdown extraction, scraping and crawling. On top of that sit session recording and replay, live debugging, and a path for a human to step in when an agent gets stuck.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">It is used by external developers building agents, crawlers and scrapers, and by other Cloudflare teams who need a browser they can trust. It is also a billed product on a steep growth curve, which makes capacity, cold-start latency, concurrency limits and abuse protection product problems rather than merely operational ones.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The team’s wider portfolio includes an agent-first browser built on Workers rather than containers, a managed CI platform for the agent development lifecycle, visual regression testing delivered as a service, a pre-rendering service, URL Scanner, and CDNJS. Browser Run is the focus of this role today; there is scope for more of that portfolio to come into it as the role and the team grow.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run went from an internal rendering tool to a public, billed product, and the surface has not stopped moving — the CDP endpoint, MCP client support, session replay and the REST API all landed inside a year. That pace is the point, and it is the thing this role has to make sustainable.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are a tight-knit team that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to the highest standard.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Role</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on engineering management role. You will own Browser Run engineering end to end — the people, the roadmap, the reliability, and the story we tell customers about it. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Agents Tooling & Platform and partner closely with Product Management, Developer Relations, and platform teams across Cloudflare.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the primary focus. The team owns other products, and there is scope for some of them to move into your remit as the role and the team grow, but we are hiring someone to make Browser Run excellent first.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will not be writing most of the code. You will be expected to understand it well enough to review a design document, challenge an architecture, and know when an estimate is wrong.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What you’ll do</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Manage, coach and grow the team of systems engineers behind Browser Run — 1:1s, career development, performance conversations, and hiring.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the Browser Run roadmap and delivery, and give the team and the wider organisation clear visibility into what is being worked on, in what order, and what we are deliberately not doing.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Partner with Product Management to set direction: shape the roadmap, pressure-test scope, and make the trade-off calls that keep an incubation product shipping.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own Browser Run’s operational health — browser fleet capacity, session reliability, cold-start latency, concurrency limits, on-call rotations, alert quality and incident follow-through. External developers and other Cloudflare teams depend on this service.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Keep the automation surface honest: Puppeteer and Playwright compatibility, CDP behaviour that matches what developers expect from a local Chrome, and a credible story for Chrome version upgrades.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop leaders. Identify and grow the engineers who will run day-to-day delivery for an area of the product, and hand that work to them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Resolve cross-team dependencies with the Workers, Developer Platform, Security and Billing teams, and bring contentious technical decisions to closure quickly and calmly.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the commercial mechanics of a billed service, including the unglamorous parts: usage metering, quotas, plan limits, abuse protection and pricing input.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Browser Run externally through launch blog posts, developer documentation, conference talks and direct customer conversations.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You have run an engineering team that shipped, and you can point at what it shipped.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You give your technical legos away. Your measure of success is the team’s output and the growth of the people on it, not your own commit history.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You are comfortable with ambiguity. Incubation means the requirements move, and you can change direction without drama.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You are direct. You give feedback early, disagree openly, and admit when you were wrong.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You write well. You believe a clear design document, roadmap or incident report is as much of a deliverable as the code.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You care about operational quality and treat a noisy alert as a bug, not as background noise.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You find browsers genuinely interesting as an engineering problem — how Chrome behaves under load, why automation breaks, and what an AI agent actually needs from a browser it does not own.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You want to join a team that upholds a culture of support, open and honest communication, and collaborative problem-solving.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">2+ years managing engineering teams, on top of a solid track record as a hands-on engineer.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience owning a production service end to end, including on-call rotation, capacity planning and incident review.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Demonstrated experience growing engineers — promotions you supported, and ideally a team lead or first-line manager you developed.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on familiarity with browser automation — Chrome DevTools Protocol, Puppeteer or Playwright — or with the browser internals underneath them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, web platform fundamentals (HTTP, JavaScript execution models, rendering) or cloud infrastructure — enough to hold a credible design review.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Austin </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong><strong><br></strong>Cloudflare is seeking an Indirect Tax Analyst to join our collaborative team. This position will have a broad range of responsibilities with a primary focus on Indirect Tax (US & International - VAT, GST, Sales Tax, Use Tax and Property Tax). This Indirect Tax Analyst will report to the Director of Tax and work with other members of the tax and finance teams, collaborating with cross-functional business partners from time-to-time. The right candidate will be detail-oriented, collaborative, and motivated by finding better, smarter ways to work through automation, standardization, and AI-enabled improvements.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Prepare Indirect Tax compliance including the financial support information (VAT, GST, Sales Tax, Use Tax and Property Tax fillings)</li> <li>Prepare monthly tax reconciliations and associated journal entries.</li> <li>Maintain and add exemption/resale certificates and Tax ID information</li> <li>Ensure timely and accurate filings to minimize assessments and penalties by maintaining the tax calendar</li> <li>Assist on audit requests and special project needs</li> <li>Prepare and ensure the payments requests and submissions.</li> <li>Reconcile data between systems to ensure integrity and accuracy</li> <li>Research various indirect tax matters/law updates and document conclusions</li> <li>Participate in the calculation of indirect tax reserves and budgets.</li> <li>Drive the digital transformation of our tax function, identifying and executing process improvements through technology, automation, and AI</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Requirements</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance or related field</li> <li>2+ years of significant experience at a public accounting firm and/or corporate tax department of a multinational company</li> <li>Proficient in Excel and AI technology</li> <li>Strong attention to detail with analytical and problem-solving skills</li> <li>Proactive and inquisitive</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively internally as well as with external service providers</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>International VAT knowledge is a plus</li> <li>Both public accounting and technology industry experience</li> <li>Experience with Oracle and AI</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, NY</li> <li>Washington DC</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers approximately 25 million Internet properties, for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us! </p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Delivering this platform with high performance and efficiency depends on advanced Linux kernel and hardware capabilities, and that is where this team works.</p> <p>The Performance Team owns overall system and application performance across that fleet: resource optimization, instrumentation, and the tooling that lets us see what the hardware is actually doing. System memory sits alongside CPU cycles, network processing, and storage IOPS as a first-class resource, and how the kernel manages it is increasingly the thing that decides how hot we can safely run every machine we own.</p> <p>We work upstream first. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. We are looking for an expert to take on these problems, fix them against production workloads, and drive the changes upstream. Solving them lifts efficiency and latency across the entire fleet rather than in one place.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Diagnose and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem, informed by real production telemetry at a scale few environments can offer.</li> <li>Land your work upstream. We expect MM changes to go to mainline first and want you to keep doing the maintainership and review work that earns standing in the community.</li> <li>Build and extend low-overhead kernel instrumentation (tracepoints, BPF, perf) so we keep measuring before we change, and prove the impact afterwards.</li> <li>Partner with kernel, networking, storage, and product engineers across the company to turn observed system behavior into concrete MM improvements.</li> <li>Set technical direction for how Cloudflare uses, tunes, and evolves kernel memory management as we push utilization higher.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem: the page allocator, virtual memory and memory mapping, reclaim, and the locking and concurrency that hold it together.</li> <li>A track record of upstream Linux contribution, ideally including maintainership or sustained work in MM or an adjacent subsystem.</li> <li>Strong systems programming in C, with the judgement to make high-risk changes to shared infrastructure safely.</li> <li>Ability to dive deep into a complex codebase while keeping the fleet-wide picture in mind, and to own a problem and its outcome rather than a single patch.</li> <li>Clear communication with engineers across many teams, since the symptoms of an MM problem usually show up far from the MM code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonuses</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals pertaining to memory management</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving performance issues in large-scale distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience with large scale configuration/deployment management.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Toronto, Canada</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until September 20, 2026.</strong></p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>Cloudflare is growing our People team. Our focus is finding the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. As we continue to scale our global organization, we are looking for a trusted Business Partner who is naturally curious about our technology, deeply invested in our business strategy, and driven to help our people thrive.In this role, you will report to the Senior Director, People Team Business Partners and serve as a heavy-hitting strategic partner to our senior leadership across Product, Engineering and Security.</p> <p>You won't just execute HR programs; you will actively architect them. You will focus on macro-level organizational design, sophisticated talent management strategies, systemic change leadership, and workforce planning that aligns directly with our aggressive business goals. Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Cloudflarians thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. You will bring critical thought, deep business acumen, and a strong point of view to help our leaders navigate this unrelenting pace, transforming potential friction into high-impact execution.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Advisory:</strong> Act as a trusted advisor to R&D executive leadership, translating business objectives into long-term workforce strategies, organizational designs, and succession plans.</li> <li><strong>Insight-Driven Problem Solving:</strong> Synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative data—leveraging AI-driven insights and engagement analytics—to proactively identify trends, mitigate risks, and design predictive people solutions.</li> <li><strong>Change Leadership:</strong> Guide leadership and teams through structural evolutions, hyper-growth scaling, and shifting business priorities with minimal disruption to engagement and output.</li> <li><strong>Talent & Capability Building:</strong> Partner with business leaders and People team Centers of Excellence (COEs) to design high-impact initiatives around talent development, performance elevation, and total rewards.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Motivated by cultivating high-performance culture, building great businesses, and helping people do their best work, you are a seasoned, consultative People leader. You don't just adapt to the future of work—you actively leverage modern tools and a relentless curiosity to shape it.</li> <li><strong>Experienced & Proven:</strong> You have 12+ years of progressive experience on a People/HR team, with at least 3+ years operating as a principal business partner backing complex, fast-paced corporate functions.</li> <li><strong>Business-First Strategist:</strong> You possess keen business acumen and effortlessly link HR strategy to commercial and operational outcomes. You think like a business leader who happens to specialize in people, always looking for ways to enable teams to hit their goals.</li> <li><strong>Relentlessly Curious:</strong> You possess an innate curiosity about what we build, how our teams operate, and what makes our people tick. You dive deep into the data and the dynamics of your organizations to diagnose root causes rather than just treating symptoms.</li> <li><strong>AI & Tech Savvy:</strong> You embrace modern innovation, utilizing AI and advanced digital tooling as strategic force multipliers. You leverage AI to enhance your personal productivity, streamline operational efficiency, and uncover data-driven insights that solve complex organizational challenges. <em>(And yes, you still secretly love a sophisticated spreadsheet!)</em></li> <li><strong>Architect of Change:</strong> You have a proven track record of leading large-scale change initiatives through highly ambiguous environments. You know what organizational complexity looks like and possess the resilience and resourcefulness to drive ideation into concrete action.</li> <li><strong>Program Builder:</strong> You have built scalable, enterprise-grade programs from the ground up and have a demonstrated history of establishing immediate credibility and trust across all levels of a distributed, virtual organization.</li> <li><strong>Empathic Influencer & Communicator:</strong> You lead with empathy but do not shy away from radical candor. You are a masterful communicator—whether presenting to executives, writing strategic proposals, or delivering difficult feedback face-to-face.</li> <li><strong>High Integrity:</strong> Uncompromising when it comes to your ethics, you speak truth to power, act with deep respect, and lead with dignity.</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $187,000 - $257,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,2,0">For Boston, California - Remote, Connecticut - Remote, DC Metro, Massachusetts - Remote, New Jersey - Remote, New York City, NY Metro, Remote - Washington, Washington (Kirkland), and Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $178,000 - $245,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,3,0">For Colorado - Remote, Illinois - Remote, Maryland - Remote, Minnesota - Remote, Nevada - Remote, New York - Remote, Rhode Island - Remote, and Vermont - Remote based hires: Estimated annual salary of $162,000 - $223,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.</p> <p>Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world's largest global networks can provide. The team analyzes these unique data points at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <h2><strong>About INTERDICT</strong></h2> <p><strong>I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T.</strong> (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>PhishGuard:</strong> Email Managed Detection and Response (MDR) service.</li> <li><strong>Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD, Formerly SOCaaS):</strong> 24/7 monitoring, detection, and mitigation of security events across Cloudflare products.</li> <li><strong>Detection Engineering:</strong> Develops, maintains, and deploys Cloudflare’s threat detection logic across email, application, and network telemetry.</li> </ul> <p>Through the combined capabilities of CMD, PhishGuard, and Detection Engineering, INTERDICT delivers a cohesive operational security function that provides continuous, proactive protection against network, application, and email-based threats. This integrated structure ensures rapid detection, coordinated response, and improved security outcomes for Cloudflare and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Response Engineer within the Cloudflare Managed Defense Center acts as a primary technical responder for Cloudflare's premium enterprise customers. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Central Territory - Toronto, Canada
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Toronto, Canada</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This
