title: Senior Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product. This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA. If you’re someone who is excited and driven by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you. Sales Cycle Ownership Coplan and execute discovery calls to understand customer requirements, their technical environment, and current business challenges. Design and deliver compelling demonstrations that solve customer problems, quantify the value of solving those problems, and tell a clear, credible story of how Synthesia solves them better than anything else. Understand and overcome technical objections and integration concerns; identify blockers early and develop solution paths with customers. Support stakeholder workshops that connect Synthesia to the buyer's broader technology strategy on complex, multi-stakeholder deals. Partner with Account Executives to define account and deal strategy, advise on competitive positioning, and provide your assessment of opportunity stage and forecast your book of business to leadership. Demo Excellence Design and execute repeatable Demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, designing Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product. Identify, build relationships with, and actively empower executive champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally. Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objections, and industry playbooks brought to life directly in Synthesia’s platform. Support POC and pilot readouts as a business narrative, not a feature tour, learning to bring storytelling and executive presence to the room as you grow into more senior conversations. Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments. Product & Industry Expertise Maintain deep expertise on Synthesia's platform capabilities across all product lines, roadmap, and positioning to highlight value driving use cases. Specific vertical knowledge, establishing credibility as a subject matter expert within an industry to easily build credibility and trust with executive buyers. Share customer and prospect product and competitive feedback to the pre-sales leadership and Product team; flag customer pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in live deals. Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from current, static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development. Ecosystem Collaboration Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap. Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards. Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments. Enablement: Review and enhance enablement content from what is effective in preparing our team members for client engagements, delivering and evaluating certification as needed to accelerate understanding in the commercial team. What we are looking for We think the ideal candidate for this role will bring 5+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience at SaaS companies. Strong consultative discovery, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with both executive decision-makers (CHRO, CLO, Head of L&D, CTO) and technical audiences (IT, security, developers). Technical depth in at least one area: Creation flows, APIs, integrations (LMS, HCM, CRM, identity), security, compliance; willingness to learn quickly across domains. Fluency with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message. Comfort translating technical requirements into business value and ROI conversations. Consultative approach to problem-solving; comfort gathering requirements, asking clarifying questions, and adapting solutions to customer needs. Excellent business and technical presentation skills, in person and remote, and the ability to explain complex AI and integration concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Self-motivated and organized; ability to manage multiple POCs, demos, and customer conversations simultaneously while meeting deadlines. Collaborative mindset; thrives working with AEs, Product, Customer Success, and other teams to drive customer and company success. Product orientation; genuine curiosity about how customers use technology Willing to travel; willingness to visit key customers for discovery, executive conversations, and on-site demos. Location We’re ideally looking for someone based in Paris who can spend time in our office at 40 Rue du Colisée, 75008 Paris, or someone based in the UK who can spend time in our London office at 20 Triton Street, Regent’s Place, London NW1 3BF. Please confirm where you are located and whether you can spend two days a week in either location. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description: IN SHORT Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges. Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites. Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations. Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet. Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations. Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team. Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software. Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first. Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans. Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup. YOUR PROFILE Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework. Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait. Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin. Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers. We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.</p> <p>Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.</li> <li>Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.</li> <li>Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.</li> <li>Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.</li> <li>Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.</li> <li>Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.</li> <li>Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.</li> <li>Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.</li> <li>A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.</li> <li>Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.</li> <li>Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.</li> <li>Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.</li> <li>Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.</li> <li>Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.</li> <li>Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.</li> </ul><div Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> <strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1917 </p> <p><strong>The Role: <br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p></p> <p>You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.</p> <ul> <li>Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification</li> <li>Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.</p> <p>Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills</li> <li>Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <p>You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Grâce à sa technologie et à la réactivité de ses équipes, Seyna accompagne les courtiers à chaque étape de leur développement : création du produit d'assurance sur-mesure, outils de vente et de gestion, analyse et amélioration du produit d'assurance, conformité. Grâce à un investissement de 57 millions d'euros de la part de GFC, WhiteStar Capital, Elaia et 115K (La Banque Postale) Seyna a des ambitions mondiales pour améliorer le secteur de l'assurance en modernisant la conception et la gestion des programmes d'assurance. TA FUTURE ÉQUIPE : L'équipe Product & Engineering, c'est le cerveau technologique de Seyna : elle construit la plateforme qui fait tourner Seyna et ses courtiers, du travail de discovery jusqu'à la mise en production, en sprints de 2 semaines. En tant que Software Product Engineer, tu rejoins l'équipe Tech avec un rôle unique, embarqué au plus près des équipes métier (actuariat, juridique, comptabilité…), en reportant directement à Guillaume, notre CPTO. Ta mission : construire avec l'IA les outils qui vont démultiplier la productivité de toute l'entreprise ! CE QUE TU FERAS : Immersion métier : Plonger dans l'équipe que tu outilles et pratiquer réellement son métier, pour comprendre de l'intérieur ses processus, ses contraintes réglementaires et ses irritants du quotidien. Discovery & priorisation : Mener la recherche utilisateur (interviews, observation, analyse des process), identifier les problèmes à plus fort impact et piloter seul ton backlog selon la valeur business attendue. Delivery de bout en bout : Développer, tester et mettre en production toi-même tes solutions, avec un vrai niveau de qualité production (code review, tests, monitoring, documentation). Livrer vite, sans créer de dette ! L'IA au cœur du build : Utiliser les agents de code (Claude Code…) comme levier de vélocité, et intégrer l'IA directement dans les outils que tu construis : automatisation, extraction, génération, agents métier. Alignement & diffusion : Réutiliser les briques existantes de la plateforme Seyna avec les équipes Product & Engineering, faire remonter ce qui mérite d'être industrialisé et partager tes méthodes de build augmenté par l'IA pour faire monter toute l'organisation en niveau. Tu as une vraie rigueur d'ingénierie : architecture réfléchie, tests, code review, monitoring et documentation font partie de ton ADN. Tu es AI-native : les agents de code font partie de ton quotidien, et tu sais intégrer l'IA dans des produits utiles. Tu sais mener une discovery : interviewer, observer, et formuler clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code. Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien. Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et tu t'appuies sur la data pour décider de la suite. Tu aimes résoudre des problèmes complexes et tu sais embarquer des profils tech comme non-tech, sans autorité hiérarchique. ✨ Bonus si tu as déjà rédigé des specs et arbitré un backlog dans un rôle de Product Manager. CE QUE SEYNA TE PROPOSE : 💵 Rémunération : Un package compétitif avec des BSPCE pour que vous puissiez partager le succès à mesure que nous grandissons. 🏖 Congés payés : 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de vos 28 jours de congés payés. 🍜 Ticket restaurant : Une carte ticket restaurant Benefiz prise en charge à 60% par Seyna (10€/jour). 🚇 Transport en commun : 50% de votre moyen de transport préféré (Navigo, vélo, train) pris en charge par Seyna. 🚑 Assurance santé : Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95% par Seyna 🏄 Événements d'équipe : Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble. 🧡 Une équipe positive avec qui travailler au quotidien et une opportunité excitante de rejoindre une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) ! Mais Solteo c’est aussi… Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée. title: Product Manager - CDI
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 ! 💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! Le mot de la CEO “Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs. Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon Et ce poste alors ? Le rôle Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO). Ton objectif : générer un flux régulier de leads qualifiés pour l'équipe commerciale, à un coût d'acquisition maîtrisé, et faire de Solteo une référence de l'électrification des bâtiments auprès des installateurs. Tu accompagneras aussi le lancement de nos nouvelles offres. Missions et responsabilités Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact. Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup , où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis. Discovery continue Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact. Shaping & conception Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe. Delivery & impact Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer. Ownership & autonomie Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet. Tes objectifs: ⭐ Les 30 premiers jours — Comprendre Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business. Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit. 🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap. ⭐ De 1 à 3 mois — Prendre en main ton périmètre Tu prendras progressivement la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit. Tu mèneras tes propres investigations, participeras au shaping des sujets, concevras les solutions avec l'équipe et suivras leur livraison. 🎯 Objectif : mener de manière autonome un sujet produit, de la compréhension du problème jusqu'à sa mise en production. ⭐ De 3 à 12 mois — Devenir pleinement autonome Tu pilotes ton périmètre avec beaucoup d'autonomie : comprendre les problèmes, identifier les opportunités, définir les priorités, construire les bons sujets avec l'équipe et mesurer leur impact. 🎯 Objectif : être pleinement responsable de l'impact produit de ton périmètre et contribuer activement à faire évoluer notre manière de construire le produit. Les compétences qu’on recherche Tu as 3+ ans d'expérience en Product Management , idéalement sur un produit SaaS B2B. Tu es à l'aise dans un environnement start-up : le flou ne te paralyse pas et tu sais avancer sans avoir toutes les réponses. Tu as un bon sens produit et UX et sais transformer un problème complexe en une solution simple. Tu es à l'aise aussi bien avec les utilisateurs qu'avec les équipes techniques. Tu sais utiliser la donnée pour challenger tes intuitions et mesurer l'impact de ce que tu construis. Tu es autonome, curieux·se et pragmatique : quand il faut creuser un sujet ou mettre les mains dans le cambouis, tu le fais. Ce qui serait un plus Tu n'as pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases, mais on sera particulièrement intéressés si : tu as déjà évolué dans une startup ou scale-up SaaS B2B avec une forte culture d'exécution ; tu sais utiliser PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude ou un outil similaire ; tu sais écrire des requêtes SQL pour explorer toi-même les données ; tu as utilisé des outils no-code / low-code pour prototyper, automatiser ou tester rapidement une idée ; tu te débrouilles sur Figma et Claude Code (ou Codex), sans être Product designer ou développeur. tu as une expérience avec des logiciels métiers complexes ; tu as déjà travaillé avec des artisans, des indépendants ou des professionnels du BTP ; tu connais ou as déjà utilisé Shape Up — sinon, pas de panique, ça s'apprend vite ; tu t'intéresses au secteur de l'énergie et à la transition énergétique ; tu connais la différence entre un kWc et un kWh . Mais Solteo c’est aussi… Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée. La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens. Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer ! Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante . Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe ! Processus de recrutement 📞 Entretien de cadrage au téléphone (20 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste. 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec un Co-fondateur et le COO (Mehdi). 🎯 Entretien technique avec l’équipe commerciale (1h00) : mise en situation pratique sur un business case avec le Head of Product et le COO ou PM. 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références (Réf call). 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Airship</strong></p> <p>Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.</p> <p>We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.</p> <p>To learn more about us, visit <a href="https://www.airship.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.airship.com/&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw3xEidfNT5kaSMR1LbqH2tz">www.airship.com</a>, read our <a href="https://www.airship.com/blog/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.airship.com/blog/&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw2S7rp6uesS3WbpmG9CFOaR">blog</a> or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/airship-social" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.linkedin.com/company/airship-social&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw2T3DnwhcK_pt63jzkrYdK6">LinkedIn.</a></p></div><h4>About the Role</h4> <p>As a Backend Java Engineer, you will design, develop, and support distributed systems that combine scale with high reliability. Additional tasks may be assigned, or the role’s scope may change based on business needs.</p> <h4>What We're Looking For</h4> <ul> <li>At least three years of experience designing, operating, and maintaining distributed systems</li> <li>Professional fluency in spoken and written French</li> <li>Strong Java development skills</li> <li>Experience with unit testing, code reviews, documentation, and Git-based version control</li> <li>Experience leading significant releases or technical projects</li> <li>Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>A collaborative and pragmatic approach to software development</li> <li>A commitment to building reliable, maintainable, and testable systems</li> </ul> <h4>We'd Be Delighted If You Also Have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience troubleshooting and improving JVM performance</li> <li>Experience with Google Cloud Platform</li> <li>Knowledge of distributed NoSQL databases or key-value stores</li> <li>Strong Linux administration fundamentals</li> </ul> <h4>Work Location & Travel Requirements</h4> <p>Airship’s ‘Digital First’ approach to work means that for the majority of our roles, work can be performed remotely, either some or most of the time. Airship believes that flexible work contributes to a more productive and more equitable work environment, and that Airshippers are able to collaborate, innovate, and support one another across different locations and timezones.</p> <p>Some roles may require that employees perform their work from a specific location to support business activities, and/or be within proximity to an Airship office location or customer or partner locations, while other roles can be performed 100% remotely. </p> <p>This position is <strong>fully remote</strong> and may require <strong>up to 10%</strong> travel based on business needs or as requested by your manager.</p> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Starting pay may vary based on factors such as relevant skills, work experience, market demands, and location. Airship's People Operations team reviews all AI-generated scores and recommendations before making any hiring determination. No applicant is rejected solely on the basis of an AI-generated output. Depending on your location, you may have the right to request human review of any AI-assisted employment decision or to opt out of AI evaluation. description: Localisation Poste basé à Lyon ou Dijon. Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique ! En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets , vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants. Vos missions · Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire. · Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires. · Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain. · Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques. · Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions. · Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets. · Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux. · Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement. · Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial. Votre profil · Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural. · Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial). · Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation. · Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux. · Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets. · Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation. Ce que NOVAR vous offre Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ? 💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours. 🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance. 🌴 Une prime vacances. 🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 🚗 Une voiture de fonction. 🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous. 📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS). 🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain. Intéressé(e) ? Prêt(e) pour la prochaine étape de votre carrière ? title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners) (H/F), Paris
description: Your mission You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams. You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room. Your tasks include: Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations. Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders. Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases. Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments. Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions. Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples. Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity. Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides. Your profile You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff. Experience & Education More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement. Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences. Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns. Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud. Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus. Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Paris). Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%). Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock). Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations. Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies. Skills & Attributes Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike. Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot. Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders. Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles. Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript. Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them. Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training. Why us? You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard. title: AI Support Engineer Lead
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary At Dust, we're building for a new kind of AI Operator : people who rethink and rebuild how their teams work around AI. Not “how can AI help us do this faster?” but “if AI existed from day one, would we even do this the same way?” As our AI Support Engineering Lead , you'll own how Support is built and scaled at Dust. This is a deeply hands-on role. You'll take on the hardest customer issues when our agents fall short, but your job isn't simply to resolve them. You'll look for the pattern behind each issue and turn what you learn into better agents, automation, tooling, documentation, and product improvements. Over time, you'll help grow the team and shape how Support Engineering operates as Dust scales. You'll define, ship, and continuously iterate on the systems that make this possible: AI agents, automation workflows, classification systems, knowledge systems, and tooling built on top of Dust itself. You'll dogfood the product harder than almost anyone at the company and set the standard for how the rest of the Support Engineering team does the same. We're looking for someone who wants to lead from the work: technically strong, obsessed with building better systems, and excited to shape both the team and the function as we grow. What you'll do Build the AI systems that do the work Set the technical direction for the support stack: what gets automated, in what order, and to what standard. You make the calls, not just the builds. Design, ship, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that reduce manual support load: think ticket classification, acknowledgment automation, response drafting, incident detection, and proactive user outreach. Identify recurring categories of issues and engineer them out of existence through automation, documentation, prompt iteration, or product feedback. Build and maintain tooling (MCP integrations, Dust agents, internal scripts) that increase the team's capacity without increasing headcount. Define and own the "Support as a Product" backlog. You decide what goes on it, coach the team to execute it, and hold the bar on what shipped means. Run support when the systems fall short Hire, onboard, and develop the support engineers around you. You're not just resolving tickets and building systems, you're growing the people who will. Set the standard for how complex issues get handled at Dust. You take the hardest tickets yourself. The team knows what good looks like because they've watched you do it. Investigate complex issues across logs, code, and internal tooling to identify root causes and provide clear answers to customers. Handle escalated cases with precise, accessible communication for both technical and non-technical audiences. Systematically analyze agent-generated responses for inconsistencies and iterate on prompts, documentation, and tooling until human intervention is minimal. Bridge customer pain to product improvements Represent support at the engineering and product level. You synthesize signal, prioritize it, and push it through with enough context that it actually moves things, not just relays it. Build strong working relationships with engineers and customer-facing teams to ensure efficient, high-context escalations. Own the feedback loop end-to-end: when agents fail due to missing or incorrect information, close the gap across engineering, product, and documentation. Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. Aptitude Function-building experience: You've defined or significantly shaped a support engineering function before: built the operating model, set the standards, hired into the team, or rebuilt a broken process from scratch. High technical aptitude: comfortable reading code, analyzing logs, navigating codebases, and troubleshooting distributed systems. You're not stopped by a stack trace. AI fluency at builder level: track record of building custom agents, automations, or workflows using AI tools (Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, etc.); not just prompting. Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, what to escalate, and, critically, what to delegate and to whom. You make these calls for yourself and for the team, fast and without second-guessing. People leadership: You've coached and developed engineers and know how to set expectations, give direct feedback, and raise the performance of the people around you. Bidirectional communication: can translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and speak technical language fluently with engineers. Build/Run mindset: You believe the best Support Engineering teams don't just resolve issues. They build systems that prevent those issues from recurring. Attitude Builder mentality: You instinctively automate repetitive work rather than accepting inefficient systems, and you hold your team to the same standard. Resilience-empathy paradox: You can absorb customer frustration without taking it personally while still deeply caring about the user experience. Leads by example: You're not above the queue. When something is hard, you take it. Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, and what to escalate. Thrives in ambiguity: You enjoy building systems from scratch in environments where many processes are still undefined. Low ego, team player: You share knowledge freely and care about the success of the broader team. Agency High ownership: You define what needs to be done as often as you execute it. You don't wait for someone to tell you the function has a gap. Systems-first thinking: You focus on eliminating categories of work, not simply resolving tickets faster. You hold yourself and the team accountable to that distinction. Pattern recognition to repeatability: You turn recurring issues into scalable systems, automations, workflows, or documentation that eliminate future occurrences. Deep investigation instincts: You investigate as far as possible before escalating, providing engineering teams with thoughtful, high-context information when collaboration is needed, and you coach the team to do the same. Even if you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We care deeply about curiosity, potential, and determination, and we know exceptional people don’t always fit neatly into a checklist. Benefits & Compensation Competitive compensation based on level and experience 100,000€ - 160,000€ Significant equity package at a Sequoia-backed startup Health benefits for you and your dependents New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc. Opportunity to travel between our Paris and San Francisco offices Regular team events and off-sites Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. title: Head of ClinOps Data Management RWD/RWE
description: À propos de Lifen Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique. Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France. Notre équipe L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine . Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données. Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering. C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus . Ce que tu feras chez nous Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation . Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à : Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne. Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume. Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe. Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement. Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées. Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche. Ce que nous attendrons de toi Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production. Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle. À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois. Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours : Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up , dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire. Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence , idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients. Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique. Nous attendons également : Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle . Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI. Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré. Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering . Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables. Nice-to-have Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD. Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé. Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé. Ta manière de travailler Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions. Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place. Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact. Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes. Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté. Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique. Process de recrutement Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte. Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance. Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses. Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs. title: Embedded Engineer
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy. What You Will Do Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots. Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample. Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities. Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast. Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data. Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong. Requirements Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems. Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar). Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar. Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar. A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly. Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be". Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Fluent in English. German is a plus. Nice to Have A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices. de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.</li> <li>Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</li> <li>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</li> <li>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</li> <li>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</li> <li>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</li> <li>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</li> <li>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</li> <li>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</li> <li>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</li> <li>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</li> <li>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. title: Observability Engineering Manager
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an Observability Engineering Manager who will lead the development of the distributed tracing or service mesh products as part of our Observability group.</p> <p>Engineering managers at Canonical are always coders who are able to review and lead both architecture and code. They should also be astute judges of character, and comfortable setting expectations and holding colleagues accountable to them. </p> <p>We are building an observability stack that is easy to deploy and operate on Kubernetes. This is part of a broader initiative to deliver the world's best suite of open source tools, where we provide deep integration and automation for best-of-breed open source offerings that cover metrics, logging, telemetry, alerting, tracing and profiling. Our goal is to make observability tools integral and pervasive across software practices .</p> <p>Our implementation of Kubernetes operators is opinionated, resilient, and scalable, providing deep insights out of the box. The user experience is polished and seamless for the end-users, and its administrators will enjoy smooth, lightweight Day 1 and Day 2 operations. We are excited to be improving the state of the art for open-source observability.</p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Kubernetes, and Observability. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.</p> <p>As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.</p> <p>We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role can be home based in the </em><em>EMEA or Americas regions.</em></p> <h2>The role entails</h2> <ul> <li>Manage a distributed team of engineers and its observability portfolio</li> <li>Organize and lead the team’s processes in order to help it achieve its objectives</li> <li>Conduct one-on-one meetings with team members</li> <li>Identify and measure team health indicators</li> <li>Interact with a vibrant community</li> <li>Review code produced by other engineers</li> <li>Attend conferences to represent Canonical and its Observability Stack</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for in you</h2> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>A proven track record of professional experience of software delivery</li> <li>Professional software development experience, preferably with a track record in open source</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation </li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills </li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2> <ul> <li>Experience as an engineering manager, with a track record of building great, high performance teams  </li> <li>Professional Python development experience</li> <li>A working knowledge of Go</li> <li>Open source contribution experience</li> <li>Interest and experience with container technologies</li> <li>A proven understanding of the importance of observability and monitoring for keeping software running smoothly</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing observability solutions</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer colleagues</h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software.
